4.163.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu pārtha paraṃ dānaṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśanam ..
yaddattvā trividhaṃ pāpaṃ sadyo vilayamṛcchati .. 1 ..
4.163.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु पार्थ परं दानं सर्वकिल्बिषनाशनम् ॥
यद्दत्त्वा त्रिविधं पापं सद्यो विलयमृच्छति ॥ 1 ॥
4.163.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen, O son of Pṛthā, to the supreme gift that destroys all sins, / having given which, threefold sin instantly undergoes destruction.

4.163.s:
suvarṇaromāṃ sauvarṇīṃ pratyakṣaṃ vā suśobhanām ..
suvarṇatilakopetāṃ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitām .. 2 ..
4.163.d:
सुवर्णरोमां सौवर्णीं प्रत्यक्षं वा सुशोभनाम् ॥
सुवर्णतिलकोपेतां सर्वालंकारभूषिताम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.163.m: [A ewe] with golden fleece, made of gold, or an actual, beautiful one, / bearing a golden forehead mark, adorned with all ornaments,

4.163.s:
kauśeyaparidhānāṃ ca divyacaṃdanabhūṣitām ..
divyapuṣpopahārāṃ ca sarvadhāturasairyutām ..
saptadhānyasamāyuktāṃ phalapuṣpavatīṃ tathā .. 3 ..
4.163.d:
कौशेयपरिधानां च दिव्यचंदनभूषिताम् ॥
दिव्यपुष्पोपहारां च सर्वधातुरसैर्युताम् ॥
सप्तधान्यसमायुक्तां फलपुष्पवतीं तथा ॥ 3 ॥
4.163.m: Clothed in silk attire and adorned with divine sandalwood paste, / with divine flowers as offerings and endowed with all metallic minerals and liquids, / accompanied by the seven grains, as well as with fruits and flowers,

4.163.s:
śatena kārayettāṃ ca suvarṇasya prayatnataḥ ..
yathā śaktyātha vā kuryādvittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayeta .. 4 ..
4.163.d:
शतेन कारयेत्तां च सुवर्णस्य प्रयत्नतः ॥
यथा शक्त्याथ वा कुर्याद्वित्तशाठ्यं न कारयेत ॥ 4 ॥
4.163.m: One should diligently have her made with a hundred [measures] of gold, / or one should make it according to one's means; one must not practice deceit regarding wealth.

4.163.s:
ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe śaśisūryayoḥ ..
duḥsvapnadarśane caiva janmarkṣe pitṛsaṃkṣaye .. 5 ..
4.163.d:
अयने विषुवे चैव ग्रहणे शशिसूर्ययोः ॥
दुःस्वप्नदर्शने चैव जन्मर्क्षे पितृसंक्षये ॥ 5 ॥
4.163.m: At a solstice, at an equinox, and at an eclipse of the moon or the sun, / when having a bad dream, at one's birth constellation, or on the death anniversary of an ancestor,

4.163.s:
yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam ..
tadaiva dānakālaḥ syādyato'nityaṃ hi jīvitam .. 6 ..
4.163.d:
यदा वा जायते वित्तं चित्तं श्रद्धासमन्वितम् ॥
तदैव दानकालः स्याद्यतोऽनित्यं हि जीवितम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.163.m: Or whenever wealth is present and the mind is endowed with faith, / right then is the time for giving, since life is indeed impermanent.

4.163.s: dadyāttīrthe gṛhe vāpi yatra vā ramate manaḥ .. 7 ..
4.163.d: दद्यात्तीर्थे गृहे वापि यत्र वा रमते मनः ॥ 7 ॥
4.163.m: One should give it at a sacred place or even at home, or wherever the mind takes delight.

4.163.s:
tatra saṃsthāpya deveśamumayā saha śaṃkaram ..
brahmāṇaṃ saha gāyatryā saśrīkaṃ śrīdharaṃ tathā .. 8 ..
4.163.d:
तत्र संस्थाप्य देवेशमुमया सह शंकरम् ॥
ब्रह्माणं सह गायत्र्या सश्रीकं श्रीधरं तथा ॥ 8 ॥
4.163.m: Having established there Śaṅkara, the lord of gods, together with Umā, / Brahmā together with Gāyatrī, and Śrīdhara together with Śrī,

4.163.s:
ratyā saha tathānaṃgaṃ lokapālāngrahānapi ..
saṃpūjya ca vidhānena gaṃdhapuṣpanivedanaiḥ .. 9 ..
4.163.d:
रत्या सह तथानंगं लोकपालान्ग्रहानपि ॥
संपूज्य च विधानेन गंधपुष्पनिवेदनैः ॥ 9 ॥
4.163.m: And Anaṅga together with Rati, as well as the world protectors and planets, / and having worshipped them according to the rules with offerings of perfumes and flowers,

4.163.s:
tadagre kārayeddhomaṃ tilājyena mahīpate ..
alaṃkṛtya dvijaṃ śāṃtaṃ vāsobhiḥ pratipūjya ca .. 4.163.10 ..
4.163.d:
तदग्रे कारयेद्धोमं तिलाज्येन महीपते ॥
अलंकृत्य द्विजं शांतं वासोभिः प्रतिपूज्य च ॥ 4.163.10 ॥
4.163.m: One should perform an oblation in the fire in front of them with sesame seeds and clarified butter, O protector of the earth, / having adorned a peaceful twice-born man and honoured him with garments.

4.163.s:
talliṅgamaṃtrairhomaśca kartavyo jvalite'nale ..
tatastāṃ tilakuṃbhasthāṃ lavaṇāntamupasthitām .. 11 ..
4.163.d:
तल्लिङ्गमंत्रैर्होमश्च कर्तव्यो ज्वलितेऽनले ॥
ततस्तां तिलकुंभस्थां लवणान्तमुपस्थिताम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.163.m: And the burnt offering should be made in the kindled fire with the mantras dedicated to her. / Then, worshipping her who is placed on a jar of sesame seeds and has salt alongside,

4.163.s:
pūjayitvā vidhānena mantrametamudīrayet ..
romatvaṅmāṃsamajjādyaiḥ sarvopakaraṇaiḥ sadā..
jagataḥ saṃpravṛddhāsi tvāmataḥ prārthaye sthitām .. 12 ..
4.163.d:
पूजयित्वा विधानेन मन्त्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥
रोमत्वङ्मांसमज्जाद्यैः सर्वोपकरणैः सदा॥
जगतः संप्रवृद्धासि त्वामतः प्रार्थये स्थिताम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.163.m: in accordance with the rules, he should utter this mantra: / 'With hair, hide, flesh, marrow, and all [other] materials, you have ever / flourished for the sake of the world; therefore, present here, I pray to you:

4.163.s:
vāṅmanaḥkāyajanitaṃ yatkiñcinmama duṣkṛtam..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yātu tava dānātprasevitam .. 13 ..
4.163.d:
वाङ्मनःकायजनितं यत्किञ्चिन्मम दुष्कृतम्॥
तत्सर्वं विलयं यातु तव दानात्प्रसेवितम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.163.m: Whatever misdeed of mine has been produced by speech, mind, and body, / may all that completely vanish through your gift, when carefully served.'

4.163.s:
evamuccārya tāṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine ..
nābhibhāṣeta taṃ dattvā mukhaṃ ca nāvalokayet .. 14 ..
4.163.d:
एवमुच्चार्य तां दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुम्बिने ॥
नाभिभाषेत तं दत्त्वा मुखं च नावलोकयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.163.m: Having spoken thus, he should give her to a Brahmin householder. / Having given her, he should not converse with him, nor should he look upon his face.

4.163.s: duṣṭapratigrahahato vipro bhavati pātakī .. 15 ..
4.163.d: दुष्टप्रतिग्रहहतो विप्रो भवति पातकी ॥ 15 ॥
4.163.m: Struck by an unworthy gift, a Brahmin becomes a sinner.

4.163.s:
no dadyāddakṣiṇāhīnāṃ dātavyā sā vidhānataḥ ..
dakṣiṇāvidhinā hīnā duḥkhaśokāvahā bhavet .. 16 ..
4.163.d:
नो दद्याद्दक्षिणाहीनां दातव्या सा विधानतः ॥
दक्षिणाविधिना हीना दुःखशोकावहा भवेत् ॥ 16 ॥
4.163.m: He should not give [her] devoid of a priestly fee; it must be given according to rule. / Void of the rule of a priestly fee, it would bring pain and grief.

4.163.s:
purā dattamidaṃ dānaṃ gauryā śaṃkarakāmyayā ..
tena śaṃbhuḥ patirlabdhaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ .. 17 ..
4.163.d:
पुरा दत्तमिदं दानं गौर्या शंकरकाम्यया ॥
तेन शंभुः पतिर्लब्धः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः ॥ 17 ॥
4.163.m: In ancient times this gift was given by Gaurī, desiring Śaṅkara; / through that, Śambhu was obtained as her husband, bowed to by all the gods.

4.163.s:
indrāṇyā svarṇaromāṇāṃ śataṃ dattaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
sarvadevapatiṃ prāpya patiṃ sādyāpi modate .. 15 ..
4.163.d:
इन्द्राण्या स्वर्णरोमाणां शतं दत्तं विधानतः ॥
सर्वदेवपतिं प्राप्य पतिं साद्यापि मोदते ॥ 15 ॥
4.163.m: A hundred golden-fleeced [ewes] were given by Indrāṇī in accordance with the rule; / having attained the lord of all the gods as her husband, she rejoices even today.

4.163.s:
nalena dattametaddhi rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ gataḥ ..
rukmiṇyāhaṃ patirlabdhaḥ saubhāgyamatulaṃ tathā .. 19 ..
4.163.d:
नलेन दत्तमेतद्धि राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं गतः ॥
रुक्मिण्याहं पतिर्लब्धः सौभाग्यमतुलं तथा ॥ 19 ॥
4.163.m: Given by Nala, indeed, having ruled a kingdom he went to heaven. / By Rukmiṇī I was obtained as husband, as well as peerless good fortune.

4.163.s:
dānasyāsya prabhāveṇa putrā bahubalānvitāḥ ..
aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam..4.163.20..
4.163.d:
दानस्यास्य प्रभावेण पुत्रा बहुबलान्विताः ॥
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो लभते धनम्॥4.163.20॥
4.163.m: By the power of this gift, sons endowed with great strength [are born]; / a sonless man obtains a son, a poor man obtains wealth.

4.163.s:
dattvā dānaṃ śubhāṃ kāṃtiṃ vipulāṃ ca tathā śriyam ..
ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ dānakalpamanuttamam..
ahorātrakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..21 ..
4.163.d:
दत्त्वा दानं शुभां कांतिं विपुलां च तथा श्रियम् ॥
य इमं शृणुयान्नित्यं दानकल्पमनुत्तमम्॥
अहोरात्रकृतात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥21 ॥
4.163.m: Having given this gift, [one gains] auspicious beauty and abundant fortune. / Whoever constantly hears this unsurpassed procedure of giving / is freed from sin committed day and night; of this there is no doubt.

4.163.s:
meṣī viśeṣakaluṣāpaharātiśastā dāne sadaiva rasadhātuyutā sadhānyā ..
tāmādareṇa kurunandana dehi dattvā yenāstapāpatimiraḥ saviteva bhāsi .. 22 .. ..
bhūmidānavarṇanam
4.163.d:
मेषी विशेषकलुषापहरातिशस्ता दाने सदैव रसधातुयुता सधान्या ॥
तामादरेण कुरुनन्दन देहि दत्त्वा येनास्तपापतिमिरः सवितेव भासि ॥ 22 ॥ ॥
भूमिदानवर्णनम्
4.163.m:
The ewe is highly praised as an exceptional remover of defilement; in giving she is ever accompanied by minerals and fluids, accompanied by grains. / Give her with reverence, O delight of the Kurus, having given which, your darkness of sin having set, you will shine like the sun.
Description of the Gift of Land

4.164.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca.. ..
bhūmidānamato vakṣye sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
ye prayacchaṃti viprebhyo bhūmidānaṃ sadakṣiṇam .. 1 ..
4.164.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच॥ ॥
भूमिदानमतो वक्ष्ये सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
ये प्रयच्छंति विप्रेभ्यो भूमिदानं सदक्षिणम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.164.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Now I shall declare the gift of land, the destroyer of all sins. / Those who bestow the gift of land upon Brahmins accompanied by a sacrificial fee,

4.164.s:
śrotriyāya daridrāya agnihotraratāya ca ..
sa sarvakāmatṛptātmā sarvaratnairvibhūṣitaḥ .. 2 ..
4.164.d:
श्रोत्रियाय दरिद्राय अग्निहोत्ररताय च ॥
स सर्वकामतृप्तात्मा सर्वरत्नैर्विभूषितः ॥ 2 ॥
4.164.m: to one learned in the Vedas, poor, and devoted to the fire-sacrifice, / his self fulfilled in all desires, adorned with all jewels,

4.164.s:
sarvapāpavinirmukto dīpyamāno raviryathā ..
bālasūryaprabhābhāsairvāditradhvajaśobhitaiḥ ..3..
4.164.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो दीप्यमानो रविर्यथा ॥
बालसूर्यप्रभाभासैर्वादित्रध्वजशोभितैः ॥3॥
4.164.m: completely freed from all sins, blazing like the sun, / on celestial chariots gleaming with the radiance of the morning sun, adorned with musical instruments and banners,

4.164.s: vimānairbhāsvarairdivyairviṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati .. 4 ..
4.164.d: विमानैर्भास्वरैर्दिव्यैर्विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति ॥ 4 ॥
4.164.m: radiant and divine, he goes to the realm of Viṣṇu.

4.164.s:
tatra divyāṃganābhiśca sevyamāno yathāsukham ..
kāmagaḥ kāmarūpī ca krīḍatyānaṃdamakṣayam .. 5 ..
4.164.d:
तत्र दिव्यांगनाभिश्च सेव्यमानो यथासुखम् ॥
कामगः कामरूपी च क्रीडत्यानंदमक्षयम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.164.m: There, waited upon at his pleasure by celestial women, / moving at will and assuming shapes at will, he sports in imperishable bliss.

4.164.s:
yāvaddhārayate lokānbhūraṃkurasamudbhavā ..
tāvadbhūmipradaḥ kāmaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 6 ..
4.164.d:
यावद्धारयते लोकान्भूरंकुरसमुद्भवा ॥
तावद्भूमिप्रदः कामं विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥ 6 ॥
4.164.m: As long as the earth, origin of sprouts, sustains the worlds, / so long does the giver of land rightly rejoice in the realm of Viṣṇu.

4.164.s:
nahi bhūmipradānādvai dānamanyadviśiṣyate ..
diśo daśānugṛhṇāti hartā tā daśa haṃti ca .. 7 ..
4.164.d:
नहि भूमिप्रदानाद्वै दानमन्यद्विशिष्यते ॥
दिशो दशानुगृह्णाति हर्ता ता दश हंति च ॥ 7 ॥
4.164.m: Indeed, no other gift is superior to the gift of land. / [The giver] favors ten directions, and the usurper destroys those ten.

4.164.s:
dānānyanyāni kṣīyaṃte kālena puruṣarṣabha ..
bhūmipradānapuṇyasya kṣayo naivopapadyate .. 8 ..
4.164.d:
दानान्यन्यानि क्षीयंते कालेन पुरुषर्षभ ॥
भूमिप्रदानपुण्यस्य क्षयो नैवोपपद्यते ॥ 8 ॥
4.164.m: Other gifts diminish in time, O bull among men; / no diminution ever befalls the merit of giving land.

4.164.s:
sarvapāpāni kṣīyaṃte kālayogakrameṇa tu ..
bhūmihartuśca rājeṃdra duḥkhasyāṃto na vidyate .. 9 ..
4.164.d:
सर्वपापानि क्षीयंते कालयोगक्रमेण तु ॥
भूमिहर्तुश्च राजेंद्र दुःखस्यांतो न विद्यते ॥ 9 ॥
4.164.m: All sins dwindle away in the course of time's conjunction, / but for the thief of land, O king of kings, there is no end to suffering.

4.164.s:
brāhmaṇāya suśīlāya bhūmiṃ dattvā tu yo naraḥ ..
na hi tāmupajīvedyaḥ sa mahatpuṇyamāpnuyāt .. 4.164.10 ..
4.164.d:
ब्राह्मणाय सुशीलाय भूमिं दत्त्वा तु यो नरः ॥
न हि तामुपजीवेद्यः स महत्पुण्यमाप्नुयात् ॥ 4.164.10 ॥
4.164.m: The man who, having given land to a virtuous Brahmin, / does not live off it, attains great merit.

4.164.s:
halakṛṣṭāṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā sabījāṃ sasyamālinīm..
yāvatsūryakṛtā lokastāvatsvarge mahīyate .. 11 ..
4.164.d:
हलकृष्टां महीं कृत्वा सबीजां सस्यमालिनीम्॥
यावत्सूर्यकृता लोकस्तावत्स्वर्गे महीयते ॥ 11 ॥
4.164.m: Having made the earth furrowed by the plough, provided with seeds, and garlanded with crops, / as long as the worlds are illuminated by the sun, so long is he glorified in heaven.

4.164.s:
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca ratnānyābharaṇāni ca ..
sarvadānāni rājeṃdra dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat .. 12 ..
4.164.d:
धनं धान्यं हिरण्यं च रत्नान्याभरणानि च ॥
सर्वदानानि राजेंद्र ददाति वसुधां ददत् ॥ 12 ॥
4.164.m: Wealth, grain, gold, gems, and ornaments— / all gifts he gives, O king of kings, when giving the earth.

4.164.s:
sāgarānsaritaḥ śailānsamāni viṣamāṇi ca ..
sarvagaṃdharasānsnehāndadāti vasudhāṃ dadat .. 13 ..
4.164.d:
सागरान्सरितः शैलान्समानि विषमाणि च ॥
सर्वगंधरसान्स्नेहान्ददाति वसुधां ददत् ॥ 13 ॥
4.164.m: Oceans, rivers, mountains, level lands and rough, / all scents, tastes, and saps he gives when giving the earth.

4.164.s:
oṣadhīḥ kṣīrasaṃpannā nānāpuṣpaphalopagāḥ ..
kamalotpalakhaṃḍāṃśca dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat .. 14 ..
4.164.d:
ओषधीः क्षीरसंपन्ना नानापुष्पफलोपगाः ॥
कमलोत्पलखंडांश्च ददाति वसुधां ददत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.164.m: Medicinal herbs full of sap, laden with diverse flowers and fruits, / and beds of lotuses and water lilies he gives when giving the earth.

4.164.s:
agniṣṭomādibhiryajñairye yajaṃti sadakṣiṇaiḥ ..
prāpnuvaṃti ca tatpuṇyaṃ bhūmidānādyadāpyate .. 15 ..
4.164.d:
अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैर्ये यजंति सदक्षिणैः ॥
प्राप्नुवंति च तत्पुण्यं भूमिदानाद्यदाप्यते ॥ 15 ॥
4.164.m: The merit that those who sacrifice with the Agniṣṭoma and other rites along with priestly fees obtain, / that same merit is attained from the gift of land.

4.164.s:
śrotriyāya mahīṃ dattvā ye haraṃti na mānavāḥ ..
tāvatteṣāṃ bhavetsvargo yāvallokā pratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 16..
4.164.d:
श्रोत्रियाय महीं दत्त्वा ये हरंति न मानवाः ॥
तावत्तेषां भवेत्स्वर्गो यावल्लोका प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥ 16॥
4.164.m: Those men who, having given land to a Vedic scholar, do not seize it back, / heaven shall be theirs as long as the worlds remain established.

4.164.s:
sasyapūrṇāṃ mahīṃ yastu śrotriyāya prayacchati ..
pitarastasya tuṣyaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 17 ..
4.164.d:
सस्यपूर्णां महीं यस्तु श्रोत्रियाय प्रयच्छति ॥
पितरस्तस्य तुष्यंति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.164.m: He who bestows land full of crops upon a Vedic scholar, / his ancestors are gratified until the universal dissolution.

4.164.s:
yatkiṃcitkurute pāpaṃ puruṣo vṛttikarśitaḥ ..
api gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena śudhyati .. 18 ..
4.164.d:
यत्किंचित्कुरुते पापं पुरुषो वृत्तिकर्शितः ॥
अपि गोचर्ममात्रेण भूमिदानेन शुध्यति ॥ 18 ॥
4.164.m: Whatever sin a man commits when reduced by [lack of] livelihood, / he is purified even by a gift of land measuring only a cow's hide.

4.164.s:
suvarṇānāṃ sahasreṇa yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam..
bhūmi gocarmamātreṇa tatphalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ .. 19 ..
4.164.d:
सुवर्णानां सहस्रेण यत्पुण्यं समुदाहृतम्॥
भूमि गोचर्ममात्रेण तत्फलं प्राप्नुयान्नरः ॥ 19 ॥
4.164.m: The merit that is declared to come from a thousand gold pieces, / that fruit a man obtains from land measuring only a cow's hide.

4.164.s:
kapilānāṃ sahasrebhyo yaddatte'nnaṃ narottama ..
bhūmigocarmamātreṇa tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ .. 4.164.20 ..
4.164.d:
कपिलानां सहस्रेभ्यो यद्दत्तेऽन्नं नरोत्तम ॥
भूमिगोचर्ममात्रेण तत्फलं लभते नरः ॥ 4.164.20 ॥
4.164.m: Whatever food is given to thousands of brown cows, O best of men, / that fruit a man attains from land measuring only a cow's hide.

4.164.s:
madhyamasya manuṣyasya vyāsena parisaṃkhyayā..
triṃśaddaṃḍāṃśca gocarma dattvā svarge mahīyate .. 21 ..
4.164.d:
मध्यमस्य मनुष्यस्य व्यासेन परिसंख्यया॥
त्रिंशद्दंडांश्च गोचर्म दत्त्वा स्वर्गे महीयते ॥ 21 ॥
4.164.m: According to the calculation of Vyāsa for an average man, / having given a cow's hide measuring thirty rods, he is glorified in heaven.

4.164.s:
bahubhirvasudhā bhuktā rājabhiḥ sagarādibhiḥ ..
yasya yasya yadā bhūmistasyatasya tadā phalam .. 22 ..
4.164.d:
बहुभिर्वसुधा भुक्ता राजभिः सगरादिभिः ॥
यस्य यस्य यदा भूमिस्तस्यतस्य तदा फलम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.164.m: The earth has been enjoyed by many kings, beginning with Sagara; / whoever possesses the land at any time, his is the fruit then.

4.164.s:
kiṃkarā mṛtyudaṃḍāśca asipatravanādayaḥ ..
ghorāśca vāruṇāḥ pāśā nopasarpaṃti bhūmidam.. 23 ..
4.164.d:
किंकरा मृत्युदंडाश्च असिपत्रवनादयः ॥
घोराश्च वारुणाः पाशा नोपसर्पंति भूमिदम्॥ 23 ॥
4.164.m: The servants [of Yama], the rods of death, the forest of sword-like leaves and the like, / and the terrible snares of Varuṇa do not approach the giver of land.

4.164.s:
nirayā rauravādyāśca kuṃbhīpākaḥ suduḥsahaḥ ..
tathā ca yātanāḥ kaṣṭā nopasarpaṃti bhūmidam .. 24 ..
4.164.d:
निरया रौरवाद्याश्च कुंभीपाकः सुदुःसहः ॥
तथा च यातनाः कष्टा नोपसर्पंति भूमिदम् ॥ 24 ॥
4.164.m: The hells, Raurava and others, the unbearable Kumbhīpāka, / and dreadful torments do not approach the giver of land.

4.164.s:
citraguptaśca kālaśca kṛtāṃto mṛtyureva ca ..
yamaścāpi svayaṃ rājā saṃpūjayati bhūmidam .. 25 ..
4.164.d:
चित्रगुप्तश्च कालश्च कृतांतो मृत्युरेव च ॥
यमश्चापि स्वयं राजा संपूजयति भूमिदम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.164.m: Citragupta, Time, the End-Maker, and Death himself, / and King Yama himself honours the giver of land.

4.164.s:
rudraḥ prajāpatiḥ śakro devāsuragaṇāstathā ..
ahaṃ ca paramaprītyā pūjayāmīha bhūmidam.. 26 ..
4.164.d:
रुद्रः प्रजापतिः शक्रो देवासुरगणास्तथा ॥
अहं च परमप्रीत्या पूजयामीह भूमिदम्॥ 26 ॥
4.164.m: Rudra, Prajāpati, Śakra, the hosts of gods and demons, / and I too, honour the giver of land here with supreme love.

4.164.s:
ṣaṭkarmakṛtsuvṛttāya kṛśāya ca priyārthine ..
bhūmirdeyā naravyāghra sannidhiścākṣayo bhavet .. 27 ..
4.164.d:
षट्कर्मकृत्सुवृत्ताय कृशाय च प्रियार्थिने ॥
भूमिर्देया नरव्याघ्र सन्निधिश्चाक्षयो भवेत् ॥ 27 ॥
4.164.m: To one who performs the six rites, of good conduct, emaciated, and desiring his welfare, / land should be given, O tiger among men, and an inexhaustible store shall be his.

4.164.s:
sīdamānakuṭuṃbāya śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye ..
vṛttasthāya daridrāya bhūmirdeyā nareśvara .. 28 ..
4.164.d:
सीदमानकुटुंबाय श्रोत्रियायाहिताग्नये ॥
वृत्तस्थाय दरिद्राय भूमिर्देया नरेश्वर ॥ 28 ॥
4.164.m: To one whose family is in distress, a Vedic scholar who maintains the sacred fire, / established in good conduct and poor, land should be given, O lord of men.

4.164.s:
yathā janitrī kṣīreṇa putraṃ saṃvarddhayetsadā ..
tathā bhūmipradaṃ bhūmiḥ sarvakāmaistu tarpati .. 29 ..
4.164.d:
यथा जनित्री क्षीरेण पुत्रं संवर्द्धयेत्सदा ॥
तथा भूमिप्रदं भूमिः सर्वकामैस्तु तर्पति ॥ 29 ॥
4.164.m: Just as a mother ever nurtures her son with milk, / so the earth gratifies the giver of land with all desires.

4.164.s:
yathā gaurbharate vatsa kṣīreṇa kṣīramutsṛjet ..
tathā sarvarasopetā bhūmirbharati bhūmidam .. 4.164.30 ..
4.164.d:
यथा गौर्भरते वत्स क्षीरेण क्षीरमुत्सृजेत् ॥
तथा सर्वरसोपेता भूमिर्भरति भूमिदम् ॥ 4.164.30 ॥
4.164.m: Just as a cow sustains her calf with milk and yields milk, / so the earth, endowed with all essences, sustains the giver of land.

4.164.s:
yathā bījāni rohaṃti jalasiktāni bhūtale ..
tathā kāmāḥ prarohaṃti bhūmidasya dinedine .. 31 ..
4.164.d:
यथा बीजानि रोहंति जलसिक्तानि भूतले ॥
तथा कामाः प्ररोहंति भूमिदस्य दिनेदिने ॥ 31 ॥
4.164.m: Just as seeds grow when sprinkled with water on the surface of the earth, / so the desires of the giver of land flourish day by day.

4.164.s:
yathodayansahasrāṃśustamaḥ sarvaṃ vyapohati ..
tathā bhūmipradānaṃ tu sarvapāpaṃ vyapohati .. 32 ..
4.164.d:
यथोदयन्सहस्रांशुस्तमः सर्वं व्यपोहति ॥
तथा भूमिप्रदानं तु सर्वपापं व्यपोहति ॥ 32 ॥
4.164.m:
Just as the thousand-rayed sun rising dispels all darkness,
even so the gift of land dispels all sin.

4.164.s:
para dattāṃ tu yo bhūmimupahiṃsetkadācana ..
sa baddho vāruṇaiḥ pāśaiḥ kṣipyate pūyaśoṇite .. 33 ..
4.164.d:
पर दत्तां तु यो भूमिमुपहिंसेत्कदाचन ॥
स बद्धो वारुणैः पाशैः क्षिप्यते पूयशोणिते ॥ 33 ॥
4.164.m:
Whoever should ever seize land given by another
is bound with the snares of Varuṇa and cast into pus and blood.

4.164.s:
svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā yo hareta vasuṃdharām ..
sa naro narake ghore kliśyatyāpralayāṃtikam .. 34 ..
4.164.d:
स्वदत्तां परदत्तां वा यो हरेत वसुंधराम् ॥
स नरो नरके घोरे क्लिश्यत्याप्रलयांतिकम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.164.m:
Whoever takes away land, whether given by himself or given by another,
that man suffers in a terrible hell until the end of the cosmic dissolution.

4.164.s:
rudatāṃ vṛttināśena ye pataṃtyaśrubiṃdavaḥ ..
tādvarṣasahasrāṇi narake pacyate tu saḥ .. 35 ..
4.164.d:
रुदतां वृत्तिनाशेन ये पतंत्यश्रुबिंदवः ॥
ताद्वर्षसहस्राणि नरके पच्यते तु सः ॥ 35 ॥
4.164.m:
As many drops of tears as fall from those weeping because of the destruction of their livelihood,
for that many thousands of years he is boiled in hell.

4.164.s:
brāhmaṇānāṃ hṛte kṣetre hartustripuruṣaṃ kulam ..
dattvā bhūmiṃ tu viprāya upahiṃsedyadā punaḥ ..
adhomukhaśca duṣṭātmā kuṃbhīpāke sa pacyate ..36..
4.164.d:
ब्राह्मणानां हृते क्षेत्रे हर्तुस्त्रिपुरुषं कुलम् ॥
दत्त्वा भूमिं तु विप्राय उपहिंसेद्यदा पुनः ॥
अधोमुखश्च दुष्टात्मा कुंभीपाके स पच्यते ॥36॥
4.164.m:
When a field belonging to Brahmins is seized, three generations of the thief's family [fall].
When, having given land to a Brahmin, one seizes it back,
that evil-minded one is boiled head downwards in Kumbhīpāka hell.

4.164.s:
divyavarṣasahasrāṃte kuṃbhīpākādviniḥsṛtaḥ ..
iha loke bhavecchā vai sapta janmāni pārthiva..37..
4.164.d:
दिव्यवर्षसहस्रांते कुंभीपाकाद्विनिःसृतः ॥
इह लोके भवेच्छा वै सप्त जन्मानि पार्थिव॥37॥
4.164.m:
Released from Kumbhīpāka at the end of a thousand divine years,
he becomes an outcaste in this world for seven births, O king.

4.164.s:
svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā yatnādrakṣedyudhiṣṭhira ..
mahīṃ mahībhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha dānācchreyonupālanam.. 38 ..
4.164.d:
स्वदत्तां परदत्तां वा यत्नाद्रक्षेद्युधिष्ठिर ॥
महीं महीभृतां श्रेष्ठ दानाच्छ्रेयोनुपालनम्॥ 38 ॥
4.164.m:
Whether given by oneself or given by another, guard the earth with care, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
O best of kings; protecting [a gift] is better than giving.

4.164.s:
toyahīneṣvaraṇyeṣu śuṣkakoṭaravāsinaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāhvayobhijāyaṃte narā brahmasvahāriṇaḥ ..39..
4.164.d:
तोयहीनेष्वरण्येषु शुष्ककोटरवासिनः ॥
कृष्णाह्वयोभिजायंते नरा ब्रह्मस्वहारिणः ॥39॥
4.164.m:
Men who steal the property of Brahmins are reborn as black snakes
dwelling in dry hollows in waterless forests.

4.164.s:
evaṃ dattvā mahīṃ rājanprahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti manasā ciṃtitānnaraḥ .. 4.164.40 ..
4.164.d:
एवं दत्त्वा महीं राजन्प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना ॥
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति मनसा चिंतितान्नरः ॥ 4.164.40 ॥
4.164.m:
Having given the earth in this way with a joyful inner soul, O king,
a man obtains all desires imagined in his mind.

4.164.s:
bhūmidānātparaṃ nāsti sukhaṃ vāmuṣmikaṃ mahat ..
na cāpi bhūmiharaṇādanyatpātakamucyate .. 41 ..
4.164.d:
भूमिदानात्परं नास्ति सुखं वामुष्मिकं महत् ॥
न चापि भूमिहरणादन्यत्पातकमुच्यते ॥ 41 ॥
4.164.m:
There is no great happiness in the other world higher than the gift of land,
nor is any sin declared to be greater than the seizure of land.

4.164.s:
yacchaṃti ye dvijavarāya mahīṃ sukṛṣṭāṃ te yāṃti śakrasadanaṃ suviśuddhadehāḥ ..
ye lopayaṃtyatibalādatha kāmalobhātte rauravātigahanānna samuttaraṃti .. 42 ..
pṛthivīdānavidhivarṇanam
4.164.d:
यच्छंति ये द्विजवराय महीं सुकृष्टां ते यांति शक्रसदनं सुविशुद्धदेहाः ॥
ये लोपयंत्यतिबलादथ कामलोभात्ते रौरवातिगहनान्न समुत्तरंति ॥ 42 ॥
पृथिवीदानविधिवर्णनम्

4.165.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhūmidānaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ nānyeṣāmupapadyate ..
te hyupārjayituṃ śaktā dātuṃ pālayituṃ yathā .. 1 ..
4.165.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
भूमिदानं क्षत्रियाणां नान्येषामुपपद्यते ॥
ते ह्युपार्जयितुं शक्ता दातुं पालयितुं यथा ॥ 1 ॥

4.165.s:
bhūmidānasamaṃ kiṃcidanyatkathaya yādava ..
saṃprāptavittairyacchakyaṃ saṃsārabhayabhīrubhiḥ .. 2 ..
4.165.d:
भूमिदानसमं किंचिदन्यत्कथय यादव ॥
संप्राप्तवित्तैर्यच्छक्यं संसारभयभीरुभिः ॥ 2 ॥
4.165.m:
Tell of something else equal to the gift of land, O Yādava,
which can be performed with wealth acquired by those who fear the terror of saṃsāra.

4.165.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sauvarṇāṃ vidhivatkṛtvā sādridrumavatīṃ śubhām ..
mahīṃ prayaccha viprāṇāṃ tattulyā sā nigadyate .. 3 ..
4.165.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
सौवर्णां विधिवत्कृत्वा साद्रिद्रुमवतीं शुभाम् ॥
महीं प्रयच्छ विप्राणां तत्तुल्या सा निगद्यते ॥ 3 ॥
4.165.m:
The Holy Kṛṣṇa said:
Having properly fashioned an auspicious [image of the] earth in gold, endowed with mountains and trees,
bestow it upon Brahmins; it is declared to be equal to that.

4.165.s:
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā mahādānaṃ narottama ..
savidhānaṃ pravakṣyāmi phalaṃ yatnena yadbhavet .. 4 ..
4.165.d:
शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा महादानं नरोत्तम ॥
सविधानं प्रवक्ष्यामि फलं यत्नेन यद्भवेत् ॥ 4 ॥
4.165.m:
Listen with a concentrated mind, O best of men, to the great gift;
I shall declare it along with the procedure, and the fruit that comes from it with effort.

4.165.s:
caṃdrasūryoparāge ca janmarkṣe viṣuve tathā ..
yugādiṣu ca dātavyamayane ca vidhānataḥ .. 5 ..
4.165.d:
चंद्रसूर्योपरागे च जन्मर्क्षे विषुवे तथा ॥
युगादिषु च दातव्यमयने च विधानतः ॥ 5 ॥
4.165.m:
At an eclipse of the moon or the sun, on one's birth-star, at the equinox,
at the starts of the yugas, and at the solstices, it should be given according to rule;

4.165.s:
anyeṣvapi ca kāleṣu praśaste dhanasaṃcaye ..
pāpakṣayāya dātavyaṃ yaśo'rthe vā narairbhuvi .. 6 ..
4.165.d:
अन्येष्वपि च कालेषु प्रशस्ते धनसंचये ॥
पापक्षयाय दातव्यं यशोऽर्थे वा नरैर्भुवि ॥ 6 ॥
4.165.m:
and at other auspicious times, when wealth has accumulated,
it should be given by men on earth for the destruction of sin or for the sake of fame.

4.165.s:
hemnaḥ palaśatenoktā tadardhenāpi śaktitaḥ ..
kuryātpaṃcapalādūrdhvamasamartho'pi bhaktimān .. 7 ..
4.165.d:
हेम्नः पलशतेनोक्ता तदर्धेनापि शक्तितः ॥
कुर्यात्पंचपलादूर्ध्वमसमर्थोऽपि भक्तिमान् ॥ 7 ॥
4.165.m:
[The earth] is prescribed to be made of a hundred palas of gold, or of half that according to one's means;
even an incapable person who is devoted may make it from five palas upwards.

4.165.s:
kārayetpṛthivīṃ haimīṃ jaṃbudvīpānukāriṇīm ..
maryādāparvatavatīṃ madhye merusamanvitām .. 8 ..
4.165.d:
कारयेत्पृथिवीं हैमीं जंबुद्वीपानुकारिणीम् ॥
मर्यादापर्वतवतीं मध्ये मेरुसमन्विताम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.165.m:
He should have a golden earth fashioned resembling Jambūdvīpa,
endowed with the boundary mountains and with Meru in the center,

4.165.s:
lokapālāṣṭakopetāṃ brahmaviśveśasaṃyutām ..
nānāparvatapūrṇāṃ ca ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām .. 9 ..
4.165.d:
लोकपालाष्टकोपेतां ब्रह्मविश्वेशसंयुताम् ॥
नानापर्वतपूर्णां च रत्नाभरणभूषिताम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.165.m:
endowed with the eight world protectors, together with Brahmā and Viśveśa,
filled with various mountains, and adorned with gem-ornaments,

4.165.s:
sarvasasyavicitrāṃgīṃ sarvagaṃdhādhivāsitām ..
īdṛśīṃ tu mahīṃ kṛtvā kārayenmaṃḍapaṃ tataḥ .. 4.165.10 ..
4.165.d:
सर्वसस्यविचित्रांगीं सर्वगंधाधिवासिताम् ॥
ईदृशीं तु महीं कृत्वा कारयेन्मंडपं ततः ॥ 4.165.10 ॥
4.165.m:
its body variegated with all crops, perfumed with all fragrances.
Having made such an earth, he should then have a pavilion constructed,

4.165.s:
daśadvādaśahastaṃ ca caturvaktra satoraṇam ..
madhye ca vedikāṃ kuryāddhanurhastāṃ pramāṇataḥ .. ..11..
4.165.d:
दशद्वादशहस्तं च चतुर्वक्त्र सतोरणम् ॥
मध्ये च वेदिकां कुर्याद्धनुर्हस्तां प्रमाणतः ॥ ॥11॥
4.165.m:
ten by twelve cubits, with four entrances and archways.
In the middle he should make an altar measuring one bow-length cubit.

4.165.s:
aiśānyāṃ surasaṃsthānamāgneyyāṃ kuṃḍameva ca ..
patākābhiralaṃkṛtya devatāyatanānyatha .. 12 ..
4.165.d:
ऐशान्यां सुरसंस्थानमाग्नेय्यां कुंडमेव च ॥
पताकाभिरलंकृत्य देवतायतनान्यथ ॥ 12 ॥
4.165.m:
In the northeast is the place of the deities, and in the southeast the sacrificial pit.
Then, having decorated the shrines of the deities with banners,

4.165.s:
lokapālā grahāścaiva pūjyā mālyavilepanaiḥ ..
homaṃ kuryurdvijāḥ śāṃtāścātuścaraṇikāḥ śubhāḥ .. 13 ..
4.165.d:
लोकपाला ग्रहाश्चैव पूज्या माल्यविलेपनैः ॥
होमं कुर्युर्द्विजाः शांताश्चातुश्चरणिकाः शुभाः ॥ 13 ॥
4.165.m:
the world protectors and the planets are to be worshipped with garlands and ointments.
Serene and auspicious twice-born priests skilled in the four Vedas should perform the fire oblation,

4.165.s:
sālaṃkārā savastrāśca mālyacaṃdanabhūṣitāḥ ..
agnisaṃsthāpanaṃ tatra kṛtvā pūrvaṃ tato mahīm.. 14 ..
4.165.d:
सालंकारा सवस्त्राश्च माल्यचंदनभूषिताः ॥
अग्निसंस्थापनं तत्र कृत्वा पूर्वं ततो महीम्॥ 14 ॥
4.165.m:
wearing ornaments and clothes, adorned with garlands and sandalwood.
Having first established the fire there, then the twice-born

4.165.s:
ānayeyurdvijā rājanbrahmaghoṣapuraḥsaram ..
śaṃkhatūryaninādaiśca geyamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ .. 15 ..
4.165.d:
आनयेयुर्द्विजा राजन्ब्रह्मघोषपुरःसरम् ॥
शंखतूर्यनिनादैश्च गेयमंगलनिस्वनैः ॥ 15 ॥
4.165.m:
should bring the earth, O king, preceded by the chanting of the Veda,
with the sounding of conches and musical instruments, and auspicious songs.

4.165.s:
tilaiḥ pracchāditāṃ vediṃ kṛtvā tatrādhivāsayet ..
athāṣṭādaśadhānyāni rasāṃśca lavaṇādikān .. 16 ..
4.165.d:
तिलैः प्रच्छादितां वेदिं कृत्वा तत्राधिवासयेत् ॥
अथाष्टादशधान्यानि रसांश्च लवणादिकान् ॥ 16 ॥
4.165.m:
Having made an altar covered with sesame seeds, he should consecrate it there,
as well as eighteen grains and flavors such as salt and the like;

4.165.s:
tathāṣṭau pūrṇakalaśānsamaṃtātsthāpayecchubhān ..
vitānakaṃ ca kauśeyaṃ phalāni vividhāni ca .. 17 ..
4.165.d:
तथाष्टौ पूर्णकलशान्समंतात्स्थापयेच्छुभान् ॥
वितानकं च कौशेयं फलानि विविधानि च ॥ 17 ॥
4.165.m:
and likewise he should place eight auspicious, full jars all around,
a silken canopy, various fruits,

4.165.s:
aṃśukāni vicitrāṇi śrīkhaṃḍaśakalāni ca ..
ityevaṃ racayitvā tāmadhivāsanapūrvakam .. 18 ..
4.165.d:
अंशुकानि विचित्राणि श्रीखंडशकलानि च ॥
इत्येवं रचयित्वा तामधिवासनपूर्वकम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.165.m:
variegated garments, and pieces of sandalwood.
Having arranged it thus preceded by the consecration,

4.165.s:
tato homāvasāneṣu niṣpanne sarvaśāṃtike ..
śuklamālyāṃbaradharo yajamānaḥ svayaṃ tataḥ .. 19 ..
4.165.d:
ततो होमावसानेषु निष्पन्ने सर्वशांतिके ॥
शुक्लमाल्यांबरधरो यजमानः स्वयं ततः ॥ 19 ॥
4.165.m:
then, at the conclusion of the oblations, when the universal pacification rite is accomplished,
the patron himself, clad in white garlands and garments,

4.165.s:
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ pṛthvīṃ gṛhītvā kusumāṃjalim ..
puṇyakālamathāsādya maṃtrānetānudīrayet .. 4.165.20 ..
4.165.d:
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं पृथ्वीं गृहीत्वा कुसुमांजलिम् ॥
पुण्यकालमथासाद्य मंत्रानेतानुदीरयेत् ॥ 4.165.20 ॥
4.165.m:
having circumambulated the earth and taken a handful of flowers,
upon the arrival of the auspicious time, should utter these mantras:

4.165.s:
namaste sarvadevānāṃ tvameva bhavanaṃ yataḥ ..
dhātrī tvamasi bhūtānāmataḥ pāhi vasuṃdhare .. 21 ..
4.165.d:
नमस्ते सर्वदेवानां त्वमेव भवनं यतः ॥
धात्री त्वमसि भूतानामतः पाहि वसुंधरे ॥ 21 ॥
4.165.m:
"Homage to you, since you are the abode of all gods!
You are the sustainer of all beings; therefore protect [me], O bearer of wealth!

4.165.s:
vasu dhārayase yasmātsarvasaukhyapradāyakam ..
vasuṃdharā tato jātā tasmātpāhi bhayādalam .. 22 ..
4.165.d:
वसु धारयसे यस्मात्सर्वसौख्यप्रदायकम् ॥
वसुंधरा ततो जाता तस्मात्पाहि भयादलम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.165.m:
Because you bear wealth that bestows all happiness,
you have therefore come to be called 'Vasuṃdharā'; protect [me] thoroughly from fear!

4.165.s:
caturmukho'pi no gacchedyasmādaṃtaṃ tavācale ..
anaṃtāyai namastubhyaṃ pāhi saṃsārakardamāt .. 23 ..
4.165.d:
चतुर्मुखोऽपि नो गच्छेद्यस्मादंतं तवाचले ॥
अनंतायै नमस्तुभ्यं पाहि संसारकर्दमात् ॥ 23 ॥
4.165.m:
Since even the four-faced [Brahmā] cannot reach your end, O immovable one,
homage to you, the endless one; protect [me] from the mire of saṃsāra!

4.165.s:
tvameva lakṣmīrgovide śive gaurīti saṃsthitā ..
gāyatrī brahmaṇaḥ pārśve jyotsnā caṃdre ravau prabhā .. 24 ..
4.165.d:
त्वमेव लक्ष्मीर्गोविदे शिवे गौरीति संस्थिता ॥
गायत्री ब्रह्मणः पार्श्वे ज्योत्स्ना चंद्रे रवौ प्रभा ॥ 24 ॥
4.165.m:
You alone are Lakṣmī in Govinda, you abide as Gaurī in Śiva,
Gāyatrī at the side of Brahmā, the moonlight in the moon, the radiance in the sun;

4.165.s:
buddhirbṛhaspatau khyātā medhā muniṣu saṃsthitā ..
viśvaṃ prāpya sthitā yasmāttato viśvaṃbharā matā .. 25 ..
4.165.d:
बुद्धिर्बृहस्पतौ ख्याता मेधा मुनिषु संस्थिता ॥
विश्वं प्राप्य स्थिता यस्मात्ततो विश्वंभरा मता ॥ 25 ॥
4.165.m:
intelligence known in Bṛhaspati, and wisdom dwelling in the sages;
since you abide having pervaded the universe, you are considered Viśvaṃbharā.

4.165.s:
dhṛtiḥ kṣitiḥ kṣamā kṣoṇī pṛthivī vasudhā mahī ..
etābhirmūrtibhiḥ pāhi devi saṃsārasāgarāt .. 26 ..
4.165.d:
धृतिः क्षितिः क्षमा क्षोणी पृथिवी वसुधा मही ॥
एताभिर्मूर्तिभिः पाहि देवि संसारसागरात् ॥ 26 ॥
4.165.m:
Resolution, Earth, Forbearance, Soil, Ground, Bearer of Wealth, Earth—
protect [me] from the ocean of saṃsāra through these forms, O goddess!"

4.165.s:
evamuccārya tāṃ devīṃ brāhmaṇebhyo niveda yet ..
dharārddhaṃ vā caturbhāgaṃ gurave pratipādayet .. 27 ..
4.165.d:
एवमुच्चार्य तां देवीं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो निवेद येत् ॥
धरार्द्धं वा चतुर्भागं गुरवे प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 27 ॥
4.165.m:
Having spoken thus, he should present that goddess to Brahmins;
he should grant half the earth or a fourth part to the guru.

4.165.s:
anena vidhinā yastu dadyāddevīṃ dharāṃ budhaḥ ..
puṇyakāle ca saṃprāpte sa padaṃ yāti vaiṣṇavam .. .. 28 ..
4.165.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्याद्देवीं धरां बुधः ॥
पुण्यकाले च संप्राप्ते स पदं याति वैष्णवम् ॥ ॥ 28 ॥
4.165.m:
The wise person who gives the goddess earth according to this rite
when the auspicious time arrives goes to the abode of Viṣṇu.

4.165.s:
yadi kartuṃ na śaknoti puṇyehni bahuvistaram ..
saṃsthāpya śobhane sthāne mahīmeva pradāpayet .. 29 ..
4.165.d:
यदि कर्तुं न शक्नोति पुण्येह्नि बहुविस्तरम् ॥
संस्थाप्य शोभने स्थाने महीमेव प्रदापयेत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.165.m:
If he cannot make such an extensive rite on an auspicious day,
he may have the earth given away simply by placing it in an auspicious spot.

4.165.s:
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṃkiṇījāla mālinā ..
nārāyaṇapuraṃ gatvā kalpatrayamathāvaset .. 4.165.30 ..
4.165.d:
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन किंकिणीजाल मालिना ॥
नारायणपुरं गत्वा कल्पत्रयमथावसेत् ॥ 4.165.30 ॥
4.165.m:
Going to the city of Nārāyaṇa in a celestial chariot the color of the sun,
wreathed with nets of tinkling bells, he dwells there for three kalpas.

4.165.s:
kṣīṇapuṇya ihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
vijayī śatrudamano bahubhṛtyaparicchadaḥ .. 31 ..
4.165.d:
क्षीणपुण्य इहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥
विजयी शत्रुदमनो बहुभृत्यपरिच्छदः ॥ 31 ॥
4.165.m:
His merit exhausted, he returns here and becomes a righteous king,
victorious, a conqueror of enemies, with many servants and retinue.

4.165.s:
śatakoṭyadhipaḥ śūraścakravartī mahābalaḥ ..
sapta janmāni dānasya māhātmyādrājyamāpnuyāt .. 32 ..
4.165.d:
शतकोट्यधिपः शूरश्चक्रवर्ती महाबलः ॥
सप्त जन्मानि दानस्य माहात्म्याद्राज्यमाप्नुयात् ॥ 32 ॥
4.165.m: Lord of a hundred million, a heroic emperor endowed with great strength, / he would obtain a kingdom for seven births through the majesty of this gift.

4.165.s:
dvīpāvikarṣaviṣamāṃ vidhivadvidhāya haimīṃ mahīṃ suramahīmiva vindhyamadhyām ..
lokeśaśaṃbhuśivakeśavasaṃyutāṃ ca prāyaccha pārtha tava kiṃ bahunoditena .. 33 ..
halapaṃktidānavidhivarṇanam
4.165.d:
द्वीपाविकर्षविषमां विधिवद्विधाय हैमीं महीं सुरमहीमिव विन्ध्यमध्याम् ॥
लोकेशशंभुशिवकेशवसंयुतां च प्रायच्छ पार्थ तव किं बहुनोदितेन ॥ 33 ॥
हलपंक्तिदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.165.m:
Having duly fashioned the golden earth, undulating with its continent-furrows, like the divine earth with the Vindhya at its centre, / and endowed it with the lords of the world, Śambhu, Śiva, and Keśava, bestow it, O Pārtha! What need is there to say more to you?
Description of the Rule for the Gift of a Row of Ploughs

4.166.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dānamatyadbhutaṃ tava ..
yena dattena rājendra sarvadānaprado bhavet .. 1 ..
4.166.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि दानमत्यद्भुतं तव ॥
येन दत्तेन राजेन्द्र सर्वदानप्रदो भवेत् ॥ 1 ॥
4.166.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hereafter I shall tell you of a most wondrous gift, / by the giving of which, O best of kings, one becomes the bestower of all gifts.

4.166.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvasaukhyapradāyakam ..
prayuktaṃ halapaṃktyā ca sarvadānaphalapradam .. 2 ..
4.166.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वसौख्यप्रदायकम् ॥
प्रयुक्तं हलपंक्त्या च सर्वदानफलप्रदम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.166.m: It pacifies all sins, bestows all happiness, / and when performed as a row of ploughs, it grants the fruit of all gifts.

4.166.s:
paṃktirdaśahalā proktā halaṃ syāttu caturgavam ..
sāradārumayānyāhurhalāni daśa paṃḍitāḥ..3..
4.166.d:
पंक्तिर्दशहला प्रोक्ता हलं स्यात्तु चतुर्गवम् ॥
सारदारुमयान्याहुर्हलानि दश पंडिताः॥3॥
4.166.m: A row is declared to be ten ploughs; a plough should have four oxen. / The learned say that the ten ploughs are made of hard timber,

4.166.s:
sauvarṇapaṭṭasaṃnaddha ratnavaṃti śubhāni ca ..
yūnaśca balino bhavyānvyaṃgahīnānsvalaṃkṛtān .. 4 ..
4.166.d:
सौवर्णपट्टसंनद्ध रत्नवंति शुभानि च ॥
यूनश्च बलिनो भव्यान्व्यंगहीनान्स्वलंकृतान् ॥ 4 ॥
4.166.m: bound with golden bands, studded with gems, and auspicious. / [There should be] young, strong, handsome bulls, free from defect, well-adorned,

4.166.s:
vastrakāṃcanapuṣpaiśca caṃdanairdigdhamastakān ..
abhagnānyojayetteṣu lāṃgaleṣu vṛṣāñchubhān .. 5 ..
4.166.d:
वस्त्रकांचनपुष्पैश्च चंदनैर्दिग्धमस्तकान् ॥
अभग्नान्योजयेत्तेषु लांगलेषु वृषाञ्छुभान् ॥ 5 ॥
4.166.m: with cloths, gold, flowers, their heads smeared with sandalwood paste. / To these ploughs one should yoke sound, auspicious bulls.

4.166.s:
yoktrāṇi yugalagnāni savṛṣāṇi ca kārayet ..
pratodakīlakābaṃdhasarvopakaraṇānvitām .. 6 ..
4.166.d:
योक्त्राणि युगलग्नानि सवृषाणि च कारयेत् ॥
प्रतोदकीलकाबंधसर्वोपकरणान्विताम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.166.m: One should have the yokes fitted with yoking-straps and harnessed with bulls, / equipped with goads, pegs, bindings, and all necessary implements.

4.166.s:
evaṃvidha halaiḥ kuryāttaṃ yuktāṃ halapaṃktikām ..
karkaṭaṃ kheṭakaṃ cāpi grāmaṃ vā sasyamālinam .. 7 ..
4.166.d:
एवंविध हलैः कुर्यात्तं युक्तां हलपंक्तिकाम् ॥
कर्कटं खेटकं चापि ग्रामं वा सस्यमालिनम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.166.m: With such ploughs one should prepare that harnessed row of ploughs, / and also [grant] an estate, a village, or a hamlet girdled with crops,

4.166.s:
nivartanaśataṃ vāpi tadarddhaṃ vā prakalpayet ..
evaṃvidhāṃ parvakāle dadyātprayatamānasaḥ .. 8 ..
4.166.d:
निवर्तनशतं वापि तदर्द्धं वा प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
एवंविधां पर्वकाले दद्यात्प्रयतमानसः ॥ 8 ॥
4.166.m: or assign one hundred nivartanas [of land], or even half of that. / Such [a gift] one should bestow at an auspicious time with a focused mind.

4.166.s:
kārtikyāṃ cātha vaiśākhyāmuttare vā'yane tathā ..
janmarkṣe grahaṇe vāpi viṣuve vā pradāpayet .. 9 ..
4.166.d:
कार्तिक्यां चाथ वैशाख्यामुत्तरे वाऽयने तथा ॥
जन्मर्क्षे ग्रहणे वापि विषुवे वा प्रदापयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
4.166.m: One should have it given on the full moon of Kārttika or Vaiśākha, at the northern solstice, / on one's birth constellation, during an eclipse, or at an equinox.

4.166.s:
brāhmaṇānvedasaṃpannānvyaṃgahīnānalaṃkṛtān ..
śrotriyāṃśca vinītāṃśca halasaṃkhyānnimaṃtrayet .. 4.166.10 ..
4.166.d:
ब्राह्मणान्वेदसंपन्नान्व्यंगहीनानलंकृतान् ॥
श्रोत्रियांश्च विनीतांश्च हलसंख्यान्निमंत्रयेत् ॥ 4.166.10 ॥
4.166.m: One should invite brāhmaṇas who are accomplished in the Vedas, free from defect, adorned, / learned in the scriptures, and modest, equal in number to the ploughs.

4.166.s:
daśahastapramāṇena maṃḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ..
pūrve dvikuḍamekaṃ vā hastamātraṃ suśobhanam .. 11 ..
4.166.d:
दशहस्तप्रमाणेन मंडपं कारयेद्बुधः ॥
पूर्वे द्विकुडमेकं वा हस्तमात्रं सुशोभनम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.166.m: A wise man should erect a pavilion measuring ten cubits, / and in the east an exquisite [sacrificial pit], either of two kuḍavas or measuring one cubit.

4.166.s:
tatra vyāhṛtibhirhomaṃ kuryuste dvijasattamāḥ ..
parjanyādityarudrebhyaḥ pāyasena yajedbudhaḥ .. 12 ..
4.166.d:
तत्र व्याहृतिभिर्होमं कुर्युस्ते द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
पर्जन्यादित्यरुद्रेभ्यः पायसेन यजेद्बुधः ॥ 12 ॥
4.166.m: There those best of twice-born should perform the homa with the vyāhṛtis. / A wise man should worship Parjanya, Āditya, and the Rudras with milk-rice.

4.166.s:
pālāśyaḥ samidhastatra sājyaṃ kṛṣṇāstilāstathā ..
adhivāsya ca tāṃ paṃktiṃ dhānyamadhyagatāṃ śubhām .. 13 ..
4.166.d:
पालाश्यः समिधस्तत्र साज्यं कृष्णास्तिलास्तथा ॥
अधिवास्य च तां पंक्तिं धान्यमध्यगतां शुभाम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.166.m: The firewood sticks there are of palāśa wood, along with ghee and black sesame seeds. / Having consecrated that auspicious row stationed in the midst of grain,

4.166.s:
tataḥ sarvasamīpe tu snātaḥ śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ ..
halapaṃktiṃ yojayitvā yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ .. 14 ..
4.166.d:
ततः सर्वसमीपे तु स्नातः शुक्लांबरः शुचिः ॥
हलपंक्तिं योजयित्वा यजमानः समाहितः ॥ 14 ॥
4.166.m: then, near everything, bathed, wearing white garments, pure, / and having harnessed the row of ploughs, the patron of the sacrifice, composed,

4.166.s:
tūryaśaṃkhaninādaiśca brahmaghoṣaiḥ supuṣkalaiḥ ..
imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ .. 15 ..
4.166.d:
तूर्यशंखनिनादैश्च ब्रह्मघोषैः सुपुष्कलैः ॥
इममुच्चारयेन्मंत्रं गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः ॥ 15 ॥
4.166.m: amid the sounds of trumpets and conches and resounding Vedic recitations, / should recite this mantra with a handful of flowers taken in hand:

4.166.s:
yasmāddevagaṇāḥ sarve hale tiṣṭhaṃti sarvadā ..
vṛṣaskaṃdhe saṃnihitāstasmādbhaktiḥ śivestu me .. 16 ..
4.166.d:
यस्माद्देवगणाः सर्वे हले तिष्ठंति सर्वदा ॥
वृषस्कंधे संनिहितास्तस्माद्भक्तिः शिवेस्तु मे ॥ 16 ॥
4.166.m: 'Since all the hosts of gods abide forever in the plough / and are present on the shoulders of the bull, may my devotion be to Śiva!

4.166.s:
yasmācca bhūmidānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ..
dānānyanyāni me bhaktirdharme cāstu dṛḍhā sadā .. 17 ..
4.166.d:
यस्माच्च भूमिदानस्य कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम् ॥
दानान्यन्यानि मे भक्तिर्धर्मे चास्तु दृढा सदा ॥ 17 ॥
4.166.m: And since other gifts do not equal a sixteenth part / of the gift of land, may my devotion to dharma always remain firm!'

4.166.s:
evamukte tataḥ paṃktiṃ prerayeyurdvijottamāḥ ..
bījāni sarvaratnāni suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā .. 18 ..
4.166.d:
एवमुक्ते ततः पंक्तिं प्रेरयेयुर्द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
बीजानि सर्वरत्नानि सुवर्णं रजतं तथा ॥ 18 ॥
4.166.m: When this has been spoken, the best of the twice-born should drive the row. / Seeds, all kinds of gems, gold, and silver—

4.166.s:
svayaṃ paścāddhale lagno viprahasteṣu nirvapet ..
yāyānnivartanaṃ yāvattatastu viramedbudhaḥ .. 19 ..
4.166.d:
स्वयं पश्चाद्धले लग्नो विप्रहस्तेषु निर्वपेत् ॥
यायान्निवर्तनं यावत्ततस्तु विरमेद्बुधः ॥ 19 ॥
4.166.m: following behind the plough himself, he should pour them into the hands of the brāhmaṇas. / The wise man should proceed for as far as a nivartana, and then cease.

4.166.s:
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā viprāṇāṃ pratipādya ca ..
sadakṣiṇāṃ vidhānena praṇipatya visarjayet .. 4.166.20 ..
4.166.d:
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा विप्राणां प्रतिपाद्य च ॥
सदक्षिणां विधानेन प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥ 4.166.20 ॥
4.166.m: Then, having circumambulated [it] and presented it to the brāhmaṇas / along with a sacrificial fee according to rule, he should bow down and dismiss them.

4.166.s:
anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati ..
ekaviṃśatkulopetaḥ svargaloke mahīyate .. 21 ..
4.166.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ॥
एकविंशत्कुलोपेतः स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥ 21 ॥
4.166.m: Whoever bestows this gift according to this rule / is exalted in the world of heaven along with twenty-one generations of his family.

4.166.s:
saptajanmasu dāridryaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ vyādhayastathā ..
na paśyati ca bhūmestu tathaivādhipatirbhavet .. 22 ..
4.166.d:
सप्तजन्मसु दारिद्र्यं दौर्भाग्यं व्याधयस्तथा ॥
न पश्यति च भूमेस्तु तथैवाधिपतिर्भवेत् ॥ 22 ॥
4.166.m: For seven births he experiences no poverty, misfortune, or disease, / and indeed he becomes a sovereign lord of the earth.

4.166.s:
dṛṣṭvā taddīyamānaṃ tu dānametadyudhiṣṭhira ..
ājanmanaḥ kṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..23..
4.166.d:
दृष्ट्वा तद्दीयमानं तु दानमेतद्युधिष्ठिर ॥
आजन्मनः कृतात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥23॥
4.166.m: Beholding this gift being given, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / one is freed from the sins committed since birth; of this there is no doubt.

4.166.s:
dānametatpradattaṃ hi dilīpena yayātinā ..
śibinā niminā caiva bharatena ca dhīmatā .. 24 ..
4.166.d:
दानमेतत्प्रदत्तं हि दिलीपेन ययातिना ॥
शिबिना निमिना चैव भरतेन च धीमता ॥ 24 ॥
4.166.m: Indeed, this gift was given by Dilīpa, by Yayāti, / by Śibi, by Nimi, and by the wise Bharata.

4.166.s:
te'dyāpi divi modaṃte dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena dānametannṛpottama .. 25 ..
4.166.d:
तेऽद्यापि दिवि मोदंते दानस्यास्य प्रभावतः ॥
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन दानमेतन्नृपोत्तम ॥ 25 ॥
4.166.m: Even today they rejoice in heaven through the power of this gift. / Therefore, with every effort, O best of kings,

4.166.s:
dātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktena striyā vā puruṣeṇa vā ..
yadi paṃktirna vidyeta paṃca vā caturo'tha vā.. 26 ..
4.166.d:
दातव्यं भक्तियुक्तेन स्त्रिया वा पुरुषेण वा ॥
यदि पंक्तिर्न विद्येत पंच वा चतुरोऽथ वा॥ 26 ॥
4.166.m: this gift must be given with devotion by a woman or a man. / If a row is not available, then five or four,

4.166.s: ekamapyuktavidhinā halaṃ deyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ .. 27 ..
4.166.d: एकमप्युक्तविधिना हलं देयं विचक्षणैः ॥ 27 ॥
4.166.m: or even a single plough should be given by the wise according to the stated rule.

4.166.s:
ye saṃti lāṃgalamukhottharajovikārā yāvaṃti tadgatadhuraṃdhara romakāṇi ..
tāvaṃti śaṃkarapure triyugāni tiṣṭhetpaṃktipradānamiha yatkurute manuṣyaḥ .. 28 ..
4.166.d:
ये संति लांगलमुखोत्थरजोविकारा यावंति तद्गतधुरंधर रोमकाणि ॥
तावंति शंकरपुरे त्रियुगानि तिष्ठेत्पंक्तिप्रदानमिह यत्कुरुते मनुष्यः ॥ 28 ॥
4.166.m: As many particles of dust as arise from the point of the plough, as many as are the hairs of the draft-bullocks harnessed to it, / for so many three-age periods does a man dwell in the city of Śaṅkara who makes the gift of a row here [in this world].

4.166.s:
yuktāṃ vṛṣairatibalairhalapaṃktimetāṃ puṇyehni bhaktisahitāndvijapuṃgavebhyaḥ ..
yacchaṃti ye sukṛtino vasudhāsametāṃ te bhūbhujo bhuvamupetya bhavaṃti bhavyāḥ .. 29 ..
āpākadānavidhivarṇanam
4.166.d:
युक्तां वृषैरतिबलैर्हलपंक्तिमेतां पुण्येह्नि भक्तिसहितान्द्विजपुंगवेभ्यः ॥
यच्छंति ये सुकृतिनो वसुधासमेतां ते भूभुजो भुवमुपेत्य भवंति भव्याः ॥ 29 ॥
आपाकदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.166.m:
Those virtuous kings who, on an auspicious day, bestow this row of ploughs yoked with exceedingly strong bulls, together with land, with devotion upon the eminent twice-born, / will come to the earth and become fortunate rulers of the world.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of a Potter's Kiln

4.167.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
tanme kathaya deveśa yena dattena mānavaḥ ..
bahuputro bahudhano bahubhṛtyaśca jāyate ..1..
4.167.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
तन्मे कथय देवेश येन दत्तेन मानवः ॥
बहुपुत्रो बहुधनो बहुभृत्यश्च जायते ॥1॥
4.167.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me that, O Lord of gods, by the giving of which a person / is born with many sons, great wealth, and many servants.

4.167.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
purā bhārata vaṃśesminrājāsīddhavyavāhanaḥ.. (havyavāhanaḥ)
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ tena prāptaṃ rājya makaṃṭakam ..2..
4.167.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पुरा भारत वंशेस्मिन्राजासीद्धव्यवाहनः॥ (हव्यवाहनः)
पितृपैतामहं तेन प्राप्तं राज्य मकंटकम् ॥2॥
4.167.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly in this lineage of Bharata, there was a king named Havyavāhana. / By him his ancestral kingdom was obtained free from thorns.

4.167.s:
na tasya rājye vidhvaṃso na vairijanitaṃ bhayam ..
śarīrotthamahāvyādhirna caivāṃtaradāyakaḥ ..3..
4.167.d:
न तस्य राज्ये विध्वंसो न वैरिजनितं भयम् ॥
शरीरोत्थमहाव्याधिर्न चैवांतरदायकः ॥3॥
4.167.m: In his kingdom there was no destruction, no fear arising from enemies, / no severe disease arising in the body, nor any causing internal agony.

4.167.s:
tasyaivaṃ kurvato rājyaṃ pūrvakarmārjitāśubhāt ..
nāsti bhṛtyo bhārasahaḥ sarvarājyadhuraṃdharaḥ ..4..
4.167.d:
तस्यैवं कुर्वतो राज्यं पूर्वकर्मार्जिताशुभात् ॥
नास्ति भृत्यो भारसहः सर्वराज्यधुरंधरः ॥4॥
4.167.m: While he was ruling his kingdom thus, because of evil acquired through past deeds, / he had no servant capable of bearing burdens and carrying the weight of the entire kingdom,

4.167.s:
na putraḥ priyakṛtkaścinna maṃtrī madhurākṣaraḥ ..
na mitraṃ kāryakaraṇe samartho na suhṛttathā.. 5 ..
4.167.d:
न पुत्रः प्रियकृत्कश्चिन्न मंत्री मधुराक्षरः ॥
न मित्रं कार्यकरणे समर्थो न सुहृत्तथा॥ 5 ॥
4.167.m: no son who acted kindly, no minister of sweet speech, / no friend capable of executing tasks, and likewise no well-wisher,

4.167.s:
na bhojyasamaye prāpte bhojanaṃ sārvakāmikam ..
na pūgaphalasaṃyuktaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ vasanaṃ na ca .. 6 ..
4.167.d:
न भोज्यसमये प्राप्ते भोजनं सार्वकामिकम् ॥
न पूगफलसंयुक्तं तांबूलं वसनं न च ॥ 6 ॥
4.167.m: no meal fulfilling all desires when the time for eating arrived, / no betel leaf accompanied by areca nut, and no garment,

4.167.s:
na dhanaṃ janasaṃbandhakārako ratnasaṃcayaḥ ..
tasyaivaṃ kurvato rājyamavyāhatamaceṣṭitam .. 7 ..
4.167.d:
न धनं जनसंबन्धकारको रत्नसंचयः ॥
तस्यैवं कुर्वतो राज्यमव्याहतमचेष्टितम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.167.m: no wealth, nor any hoard of jewels that establishes ties with people. / While he was thus ruling the kingdom without obstacle or striving,

4.167.s:
athaikasmindine vipraḥ pippalādo'tiviśrutaḥ ..
ājagāma mahāyogī rājñaḥ pārśvaṃ mahādyutiḥ .. 8 ..
4.167.d:
अथैकस्मिन्दिने विप्रः पिप्पलादोऽतिविश्रुतः ॥
आजगाम महायोगी राज्ञः पार्श्वं महाद्युतिः ॥ 8 ॥
4.167.m: then, on a certain day, the widely renowned brāhmaṇa Pippalāda, / a great yogin endowed with great splendour, came to the presence of the king.

4.167.s:
tamāgataṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā rājapatnī śubhāvatī ..
pādyārghyāsanadānena sarvathā tamapūjayat .. 9 ..
4.167.d:
तमागतं मुनिं दृष्ट्वा राजपत्नी शुभावती ॥
पाद्यार्घ्यासनदानेन सर्वथा तमपूजयत् ॥ 9 ॥
4.167.m: Seeing that sage arrived, the king's wife, Śubhāvatī, / worshipped him in every way by offering water for the feet, arghya, and a seat.

4.167.s:
tataḥ kathāṃte kasmiṃścittamuvāca śubhāvatī ..
bhagavanrājyametannaḥ sarvabādhāvivarjitam .. 4.167.10 ..
4.167.d:
ततः कथांते कस्मिंश्चित्तमुवाच शुभावती ॥
भगवन्राज्यमेतन्नः सर्वबाधाविवर्जितम् ॥ 4.167.10 ॥
4.167.m: Then, at the end of a conversation, Śubhāvatī said to him: / "O venerable one, this kingdom of ours is free of all impediments;

4.167.s:
kasmānna bhṛtyāḥ putrā vā maṃtrimitrādikaṃ dvija ..
bhogāvāptirna ca tathā sarvalokātiśāyinī .. 11 ..
4.167.d:
कस्मान्न भृत्याः पुत्रा वा मंत्रिमित्रादिकं द्विज ॥
भोगावाप्तिर्न च तथा सर्वलोकातिशायिनी ॥ 11 ॥
4.167.m: Why are there no servants or sons, no ministers, friends, and the like, O twice-born one, / nor the attainment of pleasures that surpasses all the world?"

4.167.s:
.. pippalāda uvāca .. ..
yadyena pūrvavihitaṃ tadasau prākṛte phalam ..
karmabhūmiriyaṃ rājñi nātaḥ śocitumarhasi .. 12 ..
4.167.d:
॥ पिप्पलाद उवाच ॥ ॥
यद्येन पूर्वविहितं तदसौ प्राकृते फलम् ॥
कर्मभूमिरियं राज्ञि नातः शोचितुमर्हसि ॥ 12 ॥
4.167.m: Pippalāda said: / "Whatever was done by a person in the past, that fruit he [receives] in his present birth. / This is the realm of action, O queen; you should not grieve over this.

4.167.s:
na tatkurvaṃti rājāno na dāyādā na śatravaḥ ..
na bāṃdhavā na mitrāṇi yadyena na purā kṛtam .. 13 ..
4.167.d:
न तत्कुर्वंति राजानो न दायादा न शत्रवः ॥
न बांधवा न मित्राणि यद्येन न पुरा कृतम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.167.m: Neither kings, nor heirs, nor enemies, / nor kinsmen, nor friends bring about what was not done by oneself before.

4.167.s:
tasmādbhavadbhiyarddattaṃ prāptaṃ tadrājyamuttamam ..
bhṛtyamitrādisaṃbaṃdho na dattaḥ prāpyate kutaḥ .. 14 ..
4.167.d:
तस्माद्भवद्भियर्द्दत्तं प्राप्तं तद्राज्यमुत्तमम् ॥
भृत्यमित्रादिसंबंधो न दत्तः प्राप्यते कुतः ॥ 14 ॥
4.167.m: Therefore, what was given by you, that excellent kingdom has been obtained; / the relation of servants, friends, and the like was not given—whence could it be obtained?"

4.167.s:
.. śubhāvatyuvāca .. ..
idānīmeva viprarṣe kasmāttannopadiśyate ..
yena me bahavaḥ putrā dhanaṃ bhṛtyā bhavaṃti vai .. 15 ..
4.167.d:
॥ शुभावत्युवाच ॥ ॥
इदानीमेव विप्रर्षे कस्मात्तन्नोपदिश्यते ॥
येन मे बहवः पुत्रा धनं भृत्या भवंति वै ॥ 15 ॥
4.167.m: Śubhāvatī said: / "O brāhmaṇa-seer, why is that not taught [to me] right now, / by which I may have many sons, wealth, and servants indeed?

4.167.s:
maṃtro vā siddhayogo vā vrataṃ dānamupoṣitam ..
kathayasvāmalamate yena saṃpadyate sukham .. 16 ..
4.167.d:
मंत्रो वा सिद्धयोगो वा व्रतं दानमुपोषितम् ॥
कथयस्वामलमते येन संपद्यते सुखम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.167.m: Whether a mantra, an accomplished rite, a vrata, a gift, or a fast, / tell me, O pure-minded one, that by which happiness is achieved."

4.167.s:
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa pippalādo dvijottamaḥ ..
āpākākhyaṃ mahādānaṃ sarvasaṃpatpradāyakam .. 17 ..
4.167.d:
ततः स कथयामास पिप्पलादो द्विजोत्तमः ॥
आपाकाख्यं महादानं सर्वसंपत्प्रदायकम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.167.m: Then that Pippalāda, the best of the twice-born, explained / the great gift called Āpāka, which grants all prosperity:

4.167.s:
śraddhayā kuruśārdūla nārī vāpyatha vā pumān ..
yena dattena bhāgyānāṃ bahūnāṃ bhājanaṃ bhavet .. 18 ..
4.167.d:
श्रद्धया कुरुशार्दूल नारी वाप्यथ वा पुमान् ॥
येन दत्तेन भाग्यानां बहूनां भाजनं भवेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.167.m: "With faith, O tiger among the Kurus, whether a woman or a man, / by giving which one becomes a recipient of much good fortune."

4.167.s:
tacchrutvā sa dadau rājā''pākākhyaṃ dānamuttamam ..
lebhe putrānpaśūnbhṛtyānmaṃtrimitrasuhṛjjanān.. 19 ..
4.167.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा स ददौ राजा'ऽपाकाख्यं दानमुत्तमम् ॥
लेभे पुत्रान्पशून्भृत्यान्मंत्रिमित्रसुहृज्जनान्॥ 19 ॥
4.167.m: Hearing that, the king gave the excellent gift named Āpāka; / he obtained sons, cattle, servants, ministers, friends, and good-hearted people.

4.167.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
āpākākhyaṃ mahādānaṃ kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira ..
dattena yena kāmānāṃ pumānbhavati bhājanam .. 4.167.20 ..
4.167.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
आपाकाख्यं महादानं कथयामि युधिष्ठिर ॥
दत्तेन येन कामानां पुमान्भवति भाजनम् ॥ 4.167.20 ॥
4.167.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / "I shall describe the great gift named Āpāka, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / by the giving of which a man becomes a vessel of his desires.

4.167.s:
grahatārābalaṃ labdhvā bhārgavaṃ pūjayecchubham ..
vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiścaiva puṣpairagarucaṃdanaiḥ .. 21 ..
4.167.d:
ग्रहताराबलं लब्ध्वा भार्गवं पूजयेच्छुभम् ॥
वासोभिर्भूषणैश्चैव पुष्पैरगरुचंदनैः ॥ 21 ॥
4.167.m: Having obtained the strength of planets and stars, one should worship an auspicious potter / with garments, ornaments, flowers, agallochum, and sandal.

4.167.s:
kuryāttathaiva sammānaṃ yathā tuṣṭo'bhijāyate ..
kuruṣva tvaṃ me bhāṃḍāni gurūṇi ca laghūni ca .. 22 ..
4.167.d:
कुर्यात्तथैव सम्मानं यथा तुष्टोऽभिजायते ॥
कुरुष्व त्वं मे भांडानि गुरूणि च लघूनि च ॥ 22 ॥
4.167.m: One should honor him in such a way that he becomes pleased: / 'Make for me vessels, heavy and light,

4.167.s:
maṇikādīni śubhrāṇi sthālyaśca sumanoharāḥ ..
ghaṭakāḥ karakāścaiva galaṃtyaḥ kuṃḍalāni ca .. 23 ..
4.167.d:
मणिकादीनि शुभ्राणि स्थाल्यश्च सुमनोहराः ॥
घटकाः करकाश्चैव गलंत्यः कुंडलानि च ॥ 23 ॥
4.167.m: Bright large water-jars and the like, and very charming cooking pots, / small pitchers, water-vessels, water-drippers, and shallow basins,

4.167.s:
śarāvādīni pātrāṇi bhāṃḍamuccāvacaṃ bahu ..
saṃpādaya mahābhāga viśvakarmā tvameva hi .. 24 ..
4.167.d:
शरावादीनि पात्राणि भांडमुच्चावचं बहु ॥
संपादय महाभाग विश्वकर्मा त्वमेव हि ॥ 24 ॥
4.167.m: Dishes and other vessels, diverse pots in abundance; / produce them, O fortunate one, for you are indeed Viśvakarman.'"

4.167.s:
bhārgavo'pi prayatnena nānā bhāṃḍānvitaṃ śubham ..
āpākaṃ kalpayeddivyaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ..29..
4.167.d:
भार्गवोऽपि प्रयत्नेन नाना भांडान्वितं शुभम् ॥
आपाकं कल्पयेद्दिव्यं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥29॥
4.167.m: The potter too should diligently construct a splendid, divine / kiln filled with various pots, according to the rite prescribed by rule.

4.167.s:
sahasramekaṃ bhāṃḍānāṃ sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
saṃdhyākāle jvalitvā tu dadyāccāpi hutāśanam .. 26 ..
4.167.d:
सहस्रमेकं भांडानां स्थापयित्वा विचक्षणः ॥
संध्याकाले ज्वलित्वा तु दद्याच्चापि हुताशनम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.167.m: Having arranged one thousand pots, the wise [potter], / having ignited [the fire] at twilight, should apply the fire.

4.167.s:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādgītamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ ..
tataḥ prabhāte vimale jñātvā nirvāpitaṃ śanaiḥ .. 27 ..
4.167.d:
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याद्गीतमङ्गलनिस्वनैः ॥
ततः प्रभाते विमले ज्ञात्वा निर्वापितं शनैः ॥ 27 ॥
4.167.m: During the night one should keep vigil with songs and auspicious sounds; / then, in the clear dawn, knowing that it has gradually cooled down,

4.167.s:
raktavastraiḥ samācchādya puṣpamālābhirarcayet ..
yajamānastataḥ snātvā śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ .. .. 28 ..
4.167.d:
रक्तवस्त्रैः समाच्छाद्य पुष्पमालाभिरर्चयेत् ॥
यजमानस्ततः स्नात्वा शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः ॥ ॥ 28 ॥
4.167.m: Having covered it with red garments, one should worship it with flower garlands. / Then the patron of the sacrifice, having bathed, wearing white garments, pure,

4.167.s:
hemaraupyāṇi bhāṃḍāni tāmralohamayāni ca ..
paritaḥ sthāpayitvā ca svaśaktyā tāni ṣoḍaśa .. 29 ..
4.167.d:
हेमरौप्याणि भांडानि ताम्रलोहमयानि च ॥
परितः स्थापयित्वा च स्वशक्त्या तानि षोडश ॥ 29 ॥
4.167.m: Vessels of gold and silver, and those made of copper and iron, / having placed them all around according to his means, sixteen of them,

4.167.s:
pūjayitvā prayatnena kṛtvā cāru pradakṣiṇām ..
brāhmaṇānpūjayitvā ca bhārgavaṃ pūjya yatnataḥ .. 4.167.30 ..
4.167.d:
पूजयित्वा प्रयत्नेन कृत्वा चारु प्रदक्षिणाम् ॥
ब्राह्मणान्पूजयित्वा च भार्गवं पूज्य यत्नतः ॥ 4.167.30 ॥
4.167.m: Having worshipped them carefully and performed a graceful circumambulation, / having worshipped the brāhmaṇas and diligently worshipped the potter,

4.167.s:
nāryaścāvidhavāstatra samānīya prapūjya ca ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā maṃtreṇānena pūjayet .. 31 ..
4.167.d:
नार्यश्चाविधवास्तत्र समानीय प्रपूज्य च ॥
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा मंत्रेणानेन पूजयेत् ॥ 31 ॥
4.167.m: Having brought non-widowed women there and worshipped them, / having then circumambulated, he should worship with this mantra:

4.167.s:
āpākabrahmarūposi bhāṃḍānīmāni jaṃtavaḥ ..
pradānātte prajāpuṣṭiḥ svargaścāstu mamākṣayaḥ .. 32 ..
4.167.d:
आपाकब्रह्मरूपोसि भांडानीमानि जंतवः ॥
प्रदानात्ते प्रजापुष्टिः स्वर्गश्चास्तु ममाक्षयः ॥ 32 ॥
4.167.m: 'O kiln, you have the form of Brahman; these pots are living beings; / by your gift, may there be thriving of my offspring and imperishable heaven for me.

4.167.s:
bhāṃḍarūpāṇi yānyatra kalpitāni mayā kila ..
bhūtvā satpātrarūpāṇi upatiṣṭhaṃtu tāni me .. 33 .. iti dānamaṃtraḥ ..
4.167.d:
भांडरूपाणि यान्यत्र कल्पितानि मया किल ॥
भूत्वा सत्पात्ररूपाणि उपतिष्ठंतु तानि मे ॥ 33 ॥ इति दानमंत्रः ॥
4.167.m: Whatever forms of pots have indeed been fashioned here by me, / having become the forms of worthy recipients, may they attend upon me.' Thus is the donation mantra.

4.167.s:
yā ca yadbhāṃḍamādatte tasyaitaddāpayettataḥ ..
svecchayā caiva gṛhṇātu na nivāryāstu kāścana .. 34 ..
4.167.d:
या च यद्भांडमादत्ते तस्यैतद्दापयेत्ततः ॥
स्वेच्छया चैव गृह्णातु न निवार्यास्तु काश्चन ॥ 34 ॥
4.167.m: Whichever pot [a woman] takes, he should have that given to her; / let her take according to her wish, and none should be prevented.

4.167.s:
anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati ..
viśvakarmā bhavettuṣṭastasya janmatrayaṃ nṛpa .. 35 ..
4.167.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ॥
विश्वकर्मा भवेत्तुष्टस्तस्य जन्मत्रयं नृप ॥ 35 ॥
4.167.m: Whoever bestows this gift according to this rule, / Viśvakarman becomes pleased with him for three births, O king.

4.167.s:
nārī ca dattvā saubhāgyamatulaṃ pratipadyate ..
gṛhaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ bhṛtyamitrajanairvṛtam .. 36 ..
4.167.d:
नारी च दत्त्वा सौभाग्यमतुलं प्रतिपद्यते ॥
गृहं सर्वगुणोपेतं भृत्यमित्रजनैर्वृतम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.167.m: And a woman, having given it, attains matchless good fortune, / a house endowed with all virtues, surrounded by servants and friends,

4.167.s:
aviyogaṃ sadā bhartrā rūpaṃ cānuttamaṃ labhet ..
bhūdānametannirdiṣṭaṃ prakāreṇa tavānagha ..
bhidyate bahubhirbhedairbhūmireṣā nareśvara .. 37 ..
4.167.d:
अवियोगं सदा भर्त्रा रूपं चानुत्तमं लभेत् ॥
भूदानमेतन्निर्दिष्टं प्रकारेण तवानघ ॥
भिद्यते बहुभिर्भेदैर्भूमिरेषा नरेश्वर ॥ 37 ॥
4.167.m: Constant non-separation from her husband, and she obtains incomparable beauty. / This gift of earth has been described to you in detail, O sinless one; / this earth is divided into many varieties, O lord of men.

4.167.s:
niṣpādya bhāṃḍanicayoccataraṃ prayatnādāpākadānamiha yā kurute varastrī ..
sā putrapautrapaśuvṛddhimukhāni bhuktvā pretya svabhartṛsahitā sukhinī sadāste .. 38 .. ..
gṛhadānavidhivarṇanam
4.167.d:
निष्पाद्य भांडनिचयोच्चतरं प्रयत्नादापाकदानमिह या कुरुते वरस्त्री ॥
सा पुत्रपौत्रपशुवृद्धिमुखानि भुक्त्वा प्रेत्य स्वभर्तृसहिता सुखिनी सदास्ते ॥ 38 ॥ ॥
गृहदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.167.m:
Having carefully produced a very high heap of pots, whatever noble woman here makes the gift of a kiln, / she, having enjoyed the increase of sons, grandsons, and cattle, and [all] pleasures, after death dwells happy forever together with her husband.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of a House

4.168.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sarvaśāstrārthatattvajña jñānavijñānapāraga ..
gṛhadānasya māhātmyaṃ vidhiṃ vada vidāṃvara .. 1 ..
4.168.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञ ज्ञानविज्ञानपारग ॥
गृहदानस्य माहात्म्यं विधिं वद विदांवर ॥ 1 ॥
4.168.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / "O knower of the true meaning of all scriptures, who have crossed to the farther shore of knowledge and discernment, / tell the greatness and the rule of the gift of a house, O best of the wise!"

4.168.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
na gārhasthayātparo dharmo nāsti dānaṃ gṛhātparam ..
nānṛtādadhikaṃ pāpaṃ na pūjyo brāhmaṇātparaḥ .. 2 ..
4.168.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
न गार्हस्थयात्परो धर्मो नास्ति दानं गृहात्परम् ॥
नानृतादधिकं पापं न पूज्यो ब्राह्मणात्परः ॥ 2 ॥
4.168.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / "There is no duty higher than the householder's life; there is no gift higher than a house; / there is no sin greater than falsehood; there is none more venerable than a brāhmaṇa.

4.168.s: dhanadhānyasamāyuktaṃ kalatrāpatyasaṃkulam .. 3 ..
4.168.d: धनधान्यसमायुक्तं कलत्रापत्यसंकुलम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.168.m: Endowed with wealth and grain, filled with wife and offspring,

4.168.s:
gogajāśvagaṇākīrṇaṃ gṛhaṃ svargādviśiṣyate ..
yathā mātaramāśritya sarve jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ .. 4 ..
4.168.d:
गोगजाश्वगणाकीर्णं गृहं स्वर्गाद्विशिष्यते ॥
यथा मातरमाश्रित्य सर्वे जीवंति जंतवः ॥ 4 ॥
4.168.m: Abounding in herds of cows, elephants, and horses, a house is superior to heaven. / Just as all living creatures live relying upon their mother,

4.168.s:
evaṃ gṛhasthamāśritya vartayaṃtītarāśramāḥ ..
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mitrāṇi prathitaṃ yaśaḥ .. 5 ..
4.168.d:
एवं गृहस्थमाश्रित्य वर्तयंतीतराश्रमाः ॥
धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च मित्राणि प्रथितं यशः ॥ 5 ॥
4.168.m: So all the other stages of life subsist relying upon the householder. / Righteousness, wealth, pleasure, friends, and widespread renown—

4.168.s:
prāptakāmairnaraiḥ pārtha sadā sevyo gṛhāśramaḥ ..
na gṛheṇa vinā dharmo nārthakāmau sukhaṃ na ca .. 6 ..
4.168.d:
प्राप्तकामैर्नरैः पार्थ सदा सेव्यो गृहाश्रमः ॥
न गृहेण विना धर्मो नार्थकामौ सुखं न च ॥ 6 ॥
4.168.m: By men who desire to attain their goals, O son of Pṛthā, the householder's stage of life should always be pursued; / without a house there is no righteousness, nor wealth and pleasure, nor happiness,

4.168.s:
na loka paṃktirna yaśaḥ prāpyate tridaśairapi ..
na tatsvarge nāpavarge na tatkenopamīyate .. 7 ..
4.168.d:
न लोक पंक्तिर्न यशः प्राप्यते त्रिदशैरपि ॥
न तत्स्वर्गे नापवर्गे न तत्केनोपमीयते ॥ 7 ॥
4.168.m: Nor social status, nor fame, [such as cannot be] attained even by the thirty [gods]; / that is not in heaven, nor in liberation, nor can that be compared with anything.

4.168.s:
prasārya pādau yadrātrau svagṛhe svapatāṃ sukham ..
dināni nāsya gaṇyaṃte nainamāhurmahāśanam .. 8 ..
4.168.d:
प्रसार्य पादौ यद्रात्रौ स्वगृहे स्वपतां सुखम् ॥
दिनानि नास्य गण्यंते नैनमाहुर्महाशनम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.168.m: The pleasure of those who sleep at night in their own home, having stretched out their legs, / his days are not counted, nor do they call him a glutton.

4.168.s:
api śākaṃ pacānasya svagṛhe paramaṃ sukham ..
iti matvā mahārāja kārayitvā suśobhanam.. 9 ..
4.168.d:
अपि शाकं पचानस्य स्वगृहे परमं सुखम् ॥
इति मत्वा महाराज कारयित्वा सुशोभनम्॥ 9 ॥
4.168.m: Even cooking only greens in one's own house is supreme happiness. / Having reflected thus, O great king, having caused to be built a very handsome

4.168.s:
bhavanaṃ brāhmaṇe deyaṃ bhavyabhūtimabhīpsatā ..
kārayitvā dṛḍhastaṃbhaṃ śubhapakveṣṭakāmayam .. 4.168.10 ..
4.168.d:
भवनं ब्राह्मणे देयं भव्यभूतिमभीप्सता ॥
कारयित्वा दृढस्तंभं शुभपक्वेष्टकामयम् ॥ 4.168.10 ॥
4.168.m: Dwelling, it should be given to a brāhmaṇa by one who desires auspicious prosperity, / having caused firm pillars to be erected, constructed of fine fired bricks,

4.168.s:
śubhaṃ kamaṭhapṛṣṭhābhaṃ bhābhāsitadigaṃtaram ..
sudhānuliptaṃ guptaṃ ca sukhaśālāvirājitam .. 11 ..
4.168.d:
शुभं कमठपृष्ठाभं भाभासितदिगंतरम् ॥
सुधानुलिप्तं गुप्तं च सुखशालाविराजितम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.168.m: Auspicious, resembling the back of a tortoise, illuminating the ends of the directions with its radiance, / plastered with lime, well-sheltered, and adorned with comfortable halls."

4.168.s:
dadyādanaṃtaphaladaṃ śaivavaiṣṇavayoginām ..
pratiśraye tu vistīrṇe kārite sajale ghane .. 12 ..
4.168.d:
दद्यादनंतफलदं शैववैष्णवयोगिनाम् ॥
प्रतिश्रये तु विस्तीर्णे कारिते सजले घने ॥ 12 ॥
4.168.m: One should give [it] to Śaiva, Vaiṣṇava, and yoga practitioners, which yields infinite fruit. / Indeed, when an expansive, solid shelter equipped with water has been built,

4.168.s:
dīnānāthajalārthāya kṛtaṃ kiṃ na kṛtaṃ bhavet ..
kārayitvā gṛhānpaścādṛtvigrudrārkasaṃkhyayā .. 13 ..
4.168.d:
दीनानाथजलार्थाय कृतं किं न कृतं भवेत् ॥
कारयित्वा गृहान्पश्चादृत्विग्रुद्रार्कसंख्यया ॥ 13 ॥
4.168.m: what would not be accomplished when done for the poor, the helpless, and those in need of water? / Thereafter, having had houses constructed in the number of the ṛtvijs, the Rudras, or the Ādityas,

4.168.s:
kuḍhyastaṃbhagavākṣāḍhayānvicitrānbahubhūmikān..
saprākārapratolīkānkapāṭārgalayaṃtritān .. 14 ..
4.168.d:
कुढ्यस्तंभगवाक्षाढयान्विचित्रान्बहुभूमिकान्॥
सप्राकारप्रतोलीकान्कपाटार्गलयंत्रितान् ॥ 14 ॥
4.168.m: rich in walls, pillars, and lattice windows, multi-storied and diverse, / with enclosing walls and gateways, secured with doors and crossbars,

4.168.s:
sudhādhavalitānramyānvistīrṇāṃgaṇavāṭikān ..
praveśanirgamayutānsamāsannajalāśayān.. 15 ..
4.168.d:
सुधाधवलितान्रम्यान्विस्तीर्णांगणवाटिकान् ॥
प्रवेशनिर्गमयुतान्समासन्नजलाशयान्॥ 15 ॥
4.168.m: whitewashed with lime, lovely, with spacious courtyards and gardens, / provided with entrances and exits, situated close to reservoirs of water,

4.168.s:
lohopaskarasaṃpūrṇāṃstā mropaskarasaṃyutān ..
svarṇopaskaraśobhāḍhyānraupyopaskarasaṃkulān .. 16 ..
4.168.d:
लोहोपस्करसंपूर्णांस्ता म्रोपस्करसंयुतान् ॥
स्वर्णोपस्करशोभाढ्यान्रौप्योपस्करसंकुलान् ॥ 16 ॥
4.168.m: filled with iron utensils, furnished with copper utensils, / rich in the beauty of gold utensils, crowded with silver utensils,

4.168.s:
ratnopaskarasaṃyuktānkāṃsyopaskaramaṃḍitān ..
ārakūṭatrapusīsadā nopaskaravarjitān .. 17 ..
4.168.d:
रत्नोपस्करसंयुक्तान्कांस्योपस्करमंडितान् ॥
आरकूटत्रपुसीसदा नोपस्करवर्जितान् ॥ 17 ॥
4.168.m: equipped with gemstone utensils, adorned with bronze utensils, / supplied with utensils of brass, tin, and lead given [as gifts],

4.168.s:
vaṃśopaskarasaṃkīrṇānkāṣṭhopaskara bṛṃhitān ..
mṛnmayopaskarākīrṇānvastropakaraṇānvitān .. 18 ..
4.168.d:
वंशोपस्करसंकीर्णान्काष्ठोपस्कर बृंहितान् ॥
मृन्मयोपस्कराकीर्णान्वस्त्रोपकरणान्वितान् ॥ 18 ॥
4.168.m: strewn with bamboo utensils, magnified with wooden utensils, / crowded with earthen utensils, equipped with cloth implements,

4.168.s:
dharmopaskarasaṃbhāraśaṇavalkalarājitān ..
rājitāṃstṛṇapāṣāṇaiḥ sarvopaskarabhūṣitān .. 19 ..
4.168.d:
धर्मोपस्करसंभारशणवल्कलराजितान् ॥
राजितांस्तृणपाषाणैः सर्वोपस्करभूषितान् ॥ 19 ॥
4.168.m: radiant with bark and hemp fabrics, collections of implements for religious duty, / beautified with thatch and stones, adorned with all kinds of domestic articles,

4.168.s:
saptadhātumayaṃ bhāṃḍaṃ yattadratnasamudbhavam ..
carmakāṣṭhamahābhāṃḍaṃ navavastumayaṃ tathā .. 4.168.20 ..
4.168.d:
सप्तधातुमयं भांडं यत्तद्रत्नसमुद्भवम् ॥
चर्मकाष्ठमहाभांडं नववस्तुमयं तथा ॥ 4.168.20 ॥
4.168.m: vessels made of the seven metals, those made of precious stones, / large vessels of leather and wood, and likewise those made of new textiles,

4.168.s:
gomahiṣyaśvavṛṣabhapreṣyaveśyāgaṇānvitān ..
kṣetrārāmajalāsannānkāmyānharmyavarāñchubhān .. 21 ..
4.168.d:
गोमहिष्यश्ववृषभप्रेष्यवेश्यागणान्वितान् ॥
क्षेत्रारामजलासन्नान्काम्यान्हर्म्यवराञ्छुभान् ॥ 21 ॥
4.168.m: accompanied by cattle, buffalo cows, horses, bulls, servants, and troupes of courtesans, / situated near fields, orchards, and water, charming, auspicious, excellent mansions,

4.168.s:
saṃpūrṇānsarvadhānyaistu ghṛtatailaguḍādibhiḥ ..
tilataṃdulaśālīkṣumudgagodhūmasarṣapaiḥ .. 22 ..
4.168.d:
संपूर्णान्सर्वधान्यैस्तु घृततैलगुडादिभिः ॥
तिलतंदुलशालीक्षुमुद्गगोधूमसर्षपैः ॥ 22 ॥
4.168.m: filled with all types of grain, with ghee, oil, jaggery, and the like, / with sesame, husked rice, śāli-rice, sugarcane, mung beans, wheat, and mustard seeds,

4.168.s:
niṣpāvāḍhakyacaṇakakulatthāṇumasūrakaiḥ ..
kaṃgumāṣayavādyāḍhyāñchākavṛṃtākapūritān .. 23 ..
4.168.d:
निष्पावाढक्यचणककुलत्थाणुमसूरकैः ॥
कंगुमाषयवाद्याढ्याञ्छाकवृंताकपूरितान् ॥ 23 ॥
4.168.m: with niṣpāva-beans, pigeon peas, chickpeas, horse gram, aṇu-grain, and lentils, / rich in foxtail millet, black gram, barley, and the like, filled with vegetables and eggplants,

4.168.s:
lavaṇārdrakakharjūradrākṣājīrakadhānyakaiḥ ..
hiṃgukuṃkumakarpūrasnānadravyaiḥ sacaṃdanaiḥ .. 24 ..
4.168.d:
लवणार्द्रकखर्जूरद्राक्षाजीरकधान्यकैः ॥
हिंगुकुंकुमकर्पूरस्नानद्रव्यैः सचंदनैः ॥ 24 ॥
4.168.m: with salt, ginger, dates, grapes, cumin, and coriander, / with asafoetida, saffron, camphor, bathing ingredients, and sandalwood,

4.168.s:
dhūpopaskaraparyuptatūlīgaṇḍopadhānakaiḥ ..
cullīcchedanamaṃthānabhadrāsanakagucchakaiḥ .. 25 ..
4.168.d:
धूपोपस्करपर्युप्ततूलीगण्डोपधानकैः ॥
चुल्लीच्छेदनमंथानभद्रासनकगुच्छकैः ॥ 25 ॥
4.168.m: strewn with incenses and utensils, with quilts and bolsters, / hearths, cutting boards, churning sticks, auspicious stools, and bunches [of brooms],

4.168.s:
piṭharolūkhalasthālīśūrpadarpaṇapatrakaiḥ ..
muśalāsikṛpāṇīṣudaṃḍakodaṃḍamudgaraiḥ .. 26 ..
4.168.d:
पिठरोलूखलस्थालीशूर्पदर्पणपत्रकैः ॥
मुशलासिकृपाणीषुदंडकोदंडमुद्गरैः ॥ 26 ॥
4.168.m: pots, mortars, cooking vessels, winnowing baskets, mirrors, and plates, / pestles, swords, daggers, arrows, staves, bows, and mallets,

4.168.s:
gṛhāṭavāṭakādarvīdṛṣalloṣṭakahastakaiḥ ..
cātrakāṃśukalohādi dīptamaṃthanikādibhiḥ ..27..
4.168.d:
गृहाटवाटकादर्वीदृषल्लोष्टकहस्तकैः ॥
चात्रकांशुकलोहादि दीप्तमंथनिकादिभिः ॥27॥
4.168.m: household implements, ladles, grindstones, clods, pestles, / umbrellas, clothes, ironware, and shining churning vessels and the like,

4.168.s:
kaṃḍaṇī peṣaṇī cullī udakumbhī pramārjanī ..
maṃjūṣākoṣṭhakāsaṃdī kaṃbalaistanurāṃkavaiḥ .. 28 ..
4.168.d:
कंडणी पेषणी चुल्ली उदकुम्भी प्रमार्जनी ॥
मंजूषाकोष्ठकासंदी कंबलैस्तनुरांकवैः ॥ 28 ॥
4.168.m: threshing troughs, grinding stones, stoves, water pitchers, brooms, / chests, storage bins, stools, blankets, and fine woolen rugs,

4.168.s:
ityevamādibhiḥ pūrṇāngṛhāndadyāddvijātiṣu ..
kartuścaṃdrabalopete sthiranakṣatrasaṃyute .. 29 ..
4.168.d:
इत्येवमादिभिः पूर्णान्गृहान्दद्याद्द्विजातिषु ॥
कर्तुश्चंद्रबलोपेते स्थिरनक्षत्रसंयुते ॥ 29 ॥
4.168.m: one should give houses filled with these and other [articles] to twice-born men. / When the donor possesses the strength of the moon, under a fixed lunar mansion,

4.168.s:
śubhe'hni viprakathite dānakālaḥ praśasyate ..
evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro yajamānaḥ svayaṃ dvijān .. 4.168.30 ..
4.168.d:
शुभेऽह्नि विप्रकथिते दानकालः प्रशस्यते ॥
एवं संभृतसंभारो यजमानः स्वयं द्विजान् ॥ 4.168.30 ॥
4.168.m: on an auspicious day declared by a brāhmaṇa, the time of giving is praised. / Thus having gathered the provisions, the patron himself [should invite] the twice-born

4.168.s:
kulaśīlasamāyuktāngṛhasaṃkhyānnimaṃtrayet ..
adhītavedāñchāstrajñānpurāṇasmṛtipāragān .. 31 ..
4.168.d:
कुलशीलसमायुक्तान्गृहसंख्यान्निमंत्रयेत् ॥
अधीतवेदाञ्छास्त्रज्ञान्पुराणस्मृतिपारगान् ॥ 31 ॥
4.168.m: endowed with noble family and character, matching the number of houses, / who have studied the Vedas, know the treatises, and are well-versed in the Purāṇas and Smṛtis,

4.168.s:
gṛhasthadharmaniratāñchāṃtāndāṃtāñjiteṃdriyān ..
alaṃkṛtya sapatnīkānvāsobhiratha pūjayet .. 32 ..
4.168.d:
गृहस्थधर्मनिरताञ्छांतान्दांताञ्जितेंद्रियान् ॥
अलंकृत्य सपत्नीकान्वासोभिरथ पूजयेत् ॥ 32 ॥
4.168.m: devoted to the duties of householders, peaceful, self-controlled, with senses subdued. / Then, having adorned them together with their wives, he should worship them with garments.

4.168.s:
sugaṃdhisragdharānkṛtvā śāṃtikarmaṇi yojayet ..
gṛhāṃgaṇe kārayitvā kuṃḍamekaṃ samekhalam .. 33 ..
4.168.d:
सुगंधिस्रग्धरान्कृत्वा शांतिकर्मणि योजयेत् ॥
गृहांगणे कारयित्वा कुंडमेकं समेखलम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.168.m: Making them wear fragrant garlands, he should employ them in a pacification rite. / Having made a single sacrificial pit with a girdle in the courtyard of the house,

4.168.s:
grahayajñaḥ prakartavyastuṣṭipuṣṭikaraḥ sadā ..
rākṣoghnāni ca sūktāni paṭheyurbrāhmaṇāstataḥ .. 34 ..
4.168.d:
ग्रहयज्ञः प्रकर्तव्यस्तुष्टिपुष्टिकरः सदा ॥
राक्षोघ्नानि च सूक्तानि पठेयुर्ब्राह्मणास्ततः ॥ 34 ॥
4.168.m: a sacrifice to the planets should be performed, which always brings contentment and nourishment. / Then the brāhmaṇas should recite the demon-slaying hymns.

4.168.s:
vāstupūjā prakartavyā dikṣu bhūtabaliṃ kṣipet ..
tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣeṇa brāhmaṇāṃsteṣu veśmasu .. 35..
4.168.d:
वास्तुपूजा प्रकर्तव्या दिक्षु भूतबलिं क्षिपेत् ॥
ततः पुण्याहघोषेण ब्राह्मणांस्तेषु वेश्मसु ॥ 35॥
4.168.m: A worship of the site must be performed, and one should scatter offerings to the spirits in all directions. / Then, amidst the proclamation of an auspicious day, the brāhmaṇas [are led] into those dwellings;

4.168.s:
praveśayitvā śayyāsu sabhāryānupaveśayet ..
yajamānastataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ .. 36 ..
4.168.d:
प्रवेशयित्वा शय्यासु सभार्यानुपवेशयेत् ॥
यजमानस्ततः प्राज्ञः शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः ॥ 36 ॥
4.168.m: having led them in, he should seat them along with their wives upon the couches. / Then the wise patron, wearing white garments, pure,

4.168.s:
yadyasya vihitaṃ pūrvaṃ tattasya pratipādayet ..
idaṃ gṛhaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam .. 37 ..
4.168.d:
यद्यस्य विहितं पूर्वं तत्तस्य प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
इदं गृहं गृहाण त्वं सर्वोपस्करसंयुतम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.168.m: should bestow upon each what was previously assigned to him: / ‘Accept this house, supplied with all domestic articles.

4.168.s:
tava vipra prasādena mamāstvabhimataṃ phalam ..
evamekaikaśo dattvā praṇipatya kṣamāpayet .. 38 ...
4.168.d:
तव विप्र प्रसादेन ममास्त्वभिमतं फलम् ॥
एवमेकैकशो दत्त्वा प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ॥ 38 ॥।
4.168.m: By your grace, O brāhmaṇa, may I attain my desired fruit.’ / Having given thus one by one, he should prostrate himself and ask for forgiveness.

4.168.s:
svastīti brāhmaṇairvācyaṃ kodāditi ca pūjitaiḥ ..
gṛhopakaraṇaistulyā dakṣiṇā bhavanaṃ vinā .. 39 ..
4.168.d:
स्वस्तीति ब्राह्मणैर्वाच्यं कोदादिति च पूजितैः ॥
गृहोपकरणैस्तुल्या दक्षिणा भवनं विना ॥ 39 ॥
4.168.m: ‘May it be well!’ and ‘Who has given?’ is to be spoken by the honoured brāhmaṇas. / An honorarium equal to the household implements, excluding the house itself, [should be given].

4.168.s:
upadeṣṭāramāpṛcchettanmūlatvānmaharṣayaḥ ..
svayaṃ tānpūjayitvā tu tataḥ svabhavanaṃ vrajet .. 4.168.40 ..
4.168.d:
उपदेष्टारमापृच्छेत्तन्मूलत्वान्महर्षयः ॥
स्वयं तान्पूजयित्वा तु ततः स्वभवनं व्रजेत् ॥ 4.168.40 ॥
4.168.m: He should take leave of the preceptor, since the great ṛṣis are the root of that. / Having worshipped them himself, he may then go to his own abode.

4.168.s:
dadyādanena vidhinā gṛhamekaṃ bahūnapi ..
na saṃkhyāniyamaḥ kāryaḥ śaktiratra niyāmikā .. 41 ..
4.168.d:
दद्यादनेन विधिना गृहमेकं बहूनपि ॥
न संख्यानियमः कार्यः शक्तिरत्र नियामिका ॥ 41 ॥
4.168.m: According to this procedure, one should give one house, or even many; / no fixed rule of number is to be made—one's capacity is the determinant here.

4.168.s:
śītavātātapaharaṃ dattvā tṛṇakuṭīrakam ..
iṣṭānkāmānavāpnoti pretya svarge mahīyate .. 42 ..
4.168.d:
शीतवातातपहरं दत्त्वा तृणकुटीरकम् ॥
इष्टान्कामानवाप्नोति प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते ॥ 42 ॥
4.168.m: Having given a thatched hut that removes cold, wind, and heat, / one attains desired pleasures and is glorified in heaven after death.

4.168.s:
kiṃ punarbahunoktena sarvopaskarabhūṣitām ..
atyaṃtasukhalubdhena dattvā brahmapurīṃ priyām .. 43 ..
4.168.d:
किं पुनर्बहुनोक्तेन सर्वोपस्करभूषिताम् ॥
अत्यंतसुखलुब्धेन दत्त्वा ब्रह्मपुरीं प्रियाम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.168.m: What more need be said about giving a beloved Brāhmaṇa settlement, / adorned with all domestic articles, by one yearning for supreme bliss?

4.168.s:
gobhūhiraṇyadānāni yamāḥ saniyamāstathā ..
gṛhadānasya kauṃteya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm .. 44 ..
4.168.d:
गोभूहिरण्यदानानि यमाः सनियमास्तथा ॥
गृहदानस्य कौंतेय कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.168.m: Gifts of cattle, land, and gold, as well as moral restraints along with their observances, / do not equal a sixteenth part of the gift of a house, O son of Kuntī.

4.168.s:
yaḥ kārayetsudṛḍhaharmyavatī mahārhā satsevitāṃ dvijapurīṃ sujanopabhogyām ..
divyāpsarobhirabhi naṃditacittavṛttiḥ prāpnotyasāvanavamaṃ padamiṃdumauleḥ .. 45 ..
annadānamāhātmyavarṇanam
4.168.d:
यः कारयेत्सुदृढहर्म्यवती महार्हा सत्सेवितां द्विजपुरीं सुजनोपभोग्याम् ॥
दिव्याप्सरोभिरभि नंदितचित्तवृत्तिः प्राप्नोत्यसावनवमं पदमिंदुमौलेः ॥ 45 ॥
अन्नदानमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
4.168.m:
He who constructs an invaluable brāhmaṇa settlement possessed of sturdy mansions, attended by the virtuous, and enjoyable to good people, / his mind's disposition rejoiced by celestial apsarases, attains the supreme abode of the Moon-crested Lord.
Description of the Majesty of Giving Food

4.169.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
annadānasya māhātmyaṃ kathayāmi tavānagha ..
yatproktamṛṣibhiḥ pūrvaṃ tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu .. 1 ..
4.169.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अन्नदानस्य माहात्म्यं कथयामि तवानघ ॥
यत्प्रोक्तमृषिभिः पूर्वं तदिहैकमनाः शृणु ॥ 1 ॥
4.169.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall describe to you the majesty of giving food, O sinless one, / which was declared by the ṛṣis of old; hear that here with single-minded focus.

4.169.s:
dadasvānnaṃ dadasvānnaṃ dadasvānnaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
sadyastuṣṭikaraṃ loke kiṃ dattena pareṇa te ..2..
4.169.d:
ददस्वान्नं ददस्वान्नं ददस्वान्नं युधिष्ठिर ॥
सद्यस्तुष्टिकरं लोके किं दत्तेन परेण ते ॥2॥
4.169.m: Give food, give food, give food, O Yudhiṣṭhira! / It brings immediate contentment in the world; what use to you is anything else that is given?

4.169.s:
rāmeṇa daśarathinā vanasthena nijānujaḥ ..
nirvedādyatpurā proktastadahaṃ prabravīmi te .. 3 ..
4.169.d:
रामेण दशरथिना वनस्थेन निजानुजः ॥
निर्वेदाद्यत्पुरा प्रोक्तस्तदहं प्रब्रवीमि ते ॥ 3 ॥
4.169.m: What was spoken of old out of despondency by Rāma, son of Daśaratha, / to his younger brother while dwelling in the forest, that I tell you:

4.169.s:
pṛthivyāmannapūrṇāyāṃ vayamannasya kāṃkṣiṇaḥ ..
saumitre nūnamasmābhirna brāhmaṇamukhe hutam .. 4 ..
4.169.d:
पृथिव्यामन्नपूर्णायां वयमन्नस्य कांक्षिणः ॥
सौमित्रे नूनमस्माभिर्न ब्राह्मणमुखे हुतम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.169.m: ‘Though the earth is full of food, we are longing for food; / surely, O son of Sumitrā, no oblation was cast into the mouth of a brāhmaṇa by us.

4.169.s:
yaducyate karmabījaṃ tasyāvaśyaṃ phalaṃ naraiḥ ..
prāpyate lakṣmaṇāsmābhirnānnaṃ vipramukhe hutam .. 5 ..
4.169.d:
यदुच्यते कर्मबीजं तस्यावश्यं फलं नरैः ॥
प्राप्यते लक्ष्मणास्माभिर्नान्नं विप्रमुखे हुतम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.169.m: Whatever is called the seed of an action, its fruit is inevitably / obtained by mortals, O Lakṣmaṇa; food was not offered by us into the mouth of a twice-born.

4.169.s:
yatra prāpyaṃ tadaprāpyaṃ vidyayā pauruṣeṇa vā ..
satyo lokapravādo'yaṃ nādattamupatiṣṭhati .. 6 ..
4.169.d:
यत्र प्राप्यं तदप्राप्यं विद्यया पौरुषेण वा ॥
सत्यो लोकप्रवादोऽयं नादत्तमुपतिष्ठति ॥ 6 ॥
4.169.m: Where it is to be attained, it cannot be attained [otherwise] by learning or by manly effort. / True is this common saying: “What was not given does not present itself.”’

4.169.s: bhakṣopayogādannasya dānaṃ śreyaskaraṃ param .. 7 ..
4.169.d: भक्षोपयोगादन्नस्य दानं श्रेयस्करं परम् ॥ 7 ॥
