At a vyatīpāta, at a solstice, at a full moon in Kārttika, and likewise at an equinox,

4.175.s:
candrasūryagrahe yadvā māghyāṃ vā nṛpasattama ..
janmarkṣe grahapīḍāsu tathā duḥsvapnadarśane .. 26 ..
4.175.d:
चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे यद्वा माघ्यां वा नृपसत्तम ॥
जन्मर्क्षे ग्रहपीडासु तथा दुःस्वप्नदर्शने ॥ 26 ॥
4.175.m:
or at an eclipse of the moon or sun, or at a full moon in Māgha, O best of kings,
on one's birth-star, amidst afflictions by planets, and likewise upon seeing bad dreams,

4.175.s:
yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ tadā deyamidaṃ bhavet ..
anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmādvapuścātīva cañcalam .. 27 ..
4.175.d:
यदा वा जायते वित्तं तदा देयमिदं भवेत् ॥
अनित्यं जीवितं यस्माद्वपुश्चातीव चञ्चलम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.175.m:
or whenever wealth is gained, this should be given at that time.
Because life is impermanent and the body is exceedingly fickle,

4.175.s:
keśeṣu ca gṛhītaḥ sanmṛtyunā dharmamācaret ..
tasmādyadaiva jāyeta śraddhā dānaṃ prati prabho .. 28 ..
4.175.d:
केशेषु च गृहीतः सन्मृत्युना धर्ममाचरेत् ॥
तस्माद्यदैव जायेत श्रद्धा दानं प्रति प्रभो ॥ 28 ॥
4.175.m:
one should practice righteousness as if seized by the hair by death.
Therefore, whenever faith arises toward giving, O lord,

4.175.s:
tadaiva dānakālaḥ syātkāraṇaṃ hi yato mama ..
tīrthe vāyatane goṣṭheṣvatha vā bhava nāṃgaṇe ..
maṇḍapaṃ kārayedvidvāṃścaturbhadrānanaṃ budhaḥ .. 29 ..
4.175.d:
तदैव दानकालः स्यात्कारणं हि यतो मम ॥
तीर्थे वायतने गोष्ठेष्वथ वा भव नांगणे ॥
मण्डपं कारयेद्विद्वांश्चतुर्भद्राननं बुधः ॥ 29 ॥
4.175.m:
at that very time is the moment for giving, for that is my reason.
At a sacred bath, or in a temple, or in cowpens, or in the courtyard of a house,
the wise scholar should have a pavilion built with four auspicious entrances,

4.175.s:
ārdraśākhānvitaṃ divyaṃ prāgudakpravaṇaṃ dṛḍham ..
ṣoḍaśāratnimātraṃ ca patākābhiralaṃkṛ tam .. 30 ..
4.175.d:
आर्द्रशाखान्वितं दिव्यं प्रागुदक्प्रवणं दृढम् ॥
षोडशारत्निमात्रं च पताकाभिरलंकृ तम् ॥ 30 ॥
4.175.m:
furnished with fresh branches, divine, sloping to the northeast, strong,
measuring sixteen cubits, and decorated with banners.

4.175.s:
tanmadhye kārayedvediṃ hastamātrocchritāṃ śubhām ..
caturasrāṃ samaṃtācca saptahastāṃ suśobhanām .. 31 ..
4.175.d:
तन्मध्ये कारयेद्वेदिं हस्तमात्रोच्छ्रितां शुभाम् ॥
चतुरस्रां समंताच्च सप्तहस्तां सुशोभनाम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.175.m:
In its middle he should cause an auspicious altar to be made, elevated by one cubit,
four-sided all around, seven cubits [wide], and exceedingly beautiful.

4.175.s:
tasyā madhye tulāṃ divyāṃ sthāpa yedvidhipūrvakam ..
hastadvayaṃ ca nikhaneccaturhastocchritāṃ budhaḥ ..32..
4.175.d:
तस्या मध्ये तुलां दिव्यां स्थाप येद्विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
हस्तद्वयं च निखनेच्चतुर्हस्तोच्छ्रितां बुधः ॥32॥
4.175.m:
In its middle the wise man should establish a divine balance according to rule,
and he should dig down two cubits [and erect it] four cubits high.

4.175.s:
staṃbhadvayaṃ mahārāja sthāpayetsudṛḍhaṃ navam ..
caṃdanaḥ khadiro bilvaḥ śākaścaiveṃguda stathā ..33..
4.175.d:
स्तंभद्वयं महाराज स्थापयेत्सुदृढं नवम् ॥
चंदनः खदिरो बिल्वः शाकश्चैवेंगुद स्तथा ॥33॥
4.175.m:
He should establish two very firm, new pillars, O great king:
sandalwood, khadira, bilva, teak, and likewise inguda,

4.175.s: tiṃduko devadāruśca śrīparṇaścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ ..34..
4.175.d: तिंदुको देवदारुश्च श्रीपर्णश्चाष्टमः स्मृतः ॥34॥
4.175.m: tinduka, devadāru, and śrīparṇa is remembered as the eighth.

4.175.s:
ityaṣṭau vṛkṣajātīyāḥ staṃbhāste parikīrtitāḥ ..
anyathāpi bhavedvṛkṣaḥ sārajño yājñikastathā..35..
4.175.d:
इत्यष्टौ वृक्षजातीयाः स्तंभास्ते परिकीर्तिताः ॥
अन्यथापि भवेद्वृक्षः सारज्ञो याज्ञिकस्तथा॥35॥
4.175.m:
Thus the eight species of trees have been proclaimed to you for the pillars.
Otherwise, any tree may be used, known by the sacrificial experts to have solid heartwood.

4.175.s:
suniścalaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tiryakkāṣṭhamathopari..
nyasettadvṛkṣajātīyaṃ caturhastaṃ pramāṇataḥ ..36..
4.175.d:
सुनिश्चलं ततः कृत्वा तिर्यक्काष्ठमथोपरि॥
न्यसेत्तद्वृक्षजातीयं चतुर्हस्तं प्रमाणतः ॥36॥
4.175.m:
Then, having made it completely motionless, he should place a crossbeam above,
of the same tree species, four cubits in measure.

4.175.s:
samānajātiṃ tu tulāṃ tanmadhye yojayeddṛḍham..
ṣaṇṇavatyaṃgulā divyā samagrā lohapāśikā .. 37 ..
4.175.d:
समानजातिं तु तुलां तन्मध्ये योजयेद्दृढम्॥
षण्णवत्यंगुला दिव्या समग्रा लोहपाशिका ॥ 37 ॥
4.175.m:
And in its middle he should firmly join a balance of the same species,
ninety-six inches [long], divine, complete, with iron loops,

4.175.s:
kṛṣṇalohamayau tasyāṃ karṇau cāpi prakalpayet ..
tulāpuruṣasaṃjñastu madhye kāryaḥ pumānbha vet .. 38 ..
4.175.d:
कृष्णलोहमयौ तस्यां कर्णौ चापि प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
तुलापुरुषसंज्ञस्तु मध्ये कार्यः पुमान्भ वेत् ॥ 38 ॥
4.175.m:
and he should make two hooks upon it consisting of black iron.
In the middle a human figure should be made, designated the man-balance.

4.175.s:
evaṃvidhāṃ tulāṃ kṛtvā nānāratnairvibhūṣitām..
caṃdanenānuliptāṃgīṃ vastrālaṃkāravigrahām .. 39 ..
4.175.d:
एवंविधां तुलां कृत्वा नानारत्नैर्विभूषिताम्॥
चंदनेनानुलिप्तांगीं वस्त्रालंकारविग्रहाम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.175.m:
Having made such a balance adorned with various gems,
its limbs smeared with sandalwood, its form [adorned with] garments and ornaments,

4.175.s:
staṃbhau ca vastrasaṃyuktau puṣpamālāva laṃbinau ..
caṃdanenānuliptāṃgau nānātnairalaṃkṛtau .. 40 ..
4.175.d:
स्तंभौ च वस्त्रसंयुक्तौ पुष्पमालाव लंबिनौ ॥
चंदनेनानुलिप्तांगौ नानात्नैरलंकृतौ ॥ 40 ॥
4.175.m:
and the two pillars covered with cloth, suspended with garlands of flowers,
their limbs smeared with sandalwood, and adorned with various gems,

4.175.s:
kuṇḍāni cātra catvāri yoniyuktāni kārayet ..
hastamātrapramāṇāni mekhalātrayavaṃti ca .. 41 ..
4.175.d:
कुण्डानि चात्र चत्वारि योनियुक्तानि कारयेत् ॥
हस्तमात्रप्रमाणानि मेखलात्रयवंति च ॥ 41 ॥
4.175.m:
he should also make here four sacrificial pits furnished with a vulva-crescent,
measuring one cubit in size and possessing three steps.

4.175.s:
pūrvottare hastamitā vediḥ kāryā suśobhanā ..
lokapālagrahāṇāṃ ca pūjā tatra vidhīyate .. 42 ..
4.175.d:
पूर्वोत्तरे हस्तमिता वेदिः कार्या सुशोभना ॥
लोकपालग्रहाणां च पूजा तत्र विधीयते ॥ 42 ॥
4.175.m:
In the northeast, a very handsome altar measuring one cubit is to be made;
and worship of the world protectors and the planets is prescribed there.

4.175.s:
arcārcanaṃ ca tatraiva viriṃcyacyutayo rnṛpa ..
śaṃkarasya bhavetkāryaṃ mālyavastraphalākṣataiḥ .. 43 ..
4.175.d:
अर्चार्चनं च तत्रैव विरिंच्यच्युतयो र्नृप ॥
शंकरस्य भवेत्कार्यं माल्यवस्त्रफलाक्षतैः ॥ 43 ॥
4.175.m:
And right there worship of the images of Brahmā and Acyuta,
[and] of Śaṅkara should be performed, O king, with garlands, cloths, fruits, and unhusked barley.

4.175.s:
toraṇāni ca kāryāṇi kṣīravṛkṣodbhavāni ca ..
caturdvāreṣu saṃsthāpyāḥ kumbhāḥ srakpalla vānanāḥ .. 44 ..
4.175.d:
तोरणानि च कार्याणि क्षीरवृक्षोद्भवानि च ॥
चतुर्द्वारेषु संस्थाप्याः कुम्भाः स्रक्पल्ल वाननाः ॥ 44 ॥
4.175.m:
And arches should be made originating from trees with milky sap;
at the four doors, water jars with mouths of garlands and shoots should be set up,

4.175.s:
paṃcaratnasamāyuktāḥ saptadhānyoparisthitāḥ ..
ṛgvedapāṭhakau dvau ca pūrvakuṇḍe niyojayet .. 45 ..
4.175.d:
पंचरत्नसमायुक्ताः सप्तधान्योपरिस्थिताः ॥
ऋग्वेदपाठकौ द्वौ च पूर्वकुण्डे नियोजयेत् ॥ 45 ॥
4.175.m:
furnished with five gems and resting on seven grains.
And he should appoint two reciters of the Ṛgveda at the eastern sacrificial pit,

4.175.s:
yajurvedavidau yāmye paścime sāmavedinau ..
atharvaṇāvuttarato navamo dharmadeśakaḥ ..46..
4.175.d:
यजुर्वेदविदौ याम्ये पश्चिमे सामवेदिनौ ॥
अथर्वणावुत्तरतो नवमो धर्मदेशकः ॥46॥
4.175.m:
two knowers of the Yajurveda at the southern, two Sāmaveda chanters at the western,
two Atharvavedins at the northern, and a teacher of sacred duty as the ninth.

4.175.s:
atraiva kecidicchaṃti ṛṣayaḥ ṣoḍaśartvijaḥ ..
tāmrapātradvayaṃ deyamekaikasmai tathāsanam .. ..47..
4.175.d:
अत्रैव केचिदिच्छंति ऋषयः षोडशर्त्विजः ॥
ताम्रपात्रद्वयं देयमेकैकस्मै तथासनम् ॥ ॥47॥
4.175.m:
Here indeed some sages desire sixteen priests;
two copper vessels should be given to each, as well as a seat.

4.175.s:
homadravyāṇi sarvāṇi tilājyaṃ samidhastathā..
sruvāḥ srucaśca śastrāṇi viṣṭaraḥ kusumāni ca ..48..
4.175.d:
होमद्रव्याणि सर्वाणि तिलाज्यं समिधस्तथा॥
स्रुवाः स्रुचश्च शस्त्राणि विष्टरः कुसुमानि च ॥48॥
4.175.m:
All the sacrificial substances: sesame, clarified butter, and fire-sticks,
ladles and spoons, sacrificial knives, grass-cushions, and flowers;

4.175.s:
lokapālāḥ suvarṇāstu patākāḥ paritaḥ śubhāḥ ..
mahādhvajaṃ ca badhnīyātpaṃcavarṇaṃ vitānakam .. 49 ..
4.175.d:
लोकपालाः सुवर्णास्तु पताकाः परितः शुभाः ॥
महाध्वजं च बध्नीयात्पंचवर्णं वितानकम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.175.m:
the world protectors [made of] gold, and auspicious banners all around;
and he should tie a great banner and a five-coloured canopy.

4.175.s:
etatsarvaṃ samāhṛtya puṇye'hani vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
varddhakirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ sarvaśilpaviśā radaḥ .. 50 ..
4.175.d:
एतत्सर्वं समाहृत्य पुण्येऽहनि विचक्षणः ॥
वर्द्धकिर्ब्राह्मणैः सार्द्धं सर्वशिल्पविशा रदः ॥ 50 ॥
4.175.m:
Having gathered all this on an auspicious day, the discerning
carpenter, together with the brahmins, skilled in all crafts,

4.175.s:
saṃpūrṇaṃ yajamānāya darśayedyajñamaṃḍapam ..
yajamānastataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ .. 51 ..
4.175.d:
संपूर्णं यजमानाय दर्शयेद्यज्ञमंडपम् ॥
यजमानस्ततः प्राज्ञः शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः ॥ 51 ॥
4.175.m:
should show the complete sacrificial pavilion to the patron.
Then the wise patron, wearing white garments, pure,

4.175.s:
śaṃkhatūryaninādena vedadhvaniraveṇa ca ..
prakṣipellokapālānāmebhirmaṃtraiḥ śubhairbalim .. 52 ..
4.175.d:
शंखतूर्यनिनादेन वेदध्वनिरवेण च ॥
प्रक्षिपेल्लोकपालानामेभिर्मंत्रैः शुभैर्बलिम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.175.m:
amidst the sounding of conches and trumpets and the chanting of Vedic sounds,
should throw an offering for the world protectors with these auspicious mantras:

4.175.s:
ehyehi sarvāmarasiddhasādhyairabhiṣṭuto vajradharāmareśa ..
saṃvījyamānopsarasāṃ gaṇena rakṣādhvaraṃ no bhagavannamaste .. 53 ..
4.175.d:
एह्येहि सर्वामरसिद्धसाध्यैरभिष्टुतो वज्रधरामरेश ॥
संवीज्यमानोप्सरसां गणेन रक्षाध्वरं नो भगवन्नमस्ते ॥ 53 ॥
4.175.m:
"Come, come, praised by all immortals, siddhas, and sādhyas, O vajra-wielder, lord of the immortals!
Fanned by a host of apsarases, protect our sacrifice, O Lord; homage to you!"

4.175.s:
( oṃ iṃdrāya namaḥ) ..
ehyehi sarvāmarahavyavāha munipravīrerabhihṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..
tejovatā lokagaṇena sārddhaṃ mamādhvaraṃ rakṣa kave namaste ..54..
4.175.d:
( ओं इंद्राय नमः) ॥
एह्येहि सर्वामरहव्यवाह मुनिप्रवीरेरभिहृष्टमानसः ॥
तेजोवता लोकगणेन सार्द्धं ममाध्वरं रक्ष कवे नमस्ते ॥54॥
4.175.m:
(Oṃ, homage to Indra!)
"Come, come, bearer of oblations for all the immortals, mind delighted by the foremost of sages!
Together with the host of radiant worlds, protect my sacrifice, O wise one; homage to you!"

4.175.s:
( oṃ agnaye namaḥ ..)
ehyehi vaivasvatadharmarāja sarvāmarairarcitadivyamūrte ..
śubhāśubhānaṃdakṛtāmadhīśa rakṣādhvaraṃ me bhagavannamaste ..55..
4.175.d:
( ओं अग्नये नमः ॥)
एह्येहि वैवस्वतधर्मराज सर्वामरैरर्चितदिव्यमूर्ते ॥
शुभाशुभानंदकृतामधीश रक्षाध्वरं मे भगवन्नमस्ते ॥55॥
4.175.m:
(Oṃ, homage to Agni!)
"Come, come, son of Vivasvat, king of righteousness, whose divine form is worshipped by all the immortals,
O master of those who make joy from good and evil, protect my sacrifice, O Lord; homage to you!"

4.175.s:
oṃ yamāya namaḥ) ..
ehyehi rakṣogaṇanāyakastvaṃ viśālavetālapiśācasaṃghaiḥ ..
mamādhvaraṃ pāhi piśācanātha lokeśvarastvaṃ bhagavannamaste .. 56 ..
4.175.d:
ओं यमाय नमः) ॥
एह्येहि रक्षोगणनायकस्त्वं विशालवेतालपिशाचसंघैः ॥
ममाध्वरं पाहि पिशाचनाथ लोकेश्वरस्त्वं भगवन्नमस्ते ॥ 56 ॥
4.175.m:
(Oṃ, homage to Yama!)
"Come, come, you are the leader of the host of rākṣasas, with huge troops of vetālas and piśācas!
Protect my sacrifice, O lord of piśācas, you are a master of the world, O Lord; homage to you!"

4.175.s:
oṃ nirṛtaye namaḥ..)
ehyehi yādogaṇavāridhīnāṃ gaṇena parjanya sahāpsarobhiḥ ..
vidyādharendrāmaragīyamāna pāhi tvamasmānbhagavannamaste .. 57..
4.175.d:
ओं निरृतये नमः॥)
एह्येहि यादोगणवारिधीनां गणेन पर्जन्य सहाप्सरोभिः ॥
विद्याधरेन्द्रामरगीयमान पाहि त्वमस्मान्भगवन्नमस्ते ॥ 57॥
4.175.m:
(Oṃ, homage to Nirṛti!)
"Come, come, with the host of aquatic creatures and oceans, O Parjanya, together with apsarases!
Praised by vidyādharas, indras, and immortals, protect us, O Lord; homage to you!"

4.175.s:
( oṃ varuṇāya namaḥ ..
ehyehi yajñe mama rakṣaṇāya mṛgādhirūḍhaḥ saha siddhasaṃghaiḥ ..
prāṇādhipaḥ kālakaveḥ sahāyo gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste .. 58 ..
4.175.d:
( ओं वरुणाय नमः ॥
एह्येहि यज्ञे मम रक्षणाय मृगाधिरूढः सह सिद्धसंघैः ॥
प्राणाधिपः कालकवेः सहायो गृहाण पूजां भगवन्नमस्ते ॥ 58 ॥
4.175.m:
(Oṃ, homage to Varuṇa!)
"Come, come, for the protection of my sacrifice, mounted upon a deer, together with hosts of siddhas,
O master of the vital breaths, helper of the poet of time, accept the worship, O Lord; homage to you!"

4.175.s:
( oṃ vāyaveya namaḥ)
ehyehi yajñeśvara yajñarakṣāṃ vidhatsva nakṣatragaṇena sārddham ..
sarvauṣadhībhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ sahaiva gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste .. 59 ..
4.175.d:
( ओं वायवेय नमः)
एह्येहि यज्ञेश्वर यज्ञरक्षां विधत्स्व नक्षत्रगणेन सार्द्धम् ॥
सर्वौषधीभिः पितृभिः सहैव गृहाण पूजां भगवन्नमस्ते ॥ 59 ॥
4.175.m:
(Om, homage to Vāyu.)
Come, come, lord of the sacrifice! Provide protection for the sacrifice together with the host of stars.
Together with all medicinal herbs and the ancestors, receive this worship, O Lord! Homage to you!

4.175.s:
( oṃ somāya namaḥ ..)
ehyehi viśveśvara viśvamūrte triśūlakhaṭvāṅgadhareṇa sārddham ..
lokena bhūteśvara yajñasiddhyai gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste .. 60 ..
4.175.d:
( ओं सोमाय नमः ॥)
एह्येहि विश्वेश्वर विश्वमूर्ते त्रिशूलखट्वाङ्गधरेण सार्द्धम् ॥
लोकेन भूतेश्वर यज्ञसिद्ध्यै गृहाण पूजां भगवन्नमस्ते ॥ 60 ॥
4.175.m:
(Om, homage to Soma.)
Come, come, lord of the universe, whose form is the universe! Together with the folk that carry
the trident and the skull-topped staff, O lord of beings, receive this worship for the success of the sacrifice, O Lord! Homage to you!

4.175.s:
( īśānāya namaḥ ..)
ehyehi pātāladharādharendra nāgāṃganākinnaragīyamāna ..
yakṣoragendrāmaralokasaṃghairanaṃta rakṣādhvaramasmadīyam ..61..
4.175.d:
( ईशानाय नमः ॥)
एह्येहि पातालधराधरेन्द्र नागांगनाकिन्नरगीयमान ॥
यक्षोरगेन्द्रामरलोकसंघैरनंत रक्षाध्वरमस्मदीयम् ॥61॥
4.175.m:
(Homage to Īśāna.)
Come, come, lord of the underworld, the earth, and the mountains, sung of by serpent maidens and kinnaras!
Together with the hosts of yakṣas, serpent lords, and immortals, O Ananta, protect this sacrifice of ours!

4.175.s:
( oṃ anaṃtāya namaḥ)
ehyehi viśvādhipate munīṃdra lokeśa sārddhaṃ pitṛdevatābhiḥ ..
viśādhvarāṃtaḥ satataṃ śivāya pitāmahastvaṃ satataṃ namaste .. 62..
4.175.d:
( ओं अनंताय नमः)
एह्येहि विश्वाधिपते मुनींद्र लोकेश सार्द्धं पितृदेवताभिः ॥
विशाध्वरांतः सततं शिवाय पितामहस्त्वं सततं नमस्ते ॥ 62॥
4.175.m:
(Om, homage to Ananta.)
Come, come, ruler of the universe, chief of sages, lord of the world, together with the ancestral deities!
Ever within the universal sacrifice for welfare, you are the Grandfather. Perpetual homage to you!

4.175.s:
( oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ)
trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ..
brahmaviṣṇuśivaiḥ sārddhaṃ rakṣāṃ kurvaṃtu tāni me .. 63 ..
4.175.d:
( ओं ब्रह्मणे नमः)
त्रैलोक्ये यानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च ॥
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवैः सार्द्धं रक्षां कुर्वंतु तानि मे ॥ 63 ॥
4.175.m:
(Om, homage to Brahmā.)
Whatever beings there are in the three worlds, stationary and moving,
let them, together with Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, grant me protection!

4.175.s:
devadānavagandharvā yakṣa rākṣasapannagāḥ ..
ṛṣayo manavo gāvo devamātara eva ca ..64..
4.175.d:
देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्ष राक्षसपन्नगाः ॥
ऋषयो मनवो गावो देवमातर एव च ॥64॥
4.175.m:
Gods, dānavas, gandharvas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, serpents,
sages, Manus, cows, and the mothers of the gods,

4.175.s:
sarve mamādhvare rakṣāṃ prakurvaṃtu mudānvitāḥ ..
ityāvāhya surāndadyādṛtvigbhyaḥ kaṇṭha bhūṣaṇam .. 65 ..
4.175.d:
सर्वे ममाध्वरे रक्षां प्रकुर्वंतु मुदान्विताः ॥
इत्यावाह्य सुरान्दद्यादृत्विग्भ्यः कण्ठ भूषणम् ॥ 65 ॥
4.175.m:
let all of them, filled with joy, grant protection to my sacrifice!
Having thus invoked the gods, he should give neck ornaments to the officiating priests,

4.175.s:
kuṃḍalāni ca haimāni sūtrāṇi kaṭakāni ca ..
tathāṃgulipavitrāṇi vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca .. 66 ..
4.175.d:
कुंडलानि च हैमानि सूत्राणि कटकानि च ॥
तथांगुलिपवित्राणि वासांसि कुसुमानि च ॥ 66 ॥
4.175.m:
and golden earrings, cords, bracelets,
as well as rings, garments, and flowers.

4.175.s:
dviguṇaṃ gurave dadyādbhūṣaṇā cchādanādikam ..
āghārāvājyabhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 67 ..
4.175.d:
द्विगुणं गुरवे दद्याद्भूषणा च्छादनादिकम् ॥
आघारावाज्यभागौ तु पूर्वं हुत्वा विचक्षणः ॥ 67 ॥
4.175.m:
He should give twice as much ornament, clothing, and so on to the guru.
Having first offered the two libations and the two portions of clarified butter, the wise man

4.175.s:
praṇavādisvanāmnā ca svāhāṃto homa ucyate ..
homaḥ surāṇāṃ kartavyo ye caivātra pratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 68 ..
4.175.d:
प्रणवादिस्वनाम्ना च स्वाहांतो होम उच्यते ॥
होमः सुराणां कर्तव्यो ये चैवात्र प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥ 68 ॥
4.175.m:
makes the burnt offering, prescribed with the praṇava and the respective name, ending in svāhā.
The burnt offering should be made to the gods who are installed here,

4.175.s:
grahāṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ śivakeśavayostathā ..
vanaspatibhyo brahmaṇe homaḥ kāryo yathecchayā .. 59 ..
4.175.d:
ग्रहाणां लोकपालानां शिवकेशवयोस्तथा ॥
वनस्पतिभ्यो ब्रह्मणे होमः कार्यो यथेच्छया ॥ 59 ॥
4.175.m:
to the planets, to the world protectors, to Śiva and Keśava,
to the trees, and to Brahmā, as he desires.

4.175.s:
tato maṃgalaśabdena sthāpito vedamaṃgalaiḥ ..
triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ .. 70 ..
4.175.d:
ततो मंगलशब्देन स्थापितो वेदमंगलैः ॥
त्रिःप्रदक्षिणमावृत्य गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः ॥ 70 ॥
4.175.m:
Then, having been placed amidst auspicious sounds and Vedic blessings,
having circumambulated three times and taken an añjali of flowers,

4.175.s:
śuklamālyāṃbaro bhūtvā tāṃ tulāmabhimaṃtrayet ..
namaste sarvadevānāṃ śaktistvaṃ satyamāsthitā .. 71 ..
4.175.d:
शुक्लमाल्यांबरो भूत्वा तां तुलामभिमंत्रयेत् ॥
नमस्ते सर्वदेवानां शक्तिस्त्वं सत्यमास्थिता ॥ 71 ॥
4.175.m:
wearing white garlands and clothes, he should address the balance with mantras:
"Homage to you! You are the power of all the gods, founded upon truth.

4.175.s:
sākṣibhūtā jagaddhātri nirmitā viśvayoninā ..
ekataḥ sarvasatyāni tathānṛtaśatāni ca .. 72 ..
4.175.d:
साक्षिभूता जगद्धात्रि निर्मिता विश्वयोनिना ॥
एकतः सर्वसत्यानि तथानृतशतानि च ॥ 72 ॥
4.175.m:
You are the witness, the nurse of the universe, fashioned by the origin of the universe.
On the one side stand all truths, and likewise hundreds of falsehoods;

4.175.s:
dharmādharmabhṛtāṃ madhye sthāpitāsi jagaddhite ..
tvaṃ tule sarvabhūtānāṃ pramāṇamiha kīrtitā .. 73 ..
4.175.d:
धर्माधर्मभृतां मध्ये स्थापितासि जगद्धिते ॥
त्वं तुले सर्वभूतानां प्रमाणमिह कीर्तिता ॥ 73 ॥
4.175.m:
you are established in the midst of the upholders of righteousness and unrighteousness for the welfare of the world.
You, O balance, are proclaimed here as the standard of measurement for all beings.

4.175.s:
māṃ tolayaṃtī saṃsārāduddharātra namostute ..
yo'sau tattvā dhipo devaḥ puruṣaḥ pacaviṃśakaḥ .. 74 ..
4.175.d:
मां तोलयंती संसारादुद्धरात्र नमोस्तुते ॥
योऽसौ तत्त्वा धिपो देवः पुरुषः पचविंशकः ॥ 74 ॥
4.175.m:
Weighing me, lift me up here from saṃsāra! Homage be to you!
That God who is the ruler of reality, the Puruṣa, the twenty-fifth,

4.175.s:
sa eko'dhiṣṭhito devi tvayi tasmānnamo namaḥ ..
namo namaste goviṃda tulāpuruṣasaṃjñaka .. 75 ..
4.175.d:
स एकोऽधिष्ठितो देवि त्वयि तस्मान्नमो नमः ॥
नमो नमस्ते गोविंद तुलापुरुषसंज्ञक ॥ 75 ॥
4.175.m:
He alone resides in you, O goddess; therefore, homage, homage to you!
Homage, homage to you, O Govinda, named Tulāpuruṣa!

4.175.s:
tvaṃ hare tārayasvāsmānasmātsaṃsārasāgarāt ..
puṇyakālamathāsādya kṛtvaivamadhivāsanam .. 76 ..
4.175.d:
त्वं हरे तारयस्वास्मानस्मात्संसारसागरात् ॥
पुण्यकालमथासाद्य कृत्वैवमधिवासनम् ॥ 76 ॥
4.175.m:
O Hari, deliver us from this ocean of saṃsāra!"
Then, having reached the auspicious time and having thus performed the preliminary consecration,

4.175.s:
praṇamya parayā bhaktyā tāṃ tulāmāruhedbudhaḥ ..
sa saṅgacarmakavacī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ .. 77 ..
4.175.d:
प्रणम्य परया भक्त्या तां तुलामारुहेद्बुधः ॥
स सङ्गचर्मकवची सर्वाभरणभूषितः ॥ 77 ॥
4.175.m:
the wise man, bowing with supreme devotion, should mount that balance,
girded with sword, shield, and armour, adorned with all ornaments.

4.175.s:
dharmarājamathādāya hemasūryeṇa saṃyutam ..
karābhyāṃ baddhamuṣṭibhyāmāste paśyanharermukham .. 78 ..
4.175.d:
धर्मराजमथादाय हेमसूर्येण संयुतम् ॥
कराभ्यां बद्धमुष्टिभ्यामास्ते पश्यन्हरेर्मुखम् ॥ 78 ॥
4.175.m:
Then, taking Dharmarāja along with the golden Sun
in his hands with closed fists, he sits looking at the face of Hari,

4.175.s:
vāme yamaṃ tathā gṛhya dakṣiṇe ca raviṃ tathā ..
tato'pare tulābhāge nyaseyurdvijapuṃgavāḥ ..
sāmyādabhyadhikaṃ yāvatkāṃcanaṃ cātinirmalam .. 79 ..
4.175.d:
वामे यमं तथा गृह्य दक्षिणे च रविं तथा ॥
ततोऽपरे तुलाभागे न्यसेयुर्द्विजपुंगवाः ॥
साम्यादभ्यधिकं यावत्कांचनं चातिनिर्मलम् ॥ 79 ॥
4.175.m:
holding Yama in his left hand and Ravi in his right.
Then, on the other pan of the balance, the best of the twice-born should place
purest gold until it exceeds equality [in weight].

4.175.s:
puṣṭikāmastu kurvīta bhūmisaṃsthaṃ nareśvara ..
kṣaṇamātraṃ tataḥ sthitvā punaretadudīrayet.. 80 ..
4.175.d:
पुष्टिकामस्तु कुर्वीत भूमिसंस्थं नरेश्वर ॥
क्षणमात्रं ततः स्थित्वा पुनरेतदुदीरयेत्॥ 80 ॥
4.175.m:
One who desires prosperity should have it touch the ground, O ruler of men.
Then, remaining for merely a moment, he should utter this again:

4.175.s:
namaste sarvabhūtānāṃ sākṣibhūte sanātane ..
pitāmahena devi tvaṃ nirmitā parameṣṭhinā .. 81 ..
4.175.d:
नमस्ते सर्वभूतानां साक्षिभूते सनातने ॥
पितामहेन देवि त्वं निर्मिता परमेष्ठिना ॥ 81 ॥
4.175.m:
"Homage to you, eternal witness of all beings!
You, O goddess, were fashioned by the Grandfather Parameṣṭhin.

4.175.s:
tvayoddhṛtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ saha sthāvarajaṃgamam ..
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthe namaste viśvadhāriṇi .. 82 ..
4.175.d:
त्वयोद्धृतं जगत्सर्वं सह स्थावरजंगमम् ॥
सर्वभूतात्मभूतस्थे नमस्ते विश्वधारिणि ॥ 82 ॥
4.175.m:
By you the entire universe is upheld, together with what is stationary and moving.
Abiding in the self of all beings, homage to you, holder of the universe!"

4.175.s:
tato'vatīrya gurave sarvamarddhaṃ nivedayet..
ṛtvigbhyo'paramarddhaṃ ca dadyādudakapūrvakam .. 83 ..
4.175.d:
ततोऽवतीर्य गुरवे सर्वमर्द्धं निवेदयेत्॥
ऋत्विग्भ्योऽपरमर्द्धं च दद्यादुदकपूर्वकम् ॥ 83 ॥
4.175.m:
Then, descending, he should present half of everything to the guru,
and he should give the other half to the officiating priests, preceded by water.

4.175.s:
prāpya teṣāmanujñāṃ vā tathānyebhyo'pi dāpayet ..
dīnānātha viśiṣṭādīnpūjayedbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha .. 84 ..
4.175.d:
प्राप्य तेषामनुज्ञां वा तथान्येभ्योऽपि दापयेत् ॥
दीनानाथ विशिष्टादीन्पूजयेद्ब्राह्मणैः सह ॥ 84 ॥
4.175.m:
Or, having obtained their permission, he should also have it given to others;
he should honour the poor, the helpless, the distinguished, and others, together with the brāhmaṇas.

4.175.s:
na ciraṃ dhārayedgehe hemasaṃprokṣitaṃ budhaḥ ..
tiṣṭhadbhayāvahaṃ yasmātkaṣṭavyādhikaraṃ bhavet .. 85 ..
4.175.d:
न चिरं धारयेद्गेहे हेमसंप्रोक्षितं बुधः ॥
तिष्ठद्भयावहं यस्मात्कष्टव्याधिकरं भवेत् ॥ 85 ॥
4.175.m:
The wise man should not keep in his house for long gold that has been consecrated,
for if it remains, it brings fear and causes severe disease.

4.175.s:
rātriṃ parasvīkara ṇācchriyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamām ..
anenaiva vidhānena kecidraupyamayaṃ tathā ta 86 ..
4.175.d:
रात्रिं परस्वीकर णाच्छ्रियं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
अनेनैव विधानेन केचिद्रौप्यमयं तथा त 86 ॥
4.175.m:
By giving it away to another before nightfall, he attains unsurpassed prosperity.
According to this very rite, some use silver;

4.175.s:
karpūreṇa tathecchaṃti kecidbrāhmaṇapuṃgavāḥ ..
tathāsitatṛtīyāyāṃ nāryaḥ saubhāgyavardhitāḥ .. 87 ..
4.175.d:
कर्पूरेण तथेच्छंति केचिद्ब्राह्मणपुंगवाः ॥
तथासिततृतीयायां नार्यः सौभाग्यवर्धिताः ॥ 87 ॥
4.175.m:
some excellent brāhmaṇas desire it with camphor;
likewise on the third lunar day of the dark fortnight, women who have increased their good fortune

4.175.s:
kuṃkumena prayacchaṃti lavaṇena guḍena ca ..
tatra maṃtrā na homo vā evameva pradāpayet .. 88 ..
4.175.d:
कुंकुमेन प्रयच्छंति लवणेन गुडेन च ॥
तत्र मंत्रा न होमो वा एवमेव प्रदापयेत् ॥ 88 ॥
4.175.m:
give it with saffron, salt, and raw sugar.
There, neither mantras nor burnt offerings are required; one should give it just so.

4.175.s:
vidhinānena yo dadyā ddānametatsamāhitaḥ ..
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājañchṛṇuṣva gadato mama .. 89 ..
4.175.d:
विधिनानेन यो दद्या द्दानमेतत्समाहितः ॥
तस्य पुण्यफलं राजञ्छृणुष्व गदतो मम ॥ 89 ॥
4.175.m:
He who, with concentrated mind, gives this gift according to this rite—
listen, O king, to its meritorious fruit as I declare it:

4.175.s:
vimānavaramāsthāya nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā ..
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ gaṃdha rvanagaropamam .. 90 ..
4.175.d:
विमानवरमास्थाय नारी वा पुरुषोऽपि वा ॥
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णं गंध र्वनगरोपमम् ॥ 90 ॥
4.175.m:
Mounting an excellent celestial chariot, whether a woman or a man,
crowded with hosts of apsarases, resembling a city of the gandharvas,

4.175.s:
nānāvṛkṣākulaṃ ramyaṃ nānāgaṃdhādhivāsitam ..
anekaratnaviddhāṃgaṃ muktādāmāvalaṃbitam .. 91 ..
4.175.d:
नानावृक्षाकुलं रम्यं नानागंधाधिवासितम् ॥
अनेकरत्नविद्धांगं मुक्तादामावलंबितम् ॥ 91 ॥
4.175.m:
filled with diverse trees, delightful, perfumed with diverse scents,
its frame studded with many jewels, hung with strings of pearls,

4.175.s:
śayanāsanasaṃkīrṇaṃ patākā bhiralaṃkṛtam ..
ghaṃṭāśataravoddhuṣṭaṃ cāmaravyajanānvitam.. 92 ..
4.175.d:
शयनासनसंकीर्णं पताका भिरलंकृतम् ॥
घंटाशतरवोद्धुष्टं चामरव्यजनान्वितम्॥ 92 ॥
4.175.m:
crowded with couches and seats, adorned with flags,
resounding with the sound of hundreds of bells, furnished with chowries and fans,

4.175.s:
sarvartusukhadaṃ ramyaṃ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitam ..
itthaṃ vimānamāruhya gacchetsūryasalo katām.. 93 ..
4.175.d:
सर्वर्तुसुखदं रम्यं सर्वदुःखविवर्जितम् ॥
इत्थं विमानमारुह्य गच्छेत्सूर्यसलो कताम्॥ 93 ॥
4.175.m:
giving pleasure in all seasons, delightful, free from all sorrow—
mounting such a celestial chariot, one goes to the realm of Sūrya.

4.175.s:
mitvā tatra rājeṃdra kalpamekaṃ nirāmayaḥ ..
viṣṇuloke tathā kalpaṃ śivaloke tathaiva ca .. 94 ..
4.175.d:
मित्वा तत्र राजेंद्र कल्पमेकं निरामयः ॥
विष्णुलोके तथा कल्पं शिवलोके तथैव च ॥ 94 ॥
4.175.m:
Having spent there one kalpa free from disease, O king of kings,
and likewise a kalpa in the world of Viṣṇu, and likewise in the world of Śiva,

4.175.s:
viśveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ deva rāja pure tathā ..
pure ca dharmarājasya varuṇasya tathaiva ca .. 95 ..
4.175.d:
विश्वेषां चैव देवानां देव राज पुरे तथा ॥
पुरे च धर्मराजस्य वरुणस्य तथैव च ॥ 95 ॥
4.175.m:
and in the city of all the gods, and in the city of the king of the gods,
and in the city of Dharmarāja, and likewise of Varuṇa,

4.175.s:
dhanadasya pure sthitvā kalpakoṭiśataṃ naraḥ ..
punarmānuṣamabhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ .. 96 ..
4.175.d:
धनदस्य पुरे स्थित्वा कल्पकोटिशतं नरः ॥
पुनर्मानुषमभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥ 96 ॥
4.175.m:
dwelling in the city of Dhanada for a hundred crores of kalpas, a man,
returning again to human existence, becomes a righteous king,

4.175.s:
yajvā dānapatirdhīmāñchatrupakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ ..
yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā mahādānānukīrtanam .. 97 ..
4.175.d:
यज्वा दानपतिर्धीमाञ्छत्रुपक्षक्षयंकरः ॥
यश्चैतच्छृणुयाद्भक्त्या महादानानुकीर्तनम् ॥ 97 ॥
4.175.m:
a sacrificer, a generous donor, wise, a destroyer of the enemy's host.
And whoever hears with devotion this proclamation of the Great Gift,

4.175.s: so'pi mucyeta pāpena trividhena na saṃśayaḥ .. 98 ..
4.175.d: सोऽपि मुच्येत पापेन त्रिविधेन न संशयः ॥ 98 ॥
4.175.m: he too is freed from threefold sin; there is no doubt.

4.175.s:
brahmeśakeśavaparo'sti na pūjanīyo naivāśvamedhasadṛśaḥ kraturasti kaścit ..
gaṃgāsamaṃ tribhuvane'pi na tīrthamasti dānaṃ tulāpuruṣatulyamihāsti nānyat.. 99 ..
hiraṇyagarbhadānavratavarṇanam
4.175.d:
ब्रह्मेशकेशवपरोऽस्ति न पूजनीयो नैवाश्वमेधसदृशः क्रतुरस्ति कश्चित् ॥
गंगासमं त्रिभुवनेऽपि न तीर्थमस्ति दानं तुलापुरुषतुल्यमिहास्ति नान्यत्॥ 99 ॥
हिरण्यगर्भदानव्रतवर्णनम्

4.176.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavansarvabhūteśa sarvabhūtanamaskṛta ..
anugrahāya lokānāṃ kathayasva mamāparam .. 1 ..
4.176.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्सर्वभूतेश सर्वभूतनमस्कृत ॥
अनुग्रहाय लोकानां कथयस्व ममापरम् ॥ 1 ॥

4.176.s:
tvattulyo jāyate yena āyuṣā yaśasā śriyā ..
tanme kathaya deveśa dānaṃ vratamathāpi vā .. 2 ..
4.176.d:
त्वत्तुल्यो जायते येन आयुषा यशसा श्रिया ॥
तन्मे कथय देवेश दानं व्रतमथापि वा ॥ 2 ॥
4.176.m:
by which one becomes equal to you in lifespan, fame, and fortune;
tell me that gift or votive observance, O Lord of gods.

4.176.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi tava lokahitecchayā ..
yenopāyena jāyaṃte mattulyā mānavā bhuvi .. 3 ..
4.176.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि तव लोकहितेच्छया ॥
येनोपायेन जायंते मत्तुल्या मानवा भुवि ॥ 3 ॥
4.176.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Listen, O king, I shall declare out of a desire for the welfare of the world,
by which means men on earth become equal to me.

4.176.s:
na vratainopavāsaiśca na tīrthagamanairapi ..
mahāpathādimaraṇairna yajñairna śrutena ca .. 4 ..
4.176.d:
न व्रतैनोपवासैश्च न तीर्थगमनैरपि ॥
महापथादिमरणैर्न यज्ञैर्न श्रुतेन च ॥ 4 ॥
4.176.m:
Not by votive observances, nor by fasts, nor even by visits to sacred fords,
nor by death on the great journey and the like, nor by sacrifices, nor by sacred learning,

4.176.s:
prāpyate mama loko'yaṃ duṣprāpyastridaśairapi ..
pārthasnehānmahābhāga pravakṣyāmi hitaṃ tava .. 5 ..'
4.176.d:
प्राप्यते मम लोकोऽयं दुष्प्राप्यस्त्रिदशैरपि ॥
पार्थस्नेहान्महाभाग प्रवक्ष्यामि हितं तव ॥ 5 ॥'
4.176.m:
is this realm of mine attained, which is difficult to attain even for the thirty [gods].
Out of affection for Pārtha, O fortunate one, I will tell you what is beneficial for you.

4.176.s:
gobrāhmaṇārthe maraṇaṃ prāptaṃ yena sumedhasā ..
prayāge'naśanaṃ vāpi pūjito vātha śaṃkaraḥ .. 5 ..
4.176.d:
गोब्राह्मणार्थे मरणं प्राप्तं येन सुमेधसा ॥
प्रयागेऽनशनं वापि पूजितो वाथ शंकरः ॥ 5 ॥
4.176.m:
The wise person by whom death has been met for the sake of cows and Brahmins,
or fasting unto death at Prayāga, or by whom Śaṅkara has been worshipped,

4.176.s:
prayāti brahmasālokyaṃ śrutireṣā sanātanī ..
yena matsamatāṃ yāti tatte vakṣyāmyataḥ param .. 7 ..
4.176.d:
प्रयाति ब्रह्मसालोक्यं श्रुतिरेषा सनातनी ॥
येन मत्समतां याति तत्ते वक्ष्याम्यतः परम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.176.m:
goes to the world of Brahmā; this is the eternal Vedic revelation.
Beyond that, I shall tell you that by which one attains equality with me.

4.176.s:
dānaṃ hiraṇyagarbhākhyaṃ kathyamānaṃ nibodha me ..
agnerapatyaṃ prathamaṃ suvarṇamiha paṭhyate .. 8 ..
4.176.d:
दानं हिरण्यगर्भाख्यं कथ्यमानं निबोध मे ॥
अग्नेरपत्यं प्रथमं सुवर्णमिह पठ्यते ॥ 8 ॥
4.176.m:
Hear from me as it is being told, the gift named the golden embryo.
Gold is recited here as the first child of Fire.

4.176.s:
pavitraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pāvanaṃ paramaṃ mahat ..
paryāyanāma tasyoktaṃ hiraṇyaṃ sārvalaukikam .. 9 ..
4.176.d:
पवित्रं सर्वभूतानां पावनं परमं महत् ॥
पर्यायनाम तस्योक्तं हिरण्यं सार्वलौकिकम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.176.m:
It is pure for all beings, supremely great, and purifying.
Its universal synonym is declared to be 'gold' (hiraṇya).

4.176.s:
tadapāṃ garbhamāviśya punarjātaṃ tu bhūtale ..
yaśca tadbrāhmaṇe dadyānmattulyo jāyate hi saḥ .. 4.176.10 ..
4.176.d:
तदपां गर्भमाविश्य पुनर्जातं तु भूतले ॥
यश्च तद्ब्राह्मणे दद्यान्मत्तुल्यो जायते हि सः ॥ 4.176.10 ॥
4.176.m:
Entering into the womb of the waters, it was born again upon the surface of the earth;
and whoever gives it to a Brahmin indeed becomes equal to me.

4.176.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
vidhānaṃ tasya deveśa kathayasva sanātana ..
yatpramāṇaṃ yathācaitaddātavyaṃ parameśvara .. 11 ..
4.176.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
विधानं तस्य देवेश कथयस्व सनातन ॥
यत्प्रमाणं यथाचैतद्दातव्यं परमेश्वर ॥ 11 ॥

4.176.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
parvakāle pradātavyaṃ dānametanmahāmate ..
ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe śaśisūryayoḥ .. 12 ..
4.176.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पर्वकाले प्रदातव्यं दानमेतन्महामते ॥
अयने विषुवे चैव ग्रहणे शशिसूर्ययोः ॥ 12 ॥
4.176.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
This gift should be given at an auspicious period, O intelligent one,
at a solstice, an equinox, and at an eclipse of the moon or the sun,

4.176.s:
vyatīpāte'tha kārtikyāṃ janmarkṣe vā narottama ..
duḥsvapnadarśane caiva grahapīḍāsu caiva hi .. 13 ..
4.176.d:
व्यतीपातेऽथ कार्तिक्यां जन्मर्क्षे वा नरोत्तम ॥
दुःस्वप्नदर्शने चैव ग्रहपीडासु चैव हि ॥ 13 ॥
4.176.m:
at Vyatīpāta, on a Kārttikī day, or under one's birth constellation, O best of men;
or upon seeing bad dreams, and during planetary afflictions,

4.176.s:
prayāge naimiṣe caiva kurukṣetre tathārbude ..
gaṃgāyāṃ yamunāyāṃ ca siṃdhusāgarasaṃgame .. 14 ..
4.176.d:
प्रयागे नैमिषे चैव कुरुक्षेत्रे तथार्बुदे ॥
गंगायां यमुनायां च सिंधुसागरसंगमे ॥ 14 ॥
4.176.m:
at Prayāga, at Naimiṣa, at Kurukṣetra, and likewise at Arbuda,
at the Gaṅgā, at the Yamunā, and at the confluence of the Indus with the ocean;

4.176.s:
puṇyanadyaśca dānesminpraśastāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ ..
yatra vā rocate rājangṛhe devakule'thavā .. 15 ..
4.176.d:
पुण्यनद्यश्च दानेस्मिन्प्रशस्ताः स्युर्न संशयः ॥
यत्र वा रोचते राजन्गृहे देवकुलेऽथवा ॥ 15 ॥
4.176.m:
and holy rivers would be commended for this gift, there is no doubt.
Or wherever one pleases, O king, in a house or in a temple,

4.176.s:
ārāme vā taḍāge vā śucau deśe vidhānataḥ ..
tatra bhūśodhanaṃ kuryātprāgudakpravaṇaṃ śubham .. 16 ..
4.176.d:
आरामे वा तडागे वा शुचौ देशे विधानतः ॥
तत्र भूशोधनं कुर्यात्प्रागुदक्प्रवणं शुभम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.176.m:
in an orchard, or at a pond, in a pure place according to the rules;
there one should perform the purification of the ground, auspicious and sloping towards the north-east.

4.176.s:
hastā dvādaśa kartavyaṃ maṃḍapaṃ tu suśobhanam ..
staṃbhairmanoharairyuktyārdraśākhābhiranvitam .. 17 ..
4.176.d:
हस्ता द्वादश कर्तव्यं मंडपं तु सुशोभनम् ॥
स्तंभैर्मनोहरैर्युक्त्यार्द्रशाखाभिरन्वितम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.176.m:
One should construct a very beautiful pavilion of twelve cubits,
suitably furnished with charming pillars and fresh branches.

4.176.s:
tanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryātpaṃcahastāmalakṛtām ..
vitānamupariṣṭācca puṣpamālāvalaṃbitum .. 18 ..
4.176.d:
तन्मध्ये वेदिकां कुर्यात्पंचहस्तामलकृताम् ॥
वितानमुपरिष्टाच्च पुष्पमालावलंबितुम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.176.m:
In the middle of it, one should make a decorated altar of five cubits,
and a canopy above it hung with flower garlands.

4.176.s:
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ tanmadhye prathame'hani kalpayet ..
tasya pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi rūpaṃ vai sthaṃḍilodbhavam .. 19 ..
4.176.d:
हिरण्यगर्भं तन्मध्ये प्रथमेऽहनि कल्पयेत् ॥
तस्य प्रमाणं वक्ष्यामि रूपं वै स्थंडिलोद्भवम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.176.m:
On the first day, one should place the golden embryo in the middle of it.
I shall tell its measurement and its form produced on the bare ground.

4.176.s:
śilpinaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā ..
brāhmaṇānvācayetpaścāttataḥ karma samārabhet .. 4.176.20 ..
4.176.d:
शिल्पिनं पूजयेत्पूर्वं वासोभिर्भूषणैस्तथा ॥
ब्राह्मणान्वाचयेत्पश्चात्ततः कर्म समारभेत् ॥ 4.176.20 ॥
4.176.m:
First one should honour the artisan with garments and ornaments;
afterwards one should have Brahmins chant blessings, and then begin the rite.

4.176.s:
suvarṇena saṃśuddhena śaktitaḥ kārayedbudhaḥ ..
aṃgulāni catuḥṣaṣṭirdairghyaṃ ca parikīrtitam .. 21 ..
4.176.d:
सुवर्णेन संशुद्धेन शक्तितः कारयेद्बुधः ॥
अंगुलानि चतुःषष्टिर्दैर्घ्यं च परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.176.m:
A wise man should have it fashioned from thoroughly purified gold according to his means;
its length is declared to be sixty-four fingers;

4.176.s:
tribhāgahīnaṃ vadane mūle tasyārddhavistaram ..
vartulaṃ karṇikākāraṃ cārugraṃthivivarjitam .. 22 ..
4.176.d:
त्रिभागहीनं वदने मूले तस्यार्द्धविस्तरम् ॥
वर्तुलं कर्णिकाकारं चारुग्रंथिविवर्जितम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.176.m:
one third less at the mouth, and its width half of that at the base;
round, shaped like a lotus pericarp, free from unsightly knots.

4.176.s:
pidhānamupariṣṭācca kartavyaṃ cāṃgulādhikam ..
astrāṇi daśa kurvīta nālaṃ sūryaṃ ca kāṃcanam .. 23 ..
4.176.d:
पिधानमुपरिष्टाच्च कर्तव्यं चांगुलाधिकम् ॥
अस्त्राणि दश कुर्वीत नालं सूर्यं च कांचनम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.176.m:
A lid should also be made on top, one finger greater [in width];
one should make ten weapons, a lotus stalk, and a golden sun,

4.176.s:
dātraṃ sapaṭṭikaṃ caiva sarvopaskaraṇānvitam ..
sūcīkṣuraśca haimāni tatsarvaṃ parikalpayet .. 24 ..
4.176.d:
दात्रं सपट्टिकं चैव सर्वोपस्करणान्वितम् ॥
सूचीक्षुरश्च हैमानि तत्सर्वं परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 24 ॥
4.176.m:
a sickle with a cloth band, furnished with all accessories;
a needle and a razor, all of them of gold, one should prepare.

4.176.s:
pārśvataḥ sthāpayettasya hemadaṃḍakamaṃḍalū ..
chatrikāpādukāyugmaṃ vajravaiḍūryamaṃḍitam .. 25 ..
4.176.d:
पार्श्वतः स्थापयेत्तस्य हेमदंडकमंडलू ॥
छत्रिकापादुकायुग्मं वज्रवैडूर्यमंडितम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.176.m:
At its sides one should place a golden staff and waterpot,
a parasol and a pair of sandals, adorned with diamonds and lapis lazuli.

4.176.s:
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā garbhaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
brahmaghoṣeṇa mahatā śaṃkhatūryaraveṇa ca .. 26 ..
4.176.d:
एवं लक्षणसंयुक्तं कृत्वा गर्भं विचक्षणः ॥
ब्रह्मघोषेण महता शंखतूर्यरवेण च ॥ 26 ॥
4.176.m:
Having fashioned the embryo endowed with these characteristics, the discerning man,
with a great chant of Vedic hymns and the sounding of conches and instruments,

4.176.s:
hastinā śakaṭenātha rājanbrahmarathena vā ..
ānayenmaṃḍapaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇamataṃdritaḥ .. 27 ..
4.176.d:
हस्तिना शकटेनाथ राजन्ब्रह्मरथेन वा ॥
आनयेन्मंडपं कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणमतंद्रितः ॥ 27 ॥
4.176.m:
by means of an elephant, a cart, O king, or a sacred carriage,
should bring it to the pavilion after having circumambulated it without sloth.

4.176.s:
tiladroṇoparigataṃ vedīmadhye'dhivāsayet ..
samālabhya punaḥ sarvaṃ kuṃkumena sugaṃdhinā .. 28 ..
4.176.d:
तिलद्रोणोपरिगतं वेदीमध्येऽधिवासयेत् ॥
समालभ्य पुनः सर्वं कुंकुमेन सुगंधिना ॥ 28 ॥
4.176.m:
Placed upon a droṇa of sesame seeds, he should consecrate it in the middle of the altar;
and having anointed it all over with fragrant saffron,

4.176.s:
kauśeyavāsasī śubhre tatastaṃ paridhāpayet ..
samaṃtātpuṣpamālābhiḥ pūjayedbhaktitaḥ sudhīḥ ..29..
4.176.d:
कौशेयवाससी शुभ्रे ततस्तं परिधापयेत् ॥
समंतात्पुष्पमालाभिः पूजयेद्भक्तितः सुधीः ॥29॥
4.176.m:
the wise man should then clothe it with two white silk garments;
and should honour it from all sides with flower garlands out of devotion.

4.176.s:
dhūpaiḥ sudhūpitaṃ kṛtvā maṃtrametamudīrayet ..
bhūrlokapramukhālokāstava garbhe vyavasthitāḥ .. 4.176.30 ..
4.176.d:
धूपैः सुधूपितं कृत्वा मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥
भूर्लोकप्रमुखालोकास्तव गर्भे व्यवस्थिताः ॥ 4.176.30 ॥
4.176.m:
Having thoroughly perfumed it with incenses, he should recite this mantra:
‘The worlds, beginning with the realm of the earth, reside in your womb;

4.176.s:
brahmādayastathā devā namaste bhuvanodbhava ..
namaste bhuvanādhāra namaste bhuvaneśvara .. 31 ..
4.176.d:
ब्रह्मादयस्तथा देवा नमस्ते भुवनोद्भव ॥
नमस्ते भुवनाधार नमस्ते भुवनेश्वर ॥ 31 ॥
4.176.m:
likewise Brahmā and the gods; homage to you who give birth to the worlds!
Homage to you, the support of the worlds! Homage to you, the lord of the worlds!

4.176.s:
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya garbhe yasya pitāmahaḥ ..
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā tu tau rātrimadhivāsayet .. 32 ..
4.176.d:
नमो हिरण्यगर्भाय गर्भे यस्य पितामहः ॥
एवं संपूजयित्वा तु तौ रात्रिमधिवासयेत् ॥ 32 ॥
4.176.m:
Homage to the golden embryo, in whose womb is the Grandfather!’
Having worshipped it thus, one should consecrate the two of them for that night.

4.176.s:
vedyāścaturdiśaṃ caiva kuṃḍāni parikalpayet ..
catvāri caturasrāṇi teṣu homo vidhīyate .. 33 ..
4.176.d:
वेद्याश्चतुर्दिशं चैव कुंडानि परिकल्पयेत् ॥
चत्वारि चतुरस्राणि तेषु होमो विधीयते ॥ 33 ॥
4.176.m:
And on the four sides of the altar, one should prepare sacrificial pits,
four square ones; oblation into them is prescribed.

4.176.s:
catuścāraṇikāstatra brāhmaṇā maṃtrapāragāḥ ..
homaṃ kuryurjitātmāno mauninaḥ sarva eva te ..34..
4.176.d:
चतुश्चारणिकास्तत्र ब्राह्मणा मंत्रपारगाः ॥
होमं कुर्युर्जितात्मानो मौनिनः सर्व एव ते ॥34॥
4.176.m:
There, Brahmins versed in the mantras of the four Vedic traditions,
with restrained minds, all observing silence, should make the oblation.

4.176.s:
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāḥ sarve cāhatavāsasaḥ ..
tāmrapātradvayopetā gaṃdhapuṣpādipūjitāḥ .. 35 ..
4.176.d:
सर्वाभरणसंपन्नाः सर्वे चाहतवाससः ॥
ताम्रपात्रद्वयोपेता गंधपुष्पादिपूजिताः ॥ 35 ॥
4.176.m:
Endowed with all ornaments, all wearing unwashed garments,
provided with two copper vessels, honoured with perfumes, flowers, and the like.

4.176.s:
vedyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge grahavediṃ prakalpayet ..
tatra grahāṃllokapālānbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān .. .. 36 ..
4.176.d:
वेद्याः पूर्वोत्तरे भागे ग्रहवेदिं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
तत्र ग्रहांल्लोकपालान्ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरान् ॥ ॥ 36 ॥
4.176.m:
In the north-eastern part of the altar, one should prepare a planetary altar;
there one should worship the planets, the world protectors, and Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara,

4.176.s:
pūjayetsvarṇaghaṭitānpuṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ..
patākābhiralaṃkṛtya maṃḍapaṃ toraṇaistathā .. 37 ..
4.176.d:
पूजयेत्स्वर्णघटितान्पुष्पधूपविलेपनैः ॥
पताकाभिरलंकृत्य मंडपं तोरणैस्तथा ॥ 37 ॥
4.176.m:
fashioned of gold, with flowers, incenses, and unguents;
having adorned the pavilion with flags and archways,

4.176.s:
kuṃbhadvayaṃ ca dvāreṣu sthāpayedratnasaṃyutam ..
tulāpuruṣamaṃtraiśca lokapālabaliṃ kṣipet .. 38 ..
4.176.d:
कुंभद्वयं च द्वारेषु स्थापयेद्रत्नसंयुतम् ॥
तुलापुरुषमंत्रैश्च लोकपालबलिं क्षिपेत् ॥ 38 ॥
4.176.m:
and placed two jars with jewels at the doors,
he should cast the offering to the world protectors with the mantras of the weighing rite.

4.176.s:
pālāśyaḥ samidhastatra praśastā homakarmaṇi ..
caruścaivendradaivatyastilā gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā ..39..
4.176.d:
पालाश्यः समिधस्तत्र प्रशस्ता होमकर्मणि ॥
चरुश्चैवेन्द्रदैवत्यस्तिला गव्यं घृतं तथा ॥39॥
4.176.m:
Faggots of palāśa wood are commended there for the rite of oblation,
and a boiled rice offering dedicated to Indra, sesame seeds, and cow's ghee.

4.176.s:
svaliṃgairhomayetpūrvaṃ maṃtrairvyāhṛtibhiḥ pumān ..
ayute dve ca homasya saṃkhyāmāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ .. 4.176.40 ..
4.176.d:
स्वलिंगैर्होमयेत्पूर्वं मंत्रैर्व्याहृतिभिः पुमान् ॥
अयुते द्वे च होमस्य संख्यामाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥ 4.176.40 ॥
4.176.m:
A man should first offer oblations with their respective indicative mantras and the sacred utterances;
the wise state the number of oblations to be twenty thousand.

4.176.s:
yajamānastataḥ snātvā śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ..
bhaktyā hiraṇyagarbhaṃ ca parvakāle samarcayet .. 41 ..
4.176.d:
यजमानस्ततः स्नात्वा शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः॥
भक्त्या हिरण्यगर्भं च पर्वकाले समर्चयेत् ॥ 41 ॥
4.176.m:
Then the patron of the sacrifice, having bathed, wearing white clothes and pure,
should worship the golden embryo with devotion at an auspicious period:

4.176.s:
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya viśvagarbhāya vai namaḥ ..
carācarasya jagato gṛhabhūtāya te namaḥ .. 42 ..
4.176.d:
नमो हिरण्यगर्भाय विश्वगर्भाय वै नमः ॥
चराचरस्य जगतो गृहभूताय ते नमः ॥ 42 ॥
4.176.m:
‘Homage to the golden embryo, homage indeed to the universal embryo!
Homage to you who are the abode of the world of the moving and unmoving!

4.176.s:
mātrāhaṃ janitaḥ pūrva martyadharmāsurottama ..
tvadgarbhasaṃbhavādadya divyadeho bhavāmyaham .. 43 ..
4.176.d:
मात्राहं जनितः पूर्व मर्त्यधर्मासुरोत्तम ॥
त्वद्गर्भसंभवादद्य दिव्यदेहो भवाम्यहम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.176.m:
Formerly I was born of a mother, bound by mortal nature, O best of gods;
today, through birth from your womb, I become one of divine body.’

4.176.s:
ityuccārya svayaṃ bhaktyā kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇām ..
kṣīrājyadadhisaṃpūrṇaṃ tadgarbhaṃ praviśedbudhaḥ .. 44 ..
4.176.d:
इत्युच्चार्य स्वयं भक्त्या कृत्वा चैव प्रदक्षिणाम् ॥
क्षीराज्यदधिसंपूर्णं तद्गर्भं प्रविशेद्बुधः ॥ 44 ॥
4.176.m:
Having recited this with devotion and having circumambulated it,
the wise man should enter that womb filled with milk, clarified butter, and curds.

4.176.s:
sauvarṇaṃ dharmarājaṃ tu savye kṛtvā kare tataḥ ..
bhāskaraṃ dakṣiṇe caiva muṣṭiṃ baddhvā prayatnataḥ .. 45 ..
4.176.d:
सौवर्णं धर्मराजं तु सव्ये कृत्वा करे ततः ॥
भास्करं दक्षिणे चैव मुष्टिं बद्ध्वा प्रयत्नतः ॥ 45 ॥
4.176.m:
Then, taking the golden Dharmarāja in his left hand
and the Sun in his right, clenching his fists with effort,

4.176.s:
jānvoraṃtarataścaiva śiraḥ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ ..
ucchvāsapaṃcaka tiṣṭheccetasā ciṃtayañchivam .. 46 ..
4.176.d:
जान्वोरंतरतश्चैव शिरः कृत्वा समाहितः ॥
उच्छ्वासपंचक तिष्ठेच्चेतसा चिंतयञ्छिवम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.176.m:
and placing his head between his knees, collected in mind,
he should remain for five breaths, contemplating Śiva in his heart.

4.176.s:
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmaṃtonnayanaṃ tathā ..
kuryurhiraṇyagarbhasya tataste dvijapuṃgavāḥ .. 47 ..
4.176.d:
गर्भाधानं पुंसवनं सीमंतोन्नयनं तथा ॥
कुर्युर्हिरण्यगर्भस्य ततस्ते द्विजपुंगवाः ॥ 47 ॥
4.176.m:
Then those best of the twice-born should perform
the conception rite, the quickening rite, and the parting of the hair for the Golden Womb;

4.176.s:
jātakarmādikāḥ kuryuḥ kriyāḥ ṣoḍaśa cāparāḥ ..
tata utthāya niḥsṛtya punaḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇām.. 48 ..
4.176.d:
जातकर्मादिकाः कुर्युः क्रियाः षोडश चापराः ॥
तत उत्थाय निःसृत्य पुनः कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणाम्॥ 48 ॥
4.176.m:
they should perform the birth rites and the other sixteen sacraments.
Then, having risen and come out, he should circumambulate it again.

4.176.s:
tāvanmukhaṃ na paśyeta kasyacinnṛpasattama ..
sauvarṇā pṛthivī yāvanna dṛṣṭā spaṣṭacakṣuṣā .. 49 ..
4.176.d:
तावन्मुखं न पश्येत कस्यचिन्नृपसत्तम ॥
सौवर्णा पृथिवी यावन्न दृष्टा स्पष्टचक्षुषा ॥ 49 ॥
4.176.m:
O best of kings, he should not look upon anyone's face
until the golden earth has been seen with clear eyes.

4.176.s:
tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta brahmaghoṣapuraḥsaram ..
aṣṭau dvijāḥ suvarṇāṃgā sauvarṇaiḥ kalaśaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 4.176.50 ..
4.176.d:
ततः स्नानं प्रकुर्वीत ब्रह्मघोषपुरःसरम् ॥
अष्टौ द्विजाः सुवर्णांगा सौवर्णैः कलशैः शुभैः ॥ 4.176.50 ॥
4.176.m:
Then he should perform his bath preceded by the chanting of the Veda.
Eight twice-born men, their limbs adorned with gold, with auspicious golden jars,

4.176.s:
raupyairauduṃbarairvāpi mṛṇmayairvā suśobhanaiḥ ..
dadhyakṣatavicitrāṃgairāmrapallavaśobhitaiḥ .. 51 ..
4.176.d:
रौप्यैरौदुंबरैर्वापि मृण्मयैर्वा सुशोभनैः ॥
दध्यक्षतविचित्रांगैराम्रपल्लवशोभितैः ॥ 51 ॥
4.176.m:
or with silver ones, copper ones, or very handsome earthenware ones,
their bodies adorned with curds and unbroken rice, beautified with mango sprouts,

4.176.s:
puṣpairāveṣṭitagrīvairavraṇaiḥ kalaśairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
catuṣkamadhye saṃsthāpya pīṭhamavraṇamuttamam .. 52 ..
4.176.d:
पुष्पैरावेष्टितग्रीवैरव्रणैः कलशैर्दृढैः ॥
चतुष्कमध्ये संस्थाप्य पीठमव्रणमुत्तमम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.176.m:
their necks encircled with flowers, jars free from cracks and sturdy—
having placed an unbroken, excellent seat in the middle of a four-pillared square,

4.176.s:
tatra sthāpya mahābhāga yajamānaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
devasya tveti maṃtreṇa kuryurasyābhiṣecanam .. 53 ..
4.176.d:
तत्र स्थाप्य महाभाग यजमानं द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
देवस्य त्वेति मंत्रेण कुर्युरस्याभिषेचनम् ॥ 53 ॥
4.176.m:
and having seated the patron of the sacrifice there, O fortunate one,
the best of the twice-born should perform his consecration with the mantra beginning 'Devasya tvā'.

4.176.s:
adya jātasya teṃ'gāni abhiṣekṣyāmahe vayam ..
divyenānena vapuṣā ciraṃjīvamukhī bhava .. 54 ..
4.176.d:
अद्य जातस्य तेंऽगानि अभिषेक्ष्यामहे वयम् ॥
दिव्येनानेन वपुषा चिरंजीवमुखी भव ॥ 54 ॥
4.176.m:
'We sprinkle the limbs of you who are born today;
with this divine body, become one who faces long life!'

4.176.s:
evaṃ kṛtābhiṣekastu yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
dadyāddhiraṇyagarbhaṃ taṃ sodakenaiva pāṇinā .. 55 ..
4.176.d:
एवं कृताभिषेकस्तु यजमानः समाहितः ॥
दद्याद्धिरण्यगर्भं तं सोदकेनैव पाणिना ॥ 55 ॥
4.176.m:
Having thus been consecrated, the collected patron of the sacrifice
should give that Golden Womb with water in hand.

4.176.s:
tānsaṃpūjya ca bhāvena bahubhyo vā tadājñayā ..
yajñopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ gurave vinivedayet .. 56 ..
4.176.d:
तान्संपूज्य च भावेन बहुभ्यो वा तदाज्ञया ॥
यज्ञोपकरणं सर्वं गुरवे विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 56 ॥
4.176.m:
Having worshipped them with feeling, or to many [priests] at their command,
he should offer all the sacrifice's utensils to the preceptor:

4.176.s:
pādukopānahau caiva cchatracāmarabhājanam ..
anyeṣāṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ ye ca tatra sabhāsadaḥ .. 57 ..
4.176.d:
पादुकोपानहौ चैव च्छत्रचामरभाजनम् ॥
अन्येषां चैव विप्राणां ये च तत्र सभासदः ॥ 57 ॥
4.176.m:
wooden sandals, leather shoes, royal parasol, chowrie, and vessels;
and to the other Brahmins who are members of the assembly there,

4.176.s:
teṣāṃ caiva pradātavyaṃ dānaṃ cātra viśeṣataḥ ..
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca dātavyaṃ sārvakāmikam .. 58 ..
4.176.d:
तेषां चैव प्रदातव्यं दानं चात्र विशेषतः ॥
दीनांधकृपणानां च दातव्यं सार्वकामिकम् ॥ 58 ॥
4.176.m:
gifts are especially to be given to them in this rite;
and to the poor, the blind, and the destitute, whatever fulfills all desires is to be given.

4.176.s:
annasatraṃ ca kartavyaṃ yāvaddānaparigrahaḥ ..
anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati .. 59 ..
4.176.d:
अन्नसत्रं च कर्तव्यं यावद्दानपरिग्रहः ॥
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ॥ 59 ॥
4.176.m:
And a charitable food distribution must be maintained as long as the gift is being received.
He who gives this gift according to this rule,

4.176.s:
sa kulaṃ tārayetsarvaṃ devalokaṃ sa gacchati ..
vimānavaramāruhya pañcayojanavistṛtam .. 4.176.60 ..
4.176.d:
स कुलं तारयेत्सर्वं देवलोकं स गच्छति ॥
विमानवरमारुह्य पञ्चयोजनविस्तृतम् ॥ 4.176.60 ॥
4.176.m:
delivers his whole family and goes to the world of the gods,
having mounted an excellent celestial chariot five leagues wide,

4.176.s:
vāpīkūpataḍāgādyairjalasthānairalaṃkṛtam ..
udyānaśatasaṃsthānaṃ padmākaraniṣevitam .. 61 ..
4.176.d:
वापीकूपतडागाद्यैर्जलस्थानैरलंकृतम् ॥
उद्यानशतसंस्थानं पद्माकरनिषेवितम् ॥ 61 ॥
4.176.m:
adorned with water-reservoirs like stepwells, wells, and ponds,
situated amid a hundred orchards, frequented by lotus pools,

4.176.s:
prāsādaśatasaṃkīrṇaṃ varastrīśatasevitam ..
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgānāṃ śabdairāpūritaṃ mahat .. 62 ..
4.176.d:
प्रासादशतसंकीर्णं वरस्त्रीशतसेवितम् ॥
वीणावेणुमृदंगानां शब्दैरापूरितं महत् ॥ 62 ॥
4.176.m:
crowded with a hundred palaces, attended by a hundred noble women,
filled with the great sounds of lutes, flutes, and drums,

4.176.s:
bhūmayo yatra rājendra divyā maṇimayāḥ śubhāḥ ..
vedikābhirvicitrābhiḥ śobhitaṃ bhāskaraprabham.. 63 ..
4.176.d:
भूमयो यत्र राजेन्द्र दिव्या मणिमयाः शुभाः ॥
वेदिकाभिर्विचित्राभिः शोभितं भास्करप्रभम्॥ 63 ॥
4.176.m:
where, O best of kings, the divine, auspicious grounds are made of gems,
beautified by wondrous altars, radiant like the sun,

4.176.s:
dhṛtaṃ stambhasahasreṇa sukṛtaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ..
patākābhirvicitrābhirvajraiśca samalaṃkṛtam .. 64 ..
4.176.d:
धृतं स्तम्भसहस्रेण सुकृतं विश्वकर्मणा ॥
पताकाभिर्विचित्राभिर्वज्रैश्च समलंकृतम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.176.m:
supported by a thousand pillars, well fashioned by Viśvakarman,
and decorated with wondrous flags and diamonds.

4.176.s:
tadāruhya vimānāgryaṃ vidyādharagaṇairyutam ..
sa yāti lokaṃ śakrasya śakreṇa saha modate .. 65 ..
4.176.d:
तदारुह्य विमानाग्र्यं विद्याधरगणैर्युतम् ॥
स याति लोकं शक्रस्य शक्रेण सह मोदते ॥ 65 ॥
4.176.m:
Having mounted that foremost celestial chariot accompanied by hosts of Vidyādharas,
he goes to the world of Śakra and rejoices with Śakra.

4.176.s:
manvantaraśate jāte karmabhūmau prajāyate ..
jaṃbūdvīpamaśeṣaṃ tu bhuṃkte divyaparākramaḥ .. 66 ..
4.176.d:
मन्वन्तरशते जाते कर्मभूमौ प्रजायते ॥
जंबूद्वीपमशेषं तु भुंक्ते दिव्यपराक्रमः ॥ 66 ॥
4.176.m:
When a hundred manvantaras have passed, he is reborn in the realm of action;
of divine valor, he enjoys the whole of Jambūdvīpa.

4.176.s:
dhārmikaḥ satyaśīlaśca brahmaṇyo guruvatsalaḥ..
daśa janmrānyasau rājā jāyate rogavarjitaḥ .. 67 ..
4.176.d:
धार्मिकः सत्यशीलश्च ब्रह्मण्यो गुरुवत्सलः॥
दश जन्म्रान्यसौ राजा जायते रोगवर्जितः ॥ 67 ॥
4.176.m:
Righteous, truthful in nature, pious toward Brahmins, devoted to his preceptors,
for ten births that king is born free from disease.

4.176.s:
yastvidaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
so'pi varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ suraloke mahīyate .. 68 ..
4.176.d:
यस्त्विदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या रहस्यं पापनाशनम् ॥
सोऽपि वर्षशतं साग्रं सुरलोके महीयते ॥ 68 ॥
4.176.m:
He who listens to this secret, sin-destroying teaching with devotion,
he too is honored in the world of the gods for full one hundred years.

4.176.s:
garbhaṃ hiraṇyaracitaṃ vidhivatpraviśya saṃskārasaṃskṛtatanuḥ punareva tasmāt ..
niḥsṛtya taddvijavarāya nivedya bhaktyā mārtaṇḍavaddivi virājati divyadehaḥ .. 69 ..
brahmāṇḍadānavidhivarṇanam
4.176.d:
गर्भं हिरण्यरचितं विधिवत्प्रविश्य संस्कारसंस्कृततनुः पुनरेव तस्मात् ॥
निःसृत्य तद्द्विजवराय निवेद्य भक्त्या मार्तण्डवद्दिवि विराजति दिव्यदेहः ॥ 69 ॥
ब्रह्माण्डदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.176.m:
Having duly entered the womb fashioned of gold, his body consecrated by the sacraments, and having emerged from it again,
having offered it with devotion to the best of the twice-born, endowed with a divine body he shines in heaven like the sun.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of the Cosmic Egg

4.177.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
agastyena purā gīto dānānāṃ vidhiruttamaḥ ..
śṛṇu tvaṃ rājaśārdūla kathyamānaṃ mayādhunā .. 1 ..
4.177.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अगस्त्येन पुरा गीतो दानानां विधिरुत्तमः ॥
शृणु त्वं राजशार्दूल कथ्यमानं मयाधुना ॥ 1 ॥
4.177.m:
The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said:
Formerly, the supreme rule of gifts was sung by Agastya.
Listen, O tiger among kings, as it is now related by me,

4.177.s:
yena dattena rājendra sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati ..
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ vāpi kāyikaṃ ca sudustaram .. 2 ..
4.177.d:
येन दत्तेन राजेन्द्र सर्वं पापं व्यपोहति ॥
मानसं वाचिकं वापि कायिकं च सुदुस्तरम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.177.m:
by the giving of which, O best of kings, one removes all sin—
mental, vocal, and physical, however difficult to overcome.

4.177.s:
maṃgalyaṃ maṃgalaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu cottamam ..
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ paralokabhayāpaham ..
brahmāṃḍaṃ kāṃcanaṃ kṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam .. 3 ..
4.177.d:
मंगल्यं मंगलं पुण्यं सर्वदानेषु चोत्तमम् ॥
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं परलोकभयापहम् ॥
ब्रह्मांडं कांचनं कृत्वा सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.177.m:
Auspicious, bringing good fortune, meritorious, supreme among all gifts,
bestowing prosperity, fame, long life, and removing fear of the next world:
having made a golden Cosmic Egg endowed with all characteristics,

4.177.s:
devāsuramanuṣyaiśca gandharvoragarākṣasaiḥ ..
saṃyuktaṃ ca nadībhiśca samudraiḥ parvataistathā ..
vimānaśatakoṭībhirbhūṣitaṃ cāpsarovaraiḥ .. 4 ..
4.177.d:
देवासुरमनुष्यैश्च गन्धर्वोरगराक्षसैः ॥
संयुक्तं च नदीभिश्च समुद्रैः पर्वतैस्तथा ॥
विमानशतकोटीभिर्भूषितं चाप्सरोवरैः ॥ 4 ॥
4.177.m:
complete with gods, asuras, humans, gandharvas, serpents, and rākṣasas,
together with rivers, oceans, and mountains,
and adorned with a hundred crore celestial chariots and choice apsarases,

4.177.s:
diggajāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ madhyasthitacaturmukham ..
śivācyutārkaśikharamumālakṣmīsamanvitam .. 5 ..
4.177.d:
दिग्गजाष्टकसंयुक्तं मध्यस्थितचतुर्मुखम् ॥
शिवाच्युतार्कशिखरमुमालक्ष्मीसमन्वितम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.177.m:
accompanied by the eight elephants of the directions, with the four-faced [Brahmā] seated in the middle,
with peaks for Śiva, Acyuta, and the Sun, and endowed with Umā and Lakṣmī;

4.177.s:
tasyāṃge kalpayedrājanbhuvanāni caturdaśa ..
vitasteraṃgulaśataṃ yāvadāyāmavistaram .. 6 ..
4.177.d:
तस्यांगे कल्पयेद्राजन्भुवनानि चतुर्दश ॥
वितस्तेरंगुलशतं यावदायामविस्तरम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.177.m:
on its body, O king, one should fashion the fourteen worlds;
from a span up to a hundred finger-breadths in length and width,

4.177.s:
kuryādviṃśatpalādūrdhvamāsahasrācca bhaktitaḥ ..
śakaladvayasaṃyuktaṃ puṭākāraṃ susaṃhitam ..7 ..
4.177.d:
कुर्याद्विंशत्पलादूर्ध्वमासहस्राच्च भक्तितः ॥
शकलद्वयसंयुक्तं पुटाकारं सुसंहितम् ॥7 ॥
4.177.m:
one should make it from above twenty palas up to a thousand, according to one's devotion,
consisting of two halves, shaped like a box, well joined together.

4.177.s:
śilpinā vihitaṃ yasmādbrahmāṃḍaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
ayane viṣuve caiva caṃdrādityagrahe tathā .. 8 ..
4.177.d:
शिल्पिना विहितं यस्माद्ब्रह्मांडं सर्वकामदम् ॥
अयने विषुवे चैव चंद्रादित्यग्रहे तथा ॥ 8 ॥
4.177.m:
Because this Cosmic Egg fashioned by an artisan grants all desires,
at a solstice, an equinox, or an eclipse of the moon or the sun,

4.177.s:
anyeṣvapi tu kāleṣu śraddhāvittasamanvitaḥ ..
puṣpamaṃḍapikāṃ kṛtvā tatra saṃsthāpayedbudhaḥ .. 9 ..
4.177.d:
अन्येष्वपि तु कालेषु श्रद्धावित्तसमन्वितः ॥
पुष्पमंडपिकां कृत्वा तत्र संस्थापयेद्बुधः ॥ 9 ॥
4.177.m:
or at other times too, endowed with faith and wealth,
having made a small pavilion of flowers, the wise man should set it up there.

4.177.s:
tiladroṇoparigataṃ kaṃkumakṣodacarcitam ..
vāso yugmena saṃchādya puṣpagandhādhivāsitam .. 4.177.10 ..
4.177.d:
तिलद्रोणोपरिगतं कंकुमक्षोदचर्चितम् ॥
वासो युग्मेन संछाद्य पुष्पगन्धाधिवासितम् ॥ 4.177.10 ॥
4.177.m:
Placed upon a droṇa of sesame seeds, smeared with saffron powder,
covered with a pair of garments, and perfumed with flowers and fragrant unguents,

4.177.s:
tasya dikṣu ca sarvāsu pūrṇakumbhāṃśca vinyaset ..
aṣṭādaśaiva cānyāni droṇamātrāṇyathāharet .. 11 ..
4.177.d:
तस्य दिक्षु च सर्वासु पूर्णकुम्भांश्च विन्यसेत् ॥
अष्टादशैव चान्यानि द्रोणमात्राण्यथाहरेत् ॥ 11 ॥
4.177.m:
in all its directions he should set full jars;
and he should bring eighteen other [measures of grain], each a droṇa.

4.177.s:
gṛhe vā maṃḍape vāpi sthāpayettadvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
pādukopānahacchatrabhājanāsanadarpaṇaiḥ .. 12 ..
4.177.d:
गृहे वा मंडपे वापि स्थापयेत्तद्विचक्षणः ॥
पादुकोपानहच्छत्रभाजनासनदर्पणैः ॥ 12 ॥
4.177.m:
The discerning man should place them in a house or in a pavilion,
provided with wooden sandals, leather shoes, royal parasol, vessels, seats, and mirrors,

4.177.s:
saṃyuktaṃ kārayettatra payasvinyā tathaiva ca ..
kārayetkuṇḍamekaṃ tu hastamātraṃ vidhānataḥ .. 13 ..
4.177.d:
संयुक्तं कारयेत्तत्र पयस्विन्या तथैव च ॥
कारयेत्कुण्डमेकं तु हस्तमात्रं विधानतः ॥ 13 ॥
4.177.m:
and accompanied by a milch cow as well.
He should have a single sacrificial pit made, of one cubit, according to the rule.

4.177.s:
catuścāraṇikāstatra homaṃ kuryurdvijottamāḥ ..
sarvābharaṇasampannā susnātāhatavāsasaḥ .. 14 ..
4.177.d:
चतुश्चारणिकास्तत्र होमं कुर्युर्द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
सर्वाभरणसम्पन्ना सुस्नाताहतवाससः ॥ 14 ॥
4.177.m:
The best of the twice-born, serving the four Vedas, should perform the oblations there,
endowed with all ornaments, well-bathed, and wearing unwashed garments.

4.177.s:
pracareyurdvijāstatra upādhyāyasamanvitāḥ ..
tathā purohitaścaiva rājñā ṣaṣṭho vidhīyate .. 15 ..
4.177.d:
प्रचरेयुर्द्विजास्तत्र उपाध्यायसमन्विताः ॥
तथा पुरोहितश्चैव राज्ञा षष्ठो विधीयते ॥ 15 ॥
4.177.m:
The twice-born should officiate there together with the teacher,
and the family priest is prescribed by the king as the sixth.

4.177.s:
itareṣāṃ tu pañcaiva kuryuryajñamataṃdritāḥ ..
grahayajñavidhānena grahāṇāṃ yajña iṣyate .. 16 ..
4.177.d:
इतरेषां तु पञ्चैव कुर्युर्यज्ञमतंद्रिताः ॥
ग्रहयज्ञविधानेन ग्रहाणां यज्ञ इष्यते ॥ 16 ॥
4.177.m:
For the other [rituals], five [priests] alone, unwearied, should perform the sacrifice;
the sacrifice to the planets is prescribed according to the rite of planetary worship.

4.177.s:
brahmaviṣṇuśivānāṃ ca tannāmnā juhuyāttilān ..
ayutaṃ homayetpaścānmahāvyāhṛtibhirnṛpa .. 17 ..
4.177.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवानां च तन्नाम्ना जुहुयात्तिलान् ॥
अयुतं होमयेत्पश्चान्महाव्याहृतिभिर्नृप ॥ 17 ॥
4.177.m:
And for Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, one should offer sesame seeds into the fire in their name;
then, O king, one should offer ten thousand oblations with the Mahāvyāhṛtis.

4.177.s:
rudrajāpastu kartavyastasyaivānaṃtaraṃ dvijaiḥ ..
tataḥ sarvasamāptau tu snātvā śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ .. 18 ..
4.177.d:
रुद्रजापस्तु कर्तव्यस्तस्यैवानंतरं द्विजैः ॥
ततः सर्वसमाप्तौ तु स्नात्वा शुक्लांबरः शुचिः ॥ 18 ॥
4.177.m:
Immediately after that, the recitation of the Rudra hymns is to be performed by the twice-born;
then, when all is completed, having bathed, dressed in white, and purified,

4.177.s:
brahmāṃḍaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ ..
namo jagatpratiṣṭhāya viśvadhāmne namo'stu te .. 19 ..
4.177.d:
ब्रह्मांडं पूजयेद्भक्त्या गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः ॥
नमो जगत्प्रतिष्ठाय विश्वधाम्ने नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 19 ॥
4.177.m:
with devotion, holding folded hands filled with flowers, one should worship the Cosmic Egg:
'Salutations to the foundation of the world! Salutations to you, the abode of the universe!

4.177.s:
vāṅmayāṃta nimagnāya brahmāṃḍa śubhakṛdbhava ..
brahmāṃḍodaravartīni yāni sattvāni kānicit .. 4.177.20 ..
4.177.d:
वाङ्मयांत निमग्नाय ब्रह्मांड शुभकृद्भव ॥
ब्रह्मांडोदरवर्तीनि यानि सत्त्वानि कानिचित् ॥ 4.177.20 ॥
4.177.m:
To the one immersed in the essence of speech—O Cosmic Egg, be the maker of auspiciousness!
Whatever living beings there are residing within the Cosmic Egg,

4.177.s:
tāni sarvāṇi me tuṣṭiṃ prayacchatvatulāṃ sadā ..
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca lokapālāstathā grahāḥ .. 21 ..
4.177.d:
तानि सर्वाणि मे तुष्टिं प्रयच्छत्वतुलां सदा ॥
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च लोकपालास्तथा ग्रहाः ॥ 21 ॥
4.177.m:
may all of them constantly grant me incomparable satisfaction!
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and the world protectors and the planets,

4.177.s:
nakṣatrāṇi tathā nāgā ṛṣayo marutastathā ..
sarve bhavaṃtu saṃtuṣṭāḥ saptajanmāṃtarāṇi me .. 22 ..
4.177.d:
नक्षत्राणि तथा नागा ऋषयो मरुतस्तथा ॥
सर्वे भवंतु संतुष्टाः सप्तजन्मांतराणि मे ॥ 22 ॥
4.177.m:
the lunar mansions, the nāgas, the sages, and the Maruts—
may all be pleased with me across seven future births!'

4.177.s:
ityuccārya tato dadyādbrahmāṃḍaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
sadakṣiṇaṃ ca taṃ kṛtvā vasu saṃpādayeddvijān ..23..
4.177.d:
इत्युच्चार्य ततो दद्याद्ब्रह्मांडं सर्वकामदम् ॥
सदक्षिणं च तं कृत्वा वसु संपादयेद्द्विजान् ॥23॥
4.177.m:
Having uttered this, he should then bestow the Cosmic Egg, which fulfills all desires;
and having provided it with a sacrificial fee, he should enrich the twice-born with wealth.

4.177.s:
anena vidhinā dattvā yatpuṇyaṃ syānnarottama ..
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama .. 24 ..
4.177.d:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा यत्पुण्यं स्यान्नरोत्तम ॥
तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व गदतो मम ॥ 24 ॥
4.177.m:
What merit accrues from giving according to this rite, O best of men,
that I will proclaim to you; listen to me as I speak.

4.177.s:
āsīdādiyuge rājā sudyumno nāma bhārata ..
nāgāyutabalaḥ śrīmānbahubhṛtyaparicchadaḥ .. 25 ...
4.177.d:
आसीदादियुगे राजा सुद्युम्नो नाम भारत ॥
नागायुतबलः श्रीमान्बहुभृत्यपरिच्छदः ॥ 25 ॥।
4.177.m:
In the first age, O Bhārata, there was a king named Sudyumna,
having the strength of ten thousand elephants, glorious, with many attendants and retinue.

4.177.s:
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi kṛtvā rājyamakaṃṭakam ..
tataḥ saṃsthāpya tanayaṃ rājā rājye vanaṃ yayau .. 26 ..
4.177.d:
त्रिंशद्वर्षसहस्राणि कृत्वा राज्यमकंटकम् ॥
ततः संस्थाप्य तनयं राजा राज्ये वनं ययौ ॥ 26 ॥
4.177.m:
Having ruled the kingdom without a rival for thirty thousand years,
and then having installed his son on the throne, the king went to the forest.

4.177.s:
praviśya ca vanaṃ ghoraṃ tapastīvraṃ cacāra ha ..
adhyātmagatitattvajñaḥ karmakāṃḍaṃ visṛjya ca .. 27 ..
4.177.d:
प्रविश्य च वनं घोरं तपस्तीव्रं चचार ह ॥
अध्यात्मगतितत्त्वज्ञः कर्मकांडं विसृज्य च ॥ 27 ॥
4.177.m:
Having entered the terrible forest, he performed severe asceticism;
knowing the truth of the state of the inner self, and having abandoned the ritual portion of the Veda.

4.177.s:
kālena mahatā rājā diṣṭāṃtamagamatpurā ..
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya nānā vādyaravākulam ..28..
4.177.d:
कालेन महता राजा दिष्टांतमगमत्पुरा ॥
दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य नाना वाद्यरवाकुलम् ॥28॥
4.177.m:
In the course of much time, the king met his appointed end of old;
mounting a divine celestial chariot, echoing with the sounds of various musical instruments,

4.177.s:
atītya śakralokādīnbrahmalokamito gataḥ ..
tasyāsanaṃ dideśātha brahmāsuragaṇairvṛtaḥ .. 29 ..
4.177.d:
अतीत्य शक्रलोकादीन्ब्रह्मलोकमितो गतः ॥
तस्यासनं दिदेशाथ ब्रह्मासुरगणैर्वृतः ॥ 29 ॥
4.177.m:
having passed beyond the world of Śakra and the others, he went from here to the world of Brahmā;
then Brahmā, surrounded by hosts of gods, designated a seat for him,

4.177.s:
divyaṃ kanakacitrāṃgaṃ ratnālaṃkṛtavigraham ..
evaṃ lokavare tasminramamāṇo nṛpottama .. 4.177.30 ..
4.177.d:
दिव्यं कनकचित्रांगं रत्नालंकृतविग्रहम् ॥
एवं लोकवरे तस्मिन्रममाणो नृपोत्तम ॥ 4.177.30 ॥
4.177.m:
divine, its body varied with gold, its form adorned with jewels.
Thus rejoicing in that excellent world, O best of kings,

4.177.s:
āste cānudinaṃ so'tha divyabhogavivarjitaḥ ..
vasatastasya rājñastu śarīraṃ paritapyate .. 31 ..
4.177.d:
आस्ते चानुदिनं सोऽथ दिव्यभोगविवर्जितः ॥
वसतस्तस्य राज्ञस्तु शरीरं परितप्यते ॥ 31 ॥
4.177.m:
he remained day after day, yet devoid of divine enjoyments.
As that king dwelt there, his body was tormented

4.177.s:
bubhukṣayā naraśreṣṭha tathātyaṃtapipāsayā ..
sa pīḍyamāno brahmāṇaṃ kṛtāṃjalirabhāṣata .. 32 ..
4.177.d:
बुभुक्षया नरश्रेष्ठ तथात्यंतपिपासया ॥
स पीड्यमानो ब्रह्माणं कृतांजलिरभाषत ॥ 32 ॥
4.177.m:
by hunger, O best of men, and by extreme thirst.
He, being tormented, spoke to Brahmā with folded hands:

4.177.s:
bhagavanbrahmaloko'yaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ ..
atra sthitaṃ ca māṃ deva kṣuttṛṣṇā ca prabādhate .. 33 ..
4.177.d:
भगवन्ब्रह्मलोकोऽयं सर्वदोषविवर्जितः ॥
अत्र स्थितं च मां देव क्षुत्तृष्णा च प्रबाधते ॥ 33 ॥
4.177.m:
'O Blessed One, this world of Brahmā is free from all defects;
yet while I dwell here, O god, hunger and thirst afflict me.

4.177.s:
kena karma vipākena kṣudhā me nāpasarpati..
brahmaloke gatasyāpi saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi ..34..
4.177.d:
केन कर्म विपाकेन क्षुधा मे नापसर्पति॥
ब्रह्मलोके गतस्यापि संशयं छेत्तुमर्हसि ॥34॥
4.177.m:
By the ripening of what deed does my hunger not depart,
even though I have gone to the world of Brahmā? You ought to dispel my doubt.'

4.177.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
tvayā hi kurvatā rājyaṃ puṣṭānyaṃgāni pārthiva ..
naiva dattaṃ tu bahulamātmavādaratena vai .. 35 ..
4.177.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥
त्वया हि कुर्वता राज्यं पुष्टान्यंगानि पार्थिव ॥
नैव दत्तं तु बहुलमात्मवादरतेन वै ॥ 35 ॥

4.177.s:
dānaṃ baṃdhātmakaṃ matvā tasmāddattaṃ tvayā na hi ..
jñānādbrahmapadaṃ prāptamadānātkṣutprabādhate .. 36 ..
4.177.d:
दानं बंधात्मकं मत्वा तस्माद्दत्तं त्वया न हि ॥
ज्ञानाद्ब्रह्मपदं प्राप्तमदानात्क्षुत्प्रबाधते ॥ 36 ॥
4.177.m:
Thinking gift-giving to be of the nature of bondage, it was therefore not given by you.
Through knowledge the realm of Brahmā was attained, but through non-giving hunger afflicts you.'

4.177.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
bhagavaṃstṛṣāpanuttiḥ syātkathaṃ me parameśvara ..
upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi .. 37 ..
4.177.d:
॥ राजोवाच ॥ ॥
भगवंस्तृषापनुत्तिः स्यात्कथं मे परमेश्वर ॥
उपदेशप्रदानेन प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥ 37 ॥
4.177.m:
The king said:
'O Blessed One, how might the removal of my thirst come about, O supreme lord?
You ought to show favor by imparting instruction.'

4.177.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
bhūyo gatvā mahīṃ rājanbrahmāṃḍaṃ sārvakāmikam ..
prayaccha dvijamukhyānāṃ tena tṛptimavāpsyasi .. 38 ..
4.177.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥
भूयो गत्वा महीं राजन्ब्रह्मांडं सार्वकामिकम् ॥
प्रयच्छ द्विजमुख्यानां तेन तृप्तिमवाप्स्यसि ॥ 38 ॥
4.177.m:
Brahmā said:
'Going again to the earth, O king, bestow the Cosmic Egg that grants all desires
upon the foremost of the twice-born; through that you will attain satisfaction.'

4.177.s:
ityuktaḥ samyagāgatya martyalokaṃ mahīpatiḥ ..
brahmāṃḍaṃ tu vidhānena brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradattavān .. 39 ..
4.177.d:
इत्युक्तः सम्यगागत्य मर्त्यलोकं महीपतिः ॥
ब्रह्मांडं तु विधानेन ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदत्तवान् ॥ 39 ॥
4.177.m:
Having been spoken to thus, the ruler of the earth duly came to the mortal world,
and gave the Cosmic Egg to the brāhmaṇas according to the ritual.

4.177.s:
sa jagāma punaḥ svargaṃ lebhe tṛptiṃ ca śāśvatīm..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mahādānasya yatphalam .. 4.177.40 ..
4.177.d:
स जगाम पुनः स्वर्गं लेभे तृप्तिं च शाश्वतीम्॥
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं महादानस्य यत्फलम् ॥ 4.177.40 ॥
4.177.m:
He went to heaven again and obtained eternal satisfaction.
All this has been related to you: the fruit of this great gift.

4.177.s:
brahmāṃḍaṃ yaḥ prayaccheta tena dattaṃ carācaram ..
saptāvarānsapta parānsapta caiva parāvarān.. 41 ..
4.177.d:
ब्रह्मांडं यः प्रयच्छेत तेन दत्तं चराचरम् ॥
सप्तावरान्सप्त परान्सप्त चैव परावरान्॥ 41 ॥
4.177.m:
Whoever gives the Cosmic Egg, by him all that is moving and unmoving has been given.
Seven descendants, seven ancestors, and seven higher and lower descendants,

4.177.s:
tārayetkulajāndattvā bhaviṣyāṃśca na saṃśayaḥ ..
manvaṃtarāṇi ṣaṭtriśadbrahmaloke mahīyate .. 42 ..
4.177.d:
तारयेत्कुलजान्दत्त्वा भविष्यांश्च न संशयः ॥
मन्वंतराणि षट्त्रिशद्ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ॥ 42 ॥
4.177.m:
and future ones born in his family, he redeems by giving it, without a doubt.
For thirty-six manvantaras he is exalted in the world of Brahmā.

4.177.s:
punarmānuṣyamabhyetya dhārmiko jāyate kule ..
na dāridyaṃ na ca vyādhiṃ viyogaṃ naiva paśyati .. 43 ..
4.177.d:
पुनर्मानुष्यमभ्येत्य धार्मिको जायते कुले ॥
न दारिद्यं न च व्याधिं वियोगं नैव पश्यति ॥ 43 ॥
4.177.m:
Entering the human state again, he is born righteous in an [honorable] family;
he sees neither poverty nor disease, nor separation.

4.177.s:
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ..
yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā bhaktānāṃ śrāvayecca yaḥ .. 44 ..
4.177.d:
नारी वा पुरुषो वापि दानस्यास्य प्रभावतः ॥
यश्चैतच्छृणुयाद्भक्त्या भक्तानां श्रावयेच्च यः ॥ 44 ॥
4.177.m:
A woman or a man, through the power of this gift,
and whoever hears this with devotion, and whoever causes the devoted to hear it,

4.177.s: so'pi sadgatimāpnoti kiṃ punaryaḥ prayacchati .. 45 ..
4.177.d: सोऽपि सद्गतिमाप्नोति किं पुनर्यः प्रयच्छति ॥ 45 ॥
4.177.m: he too attains a good state, how much more so the one who gives it!

4.177.s:
brahmāṃḍakhaṃḍayugalaṃ sakulācalaṃ ca digbhāgasāgarasarovarasiddhajuṣṭam ..
diksaṃkhyayā guṇavatāṃ dvijasattamānāṃ dattvā pumānpadamupaiti pitāmahasya .. 46 ..
kalpavṛkṣadānavidhivarṇanam
4.177.d:
ब्रह्मांडखंडयुगलं सकुलाचलं च दिग्भागसागरसरोवरसिद्धजुष्टम् ॥
दिक्संख्यया गुणवतां द्विजसत्तमानां दत्त्वा पुमान्पदमुपैति पितामहस्य ॥ 46 ॥
कल्पवृक्षदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.177.m:
Having given the pair of hemispheres of the Cosmic Egg, along with the principal mountains, / frequented by the directions, oceans, lakes, and siddhas, / to the number of the directions of virtuous twice-born men, / a man attains the realm of the Grandfather.
Description of the Rite of Giving the Wish-Granting Tree

4.178.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
bhagavāñchaṃkaraḥ pūrvaṃ kṛtodvāho mayā saha ..
ramamāṇastayā sārddhaṃ bahuvarṣagaṇānsthitaḥ .. 1 ..
4.178.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवाञ्छंकरः पूर्वं कृतोद्वाहो मया सह ॥
रममाणस्तया सार्द्धं बहुवर्षगणान्स्थितः ॥ 1 ॥

4.178.s:
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve paraṃ trāsamupāgatāḥ ..
tayorapatyasya bhayāttameva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 2 ..
4.178.d:
ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे परं त्रासमुपागताः ॥
तयोरपत्यस्य भयात्तमेव शरणं गताः ॥ 2 ॥
4.178.m:
Then all the hosts of gods were seized with great dread;
out of fear of their offspring, they sought refuge in him alone—

4.178.s:
vaiśvānaramukhā devā mahādevaṃ trilocanam ..
prasannaścābhavatteṣāṃ vibudhānāṃ trilocanaḥ .. 3 ..
4.178.d:
वैश्वानरमुखा देवा महादेवं त्रिलोचनम् ॥
प्रसन्नश्चाभवत्तेषां विबुधानां त्रिलोचनः ॥ 3 ॥
4.178.m:
the gods headed by Agni, [sought refuge in] Mahādeva, the three-eyed one;
and the three-eyed one was pleased with those deities.

4.178.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kiṃ bhītāstridaśāḥ sarve kaṃ varaṃ ca dadāmi vaḥ ..
mayi prasanne vibudhā durlabhaṃ hi na kiṃcana .. 4 ..
4.178.d:
॥ ईश्वर उवाच ॥ ॥
किं भीतास्त्रिदशाः सर्वे कं वरं च ददामि वः ॥
मयि प्रसन्ने विबुधा दुर्लभं हि न किंचन ॥ 4 ॥
4.178.m:
The Lord said:
'Why are all the gods frightened, and what boon shall I grant you?
When I am pleased, O gods, nothing indeed is difficult to attain.'

4.178.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
bhagavaṃstava saṃyogātpārvatyā saha śaṃkara ..
mogho bhavatu deveśa bhītāḥ sma tanayasya te ..5 ..
4.178.d:
॥ देवा ऊचुः ॥ ॥
भगवंस्तव संयोगात्पार्वत्या सह शंकर ॥
मोघो भवतु देवेश भीताः स्म तनयस्य ते ॥5 ॥
4.178.m:
The gods said:
'O Blessed One, may your union with Pārvatī
be fruitless, O Śaṅkara, O lord of the gods! We are terrified of your son.

4.178.s:
anapatyaśca deveśa bhava bhūtapate sadā ..
aśaktāḥ sma vayaṃ sarve bhavadojo vidhāraṇe .. 6 ..
4.178.d:
अनपत्यश्च देवेश भव भूतपते सदा ॥
अशक्ताः स्म वयं सर्वे भवदोजो विधारणे ॥ 6 ॥
4.178.m:
And remain childless forever, O lord of the gods, O lord of beings!
We are all powerless to bear your splendor.'

4.178.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
ataḥ prabhṛtyahaṃ devā ūrdhvaretā vyavasthitaḥ ..
sthāṇuvacca sthitaścāsmi nāma caitadbhaviṣyati .. 7 ..
4.178.d:
॥ श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥ ॥
अतः प्रभृत्यहं देवा ऊर्ध्वरेता व्यवस्थितः ॥
स्थाणुवच्च स्थितश्चास्मि नाम चैतद्भविष्यति ॥ 7 ॥

4.178.s:
tataḥ kruddhā umā teṣāṃ devānāṃ vākyamabravīt ..
vitathaṃ putrajaṃ saukhyaṃ bhavadbhirme kṛtaṃ surāḥ .. 8 ..
4.178.d:
ततः क्रुद्धा उमा तेषां देवानां वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
वितथं पुत्रजं सौख्यं भवद्भिर्मे कृतं सुराः ॥ 8 ॥
4.178.m:
Then Umā, angered, spoke a word to those gods:
'The happiness born of a son has been rendered futile for me by you, O gods!

4.178.s:
yasmāttasmādbhavaṃto'pi na putrāñjanayiṣyatha ..
tataḥ prabhṛti vai devāḥ prasūyaṃte na bhūpate .. 9 ..
4.178.d:
यस्मात्तस्माद्भवंतोऽपि न पुत्राञ्जनयिष्यथ ॥
ततः प्रभृति वै देवाः प्रसूयंते न भूपते ॥ 9 ॥
4.178.m:
Therefore, you also will not beget sons.'
From then on, O ruler of the earth, the gods indeed do not procreate.

4.178.s:
dattvā śāpaṃ tato devī devānāmāha śaṃkaram ..
putrajanma mayā prāptaṃ na tāvajjagataḥ pate .. 4.178.10 ..
4.178.d:
दत्त्वा शापं ततो देवी देवानामाह शंकरम् ॥
पुत्रजन्म मया प्राप्तं न तावज्जगतः पते ॥ 4.178.10 ॥
4.178.m:
Having then pronounced the curse on the gods, the goddess said to Śaṅkara:
'The birth of a son has not been attained by me, O lord of the world!'

4.178.s:
aputrasya gatirnāsti itīyaṃ śrūyate śrutiḥ ..
tadādiśa mahābhāga lokadvayahitaṃ prabho .. 11 ..
4.178.d:
अपुत्रस्य गतिर्नास्ति इतीयं श्रूयते श्रुतिः ॥
तदादिश महाभाग लोकद्वयहितं प्रभो ॥ 11 ॥
4.178.m:
"There is no destination for the sonless"—so runs this Vedic text.
Therefore instruct me, fortunate one, in what benefits both worlds, O Lord.

4.178.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
aputraḥ puruṣo yaśca nārī vā parvatātmaje ..
sauvarṇastena dātavyaḥ kalpavṛkṣo guṇānvitaḥ .. 12 ..
4.178.d:
॥ भगवानुवाच ॥ ॥
अपुत्रः पुरुषो यश्च नारी वा पर्वतात्मजे ॥
सौवर्णस्तेन दातव्यः कल्पवृक्षो गुणान्वितः ॥ 12 ॥
4.178.m:
The Blessed Lord said:
A sonless man, or a woman, O daughter of the mountain,
should give a golden wishing-tree endowed with [all] qualities.

4.178.s:
kṛtrimaṃ vāpi gṛhṇīyādvṛkṣaṃ vā sthāvarādikam ..
jātaputro'tha vā putraḥ putratve parikalpayet..13..
4.178.d:
कृत्रिमं वापि गृह्णीयाद्वृक्षं वा स्थावरादिकम् ॥
जातपुत्रोऽथ वा पुत्रः पुत्रत्वे परिकल्पयेत्॥13॥
4.178.m:
Or one may take an artificial [image] or an actual tree, immovable and so forth,
and whether one has sons or not, adopt it as a son.

4.178.s:
tena putravatāṃ lokā devi tasya na saṃśayaḥ ..
kalpavṛkṣastu kartavyaḥ śuddhakāṃcanasaṃbhavaḥ .. 14 ..
4.178.d:
तेन पुत्रवतां लोका देवि तस्य न संशयः ॥
कल्पवृक्षस्तु कर्तव्यः शुद्धकांचनसंभवः ॥ 14 ॥
4.178.m:
Through that, O goddess, the worlds of those possessing sons are attained by him, without doubt.
The wishing-tree, however, should be fashioned out of pure gold,

4.178.s:
bahuśākhaḥ suvarṇāṃgopyanekakusumānvitaḥ ..
mahāskaṃdhasvarūpaśca ratnālaṃkṛtavigrahaḥ .. 15 ..
4.178.d:
बहुशाखः सुवर्णांगोप्यनेककुसुमान्वितः ॥
महास्कंधस्वरूपश्च रत्नालंकृतविग्रहः ॥ 15 ॥
4.178.m:
having many branches, its body of gold, endowed with numerous blossoms,
having the form of a great trunk, its frame adorned with jewels.

4.178.s:
phalāni tasya divyāni sauvarṇāni prakalpayet ..
kuryāviṃśatpalādūrddhvaṃ śaktyā vā nṛpasattama .. 16 ..
4.178.d:
फलानि तस्य दिव्यानि सौवर्णानि प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
कुर्याविंशत्पलादूर्द्ध्वं शक्त्या वा नृपसत्तम ॥ 16 ॥
4.178.m:
One should fashion divine fruits for it out of gold.
One should make it of twenty palas or more, or according to one's capacity, O best of kings.

4.178.s:
dānametatpradātavyaṃ rājataṃ caivamuttamam ..
pravālāṃkurasaṃchannaṃ muktādāmāvalaṃbitam .. 17 ..
4.178.d:
दानमेतत्प्रदातव्यं राजतं चैवमुत्तमम् ॥
प्रवालांकुरसंछन्नं मुक्तादामावलंबितम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.178.m:
This excellent gift should also be provided with silver,
covered with sprouts of coral, and hanging with strings of pearls.

4.178.s:
catuṣkoṇeṣu kurvīta caturaḥ kāṃcanadrumān ..
suvarṇasya pramāṇaṃ ca kathayāmi varānane .. 18 ..
4.178.d:
चतुष्कोणेषु कुर्वीत चतुरः कांचनद्रुमान् ॥
सुवर्णस्य प्रमाणं च कथयामि वरानने ॥ 18 ॥
4.178.m:
At the four corners one should place four golden trees.
And I shall tell the weight of the gold, O fair-faced lady:

4.178.s:
sahasreṇa tadarddhena tasyāpyarddhena vā punaḥ ..
nadyāstīre gṛhe vāpi devatāyatane tathā..19..
4.178.d:
सहस्रेण तदर्द्धेन तस्याप्यर्द्धेन वा पुनः ॥
नद्यास्तीरे गृहे वापि देवतायतने तथा॥19॥
4.178.m:
by a thousand [palas], or half of that, or again half of that.
On the bank of a river, or in a house, or in a temple of the gods,

4.178.s:
prāgudakpravaṇe deśe maṃḍapaṃ tatra kārayet ..
daśahastapramāṇena daśahastāśca vedikāḥ .. 4.178.20 ..
4.178.d:
प्रागुदक्प्रवणे देशे मंडपं तत्र कारयेत् ॥
दशहस्तप्रमाणेन दशहस्ताश्च वेदिकाः ॥ 4.178.20 ॥
4.178.m:
in a place sloping towards the north-east, one should erect a pavilion there,
measuring ten cubits, and platforms of ten cubits.

4.178.s:
hastamātrapramāṇena kuṃḍamekaṃ suśobhanam ..
āgneyyāṃ kārayedrājanmekhalāmupalepanam .. 21 ..
4.178.d:
हस्तमात्रप्रमाणेन कुंडमेकं सुशोभनम् ॥
आग्नेय्यां कारयेद्राजन्मेखलामुपलेपनम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.178.m:
Measuring just a single cubit, one very beautiful sacrificial pit
one should have made in the south-east, O king, with rims and smeared [with cowdung].

4.178.s:
tatra vai brāhmaṇā yojyā ṛgyajuḥsāmapāṭhakāḥ ..
upadeṣṭā ca tatraiva tṛtīyaḥ paṃcamo'tha vā .. .. 22 ..
4.178.d:
तत्र वै ब्राह्मणा योज्या ऋग्यजुःसामपाठकाः ॥
उपदेष्टा च तत्रैव तृतीयः पंचमोऽथ वा ॥ ॥ 22 ॥
4.178.m:
There, indeed, Brahmins who recite the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas must be employed,
and an instructor right there as the third, or as the fifth.

4.178.s:
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāstāmrapatradvayānvitāḥ ..
anuliptāścaṃdanena vastramālyādibhūṣitāḥ .. 23 ..
4.178.d:
सर्वाभरणसंपन्नास्ताम्रपत्रद्वयान्विताः ॥
अनुलिप्ताश्चंदनेन वस्त्रमाल्यादिभूषिताः ॥ 23 ॥
4.178.m:
Endowed with all ornaments, provided with two copper vessels,
anointed with sandalwood paste, adorned with garments, garlands, and so forth,

4.178.s:
guḍaprasthopariṣṭācca sthāpayetkalpapādapam ..
brahmaviṣṇuśivopetaṃ paṃcaśākhaṃ sabhāskaram .. 24 ..
4.178.d:
गुडप्रस्थोपरिष्टाच्च स्थापयेत्कल्पपादपम् ॥
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवोपेतं पंचशाखं सभास्करम् ॥ 24 ॥
4.178.m:
upon a prastha of molasses one should set the wishing-tree,
endowed with Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, having five branches, accompanied by the Sun.

4.178.s:
kāmadevamadhastācca sakalatra prayojayet ..
saṃtānaṃ saha gāyatryā pūrvato lavaṇopari .. 25 ..
4.178.d:
कामदेवमधस्ताच्च सकलत्र प्रयोजयेत् ॥
संतानं सह गायत्र्या पूर्वतो लवणोपरि ॥ 25 ॥
4.178.m:
And underneath one should place Kāmadeva together with his wife;
the Saṃtāna tree together with Gāyatrī to the east, upon salt;

4.178.s:
maṃdāraṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve śriyā saha tathā ghṛte ..
paścime pārijātaṃ tu umayā saha pādapam .. 26 ..
4.178.d:
मंदारं दक्षिणे पार्श्वे श्रिया सह तथा घृते ॥
पश्चिमे पारिजातं तु उमया सह पादपम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.178.m:
the Mandāra on the southern side together with Śrī, likewise upon ghee;
to the west the Pārijāta tree together with Umā;

4.178.s:
surabhīsaṃyutaṃ tadvattileṣu haricaṃdanam ..
kauśeyavastrasaṃyuktānikṣumālyaphalānvitān.. 27 ..
4.178.d:
सुरभीसंयुतं तद्वत्तिलेषु हरिचंदनम् ॥
कौशेयवस्त्रसंयुक्तानिक्षुमाल्यफलान्वितान्॥ 27 ॥
4.178.m:
likewise the Haricandana joined with Surabhi upon sesame seeds;
clothed in silk garments, provided with sugarcane, garlands, and fruits.

4.178.s:
tathāṣṭau pūrṇakalaśānsamaṃtātparikalpayet ..
agnipraṇayanaṃ kṛtvā adhivāsya ca pādapān .. 28 ..
4.178.d:
तथाष्टौ पूर्णकलशान्समंतात्परिकल्पयेत् ॥
अग्निप्रणयनं कृत्वा अधिवास्य च पादपान् ॥ 28 ॥
4.178.m:
Likewise, one should arrange eight full water-pots on all sides.
Having brought forward the fire, and having consecrated the trees,

4.178.s:
dhānyāni caiva sarvāṇi samaṃtātparikalpayet ..
nānā bhakṣyāṇi naivedyaṃ sarvaṃ tatra niyojayet .. 29 ..
4.178.d:
धान्यानि चैव सर्वाणि समंतात्परिकल्पयेत् ॥
नाना भक्ष्याणि नैवेद्यं सर्वं तत्र नियोजयेत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.178.m:
one should also arrange all grains completely around.
