Various eatables and food offerings—one should present all that there.

4.178.s:
dīpamālā vicitrāśca jvālayeta samaṃtataḥ ..
maṃtreṇa yojayitvā tā mayoktena varānane .. 4.178.30 ..
4.178.d:
दीपमाला विचित्राश्च ज्वालयेत समंततः ॥
मंत्रेण योजयित्वा ता मयोक्तेन वरानने ॥ 4.178.30 ॥
4.178.m:
And one should kindle variegated rows of lamps on every side.
Having joined them with the mantra spoken by me, O fair-faced lady:

4.178.s:
kāmadastvaṃ hi devānāṃ kāmavṛkṣastataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
mayā saṃpūjito bhaktyā pūrayasva manorathān .. .. 31 ..
4.178.d:
कामदस्त्वं हि देवानां कामवृक्षस्ततः स्मृतः ॥
मया संपूजितो भक्त्या पूरयस्व मनोरथान् ॥ ॥ 31 ॥
4.178.m:
"You grant the wishes of the gods; therefore you are remembered as the wishing-tree.
Worshipped by me with devotion, fulfill my desires!"

4.178.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet ..
śaṃkhavāditranirghoṣairvedadhvanivimiśritaiḥ .. 32 ..
4.178.d:
एवं संपूज्य विधिना जागरं तत्र कारयेत् ॥
शंखवादित्रनिर्घोषैर्वेदध्वनिविमिश्रितैः ॥ 32 ॥
4.178.m:
Having worshipped thus according to the rules, one should hold a night-vigil there,
with the sounds of conches and musical instruments mingled with Vedic chants.

4.178.s:
homaṃ ca brāhmaṇāḥ kuryurmadgatenāṃtarātmanā ..
āghārāvājyabhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 33 ..
4.178.d:
होमं च ब्राह्मणाः कुर्युर्मद्गतेनांतरात्मना ॥
आघारावाज्यभागौ तु पूर्वं हुत्वा विचक्षणः ॥ 33 ॥
4.178.m:
And the Brahmins should perform the fire sacrifice, their inner self fixed on me.
The wise one, having first offered the two libations and the two portions of clarified butter,

4.178.s:
talliṃgaiḥ sthāpitāndevānhomenāpyāyayettataḥ ..
mahāvyāhṛtibhiścaiva homaṃ kuryustataḥ param .. .. 34 ..
4.178.d:
तल्लिंगैः स्थापितान्देवान्होमेनाप्याययेत्ततः ॥
महाव्याहृतिभिश्चैव होमं कुर्युस्ततः परम् ॥ ॥ 34 ॥
4.178.m:
should then gratify the installed gods with the fire sacrifice using their characteristic mantras.
After that, they should perform the fire sacrifice with the great sacred utterances.

4.178.s:
ayutena bhavetsiddhiryajñasya varavarṇini ..
tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya snātvā śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ .. 35 ..
4.178.d:
अयुतेन भवेत्सिद्धिर्यज्ञस्य वरवर्णिनि ॥
ततः प्रभाते चोत्थाय स्नात्वा शुक्लांबरः शुचिः ॥ 35 ॥
4.178.m:
With ten thousand [oblations], perfection of the sacrifice is attained, O fair-complexioned lady.
Then, rising at dawn, having bathed, wearing white garments, pure,

4.178.s:
dadyātparvasamīpe tu kalpavṛkṣaṃ sada kṣiṇam ..
triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 36 ..
4.178.d:
दद्यात्पर्वसमीपे तु कल्पवृक्षं सद क्षिणम् ॥
त्रिःप्रदक्षिणमावृत्य मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥ 36 ॥
4.178.m:
near the festival time one should give the wishing-tree together with a sacrificial fee.
Circumambulating three times clockwise, one should recite this mantra:

4.178.s:
namaste kalpavṛkṣāya vitatārthapradāya ca ..
viśvaṃbharāya devāya namaste viśvamūrtaye .. .. 37 ..
4.178.d:
नमस्ते कल्पवृक्षाय विततार्थप्रदाय च ॥
विश्वंभराय देवाय नमस्ते विश्वमूर्तये ॥ ॥ 37 ॥
4.178.m:
"Homage to you, the wishing-tree, the giver of boundless desires,
the god who sustains all, homage to you whose form is the universe!

4.178.s:
yasmāttvameva viśvātmā brahmasthāṇudivākarāḥ ..
mūrtāmūrtaparaṃ bījamataḥ pāhi sanātana ..38..
4.178.d:
यस्मात्त्वमेव विश्वात्मा ब्रह्मस्थाणुदिवाकराः ॥
मूर्तामूर्तपरं बीजमतः पाहि सनातन ॥38॥
4.178.m:
Because you yourself are the universal Self, Brahmā, Sthāṇu, and the Sun,
the highest seed of the manifest and the unmanifest—therefore protect me, O eternal one!"

4.178.s:
evamāmantrya taṃ dṛṣṭvā gurave kalpapādapam ..
caturbhyaścāpi ṛtvigbhyaḥ sāmaṃtādīnprakalpayet .. 39 ..
4.178.d:
एवमामन्त्र्य तं दृष्ट्वा गुरवे कल्पपादपम् ॥
चतुर्भ्यश्चापि ऋत्विग्भ्यः सामंतादीन्प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 39 ॥
4.178.m:
Having addressed it thus and beheld the wishing-tree, [he gives it] to the guru,
and should assign the surrounding [trees] to the four priests.

4.178.s:
anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati ..
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ devi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama.. .. 4.178.40 ..
4.178.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ॥
तस्य पुण्यफलं देवि शृणुष्व गदतो मम॥ ॥ 4.178.40 ॥
4.178.m:
He who bestows this gift according to this rule—
hear from me as I proclaim the fruit of his merit, O goddess:

4.178.s:
vimānavaramāruhya sūryatejaḥsamaprabham ..
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ kiṃkiṇījālamālitam .. 41 ..
4.178.d:
विमानवरमारुह्य सूर्यतेजःसमप्रभम् ॥
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णं किंकिणीजालमालितम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.178.m:
Mounting an excellent celestial chariot shining like the radiance of the sun,
crowded with hosts of apsarases, garlanded with nets of tinkling bells,

4.178.s:
yāti lokaṃ sureśasya sarvabādhāvivarji tam..
punaḥ karmakṣitāvetya jāyate śrotriye kule .. 42 ..
4.178.d:
याति लोकं सुरेशस्य सर्वबाधाविवर्जि तम्॥
पुनः कर्मक्षितावेत्य जायते श्रोत्रिये कुले ॥ 42 ॥
4.178.m:
he goes to the world of the lord of gods, free from all afflictions.
Returning again to the earth of action, he is born in a family learned in the Veda.

4.178.s:
yajvā śūro'pi vidvāṃśca naro bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
punaraṃte prāpnuyādvai lokaṃ devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ .. 43 .. ..
4.178.d:
यज्वा शूरोऽपि विद्वांश्च नरो भवति धार्मिकः ॥
पुनरंते प्राप्नुयाद्वै लोकं देवस्य शार्ङ्गिणः ॥ 43 ॥ ॥
4.178.m:
A sacrificer, a hero, and a learned man, he becomes a righteous person.
At the end, he surely attains the world of the god who bears the Śārṅga bow.

4.178.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde kalpavṛkṣadānavidhivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatyuttaraśatata mo'dhyāyaḥ ... 178 ..
kalpalatādānavidhivarṇanam
4.178.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे कल्पवृक्षदानविधिवर्णनं नामाष्टसप्तत्युत्तरशतत मोऽध्यायः ॥। 178 ॥
कल्पलतादानविधिवर्णनम्
4.178.m:
Thus, in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa, in the Uttaraparvan, in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, the one hundred and seventy-eighth chapter, named "Description of the Rite of Giving the Wishing-Tree."
Description of the Rite of Giving the Wishing-Creeper

4.179.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavansarvabhūteśa sarvalokanamaskṛta ..
anugrahāya lokānāṃ kathayasva mamāparam .. 1 ...
4.179.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्सर्वभूतेश सर्वलोकनमस्कृत ॥
अनुग्रहाय लोकानां कथयस्व ममापरम् ॥ 1 ॥।

4.179.s:
niṣpāpo jāyate yena āyuṣā yaśasā śriyā ..
tanme kathaya deveśa dānaṃ vratamathāpi vā .. 2 ..
4.179.d:
निष्पापो जायते येन आयुषा यशसा श्रिया ॥
तन्मे कथय देवेश दानं व्रतमथापि वा ॥ 2 ॥
4.179.m:
by which one becomes free from sin, endowed with longevity, fame, and fortune;
tell me that, O Lord of gods, whether a gift or a votive observance.

4.179.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi tava lokahitepsayā ..
yenopāyena jāyaṃte sabhāgyā mānavā bhuvi .. 3 ..
4.179.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि तव लोकहितेप्सया ॥
येनोपायेन जायंते सभाग्या मानवा भुवि ॥ 3 ॥
4.179.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Listen, O king, I shall tell you out of a desire for the welfare of the world,
by which means mortals become fortunate on earth.

4.179.s:
na vratairnopavāsaiśca na tīrthagamanairapi ..
mahāpathādimaraṇairna yajñairna śrutena ca .. 4 ..
4.179.d:
न व्रतैर्नोपवासैश्च न तीर्थगमनैरपि ॥
महापथादिमरणैर्न यज्ञैर्न श्रुतेन च ॥ 4 ॥
4.179.m:
Not by votive observances, nor by fasts, nor even by visits to sacred sites,
not by dying on the great journey and the like, not by sacrifices, nor by sacred learning,

4.179.s:
prāpyate mama loko'yaṃ duṣprāpyastridaśairapi ..
pārtha snehānmahābhāga pravakṣyāmi hitaṃ tava .. 5 ..
4.179.d:
प्राप्यते मम लोकोऽयं दुष्प्राप्यस्त्रिदशैरपि ॥
पार्थ स्नेहान्महाभाग प्रवक्ष्यामि हितं तव ॥ 5 ॥
4.179.m:
is this world of mine attained, which is hard to reach even by the thirty [gods].
O son of Pṛthā, out of affection, fortunate one, I shall tell what is beneficial for you.

4.179.s:
vakṣye kalpalatādānaṃ śobhanaṃ vidhipūrvakam ..
sarvaṃ pūrvavidhānaṃ ca tatra tantre prakalpayet .. 6 ..
4.179.d:
वक्ष्ये कल्पलतादानं शोभनं विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
सर्वं पूर्वविधानं च तत्र तन्त्रे प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 6 ॥
4.179.m:
I shall describe the auspicious gift of the wishing-creeper according to the rules.
And all the previous procedure one should arrange in that rite.

4.179.s:
dikpālebhyo baliṃ tatra kṣipedvai vidhipūrvakam ..
āghārāvājyabhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 7 ..
4.179.d:
दिक्पालेभ्यो बलिं तत्र क्षिपेद्वै विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
आघारावाज्यभागौ तु पूर्वं हुत्वा विचक्षणः ॥ 7 ॥
4.179.m:
One should throw the offering to the guardians of the directions there according to rule.
The wise one, having first offered the two libations and the two portions of clarified butter,

4.179.s:
tato grahamakhaṃ kuryāddhomaṃ vyāhṛtibhistataḥ ..
ayutenaiva homasya samāptiriha kathyate .. 8 ..
4.179.d:
ततो ग्रहमखं कुर्याद्धोमं व्याहृतिभिस्ततः ॥
अयुतेनैव होमस्य समाप्तिरिह कथ्यते ॥ 8 ॥
4.179.m:
should then perform the planetary sacrifice, and then the fire sacrifice with the sacred utterances.
The completion of the fire sacrifice is declared to be with ten thousand [oblations].

4.179.s:
tataḥ sarvasamīpe tu snātaḥ śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ ..
puṣpadhūpairathābhyarcya vāsobhiḥ saphalākṣataiḥ ..
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya maṃtrānetānudīrayet .. 9 ..
4.179.d:
ततः सर्वसमीपे तु स्नातः शुक्लांबरः शुचिः ॥
पुष्पधूपैरथाभ्यर्च्य वासोभिः सफलाक्षतैः ॥
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य मंत्रानेतानुदीरयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
4.179.m:
Then near everything, bathed, wearing white garments, pure,
having worshipped with flowers and incense, with garments, along with fruits and unbroken grains,
then having circumambulated clockwise, one should utter these mantras:

4.179.s:
namo namaḥ pāpavināśinībhyo brahmāṃḍalokeśvarapālanībhyaḥ ..
āśāśatādhikyaphalapradābhyo digbhyastathā kalpalatāvadhūbhyaḥ .. 4.179.10 ..
4.179.d:
नमो नमः पापविनाशिनीभ्यो ब्रह्मांडलोकेश्वरपालनीभ्यः ॥
आशाशताधिक्यफलप्रदाभ्यो दिग्भ्यस्तथा कल्पलतावधूभ्यः ॥ 4.179.10 ॥
4.179.m: “Homage, homage to the destroyers of sin, the protectresses of the universe’s worlds and rulers, / to the directions who bestow fruits exceeding hundreds of hopes, and likewise to the wishing-vine brides!

4.179.s:
yā yasya śaktiḥ paramā pradiṣṭā vede purāṇe surasattamasya ..
tāṃ pūjayāmīha pareṇa sāmnā sā me śubhaṃ yacchatu tāṃ nato'smi .. 11 ..
4.179.d:
या यस्य शक्तिः परमा प्रदिष्टा वेदे पुराणे सुरसत्तमस्य ॥
तां पूजयामीह परेण साम्ना सा मे शुभं यच्छतु तां नतोऽस्मि ॥ 11 ॥
4.179.m: Whichever supreme power of whichever best of gods is proclaimed in the Veda and the Purāṇa, / that [power] I worship here with highest praise; may she grant me good fortune; to her I bow.”

4.179.s:
evamuccārya tāḥ sarvā brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet ..
daśāśāḥ parayā bhaktyā tāstāḥ saṃkalpya cetasi .. 12 ..
4.179.d:
एवमुच्चार्य ताः सर्वा ब्राह्मणेभ्यो निवेदयेत् ॥
दशाशाः परया भक्त्या तास्ताः संकल्प्य चेतसि ॥ 12 ॥
4.179.m: Having spoken thus, with supreme devotion he should present them all to the brāhmaṇas, / having dedicated those ten directions in his mind.

4.179.s:
tataḥ kṣamāpayedviprānpraṇipatya sadakṣiṇān ..
anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati .. 13 ..
4.179.d:
ततः क्षमापयेद्विप्रान्प्रणिपत्य सदक्षिणान् ॥
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ॥ 13 ॥
4.179.m: Then, bowing down, he should ask the brāhmaṇas’ forgiveness, [providing them] with sacrificial fees. / But he who gives this gift according to this rite—

4.179.s:
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājankathyamānaṃ nibodha me ..
iha loke sa vijayī dhanavānputravānbhavet .. 14 ..
4.179.d:
तस्य पुण्यफलं राजन्कथ्यमानं निबोध मे ॥
इह लोके स विजयी धनवान्पुत्रवान्भवेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.179.m: learn from me, O king, the meritorious fruit described for him: / In this world, he becomes victorious, wealthy, and endowed with sons.

4.179.s:
mṛto lokādhipapure pratimanvataraṃ vaset ..
mahāśaktivṛtaḥ paścādetya rājanrasātalam .. 15 ..
4.179.d:
मृतो लोकाधिपपुरे प्रतिमन्वतरं वसेत् ॥
महाशक्तिवृतः पश्चादेत्य राजन्रसातलम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.179.m: Upon death, he dwells in the city of the ruler of the world for each Manvantara; / thereafter, accompanied by great power, returning [from] Rasātala, O king,

4.179.s:
jitasarvamahīpālaścakravartī bhavedbhuvi ..
yā ca nārī mahārāja dānametatprayacchati..16..
4.179.d:
जितसर्वमहीपालश्चक्रवर्ती भवेद्भुवि ॥
या च नारी महाराज दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति॥16॥
4.179.m: having conquered all kings, he becomes a universal monarch on earth. / And whatever woman, O great king, gives this gift,

4.179.s:
sā cakravartinaṃ putraṃ sūte śaktisamanvitam ..
yaśca paśyeddīyamānaṃ dattaṃ yaścānumodate .. 17 ..
4.179.d:
सा चक्रवर्तिनं पुत्रं सूते शक्तिसमन्वितम् ॥
यश्च पश्येद्दीयमानं दत्तं यश्चानुमोदते ॥ 17 ॥
4.179.m: gives birth to a son who is a universal monarch endowed with power. / And whoever sees it being given, and whoever rejoices at it when given,

4.179.s: śṛṇoti vācyamānaṃ ca sopi pretya vimucyate..18..
4.179.d: शृणोति वाच्यमानं च सोपि प्रेत्य विमुच्यते॥18॥
4.179.m: and hears it being recited, he too is liberated after death.

4.179.s:
yāḥ śakravahniyamanairṛtapāśahastā vāteṃdurājaśivakeśavaśaṃbhuśaktyaḥ ..
tā vai prapūjya daśakalpalatā dvijebhyo dehi trilokavijaye yadi te'sti buddhiḥ .. 19 .. ..
gajarathāśvarathadānavidhivarṇanam
4.179.d:
याः शक्रवह्नियमनैरृतपाशहस्ता वातेंदुराजशिवकेशवशंभुशक्त्यः ॥
ता वै प्रपूज्य दशकल्पलता द्विजेभ्यो देहि त्रिलोकविजये यदि तेऽस्ति बुद्धिः ॥ 19 ॥ ॥
गजरथाश्वरथदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.179.m:
Having duly worshipped those ten wishing-vines, the powers of Śakra, Vahni, Yama, Nairṛta, Pāśahasta, / Vāta, Indu, Rāja, Śiva, Keśava, and Śambhu, give them to the twice-born if your mind is set on conquest of the three worlds.
Description of the Rite of the Gift of the Elephant Chariot and the Horse Chariot
